Aided by her superpowered sidekick, a plucky little sprite called Billy Blind, Nell realizes that fate has put her on the wrong side of the law for a reason. A reason much bigger than she could have ever imagined: to defeat a magical plot against the Queen of England.

meta.plot: La série est centrée sur une grande famille de 99 dalmatiens dont le nom commence par la lettre "D" et leurs parents, Doug et Dalila, dont le dernier est un descendant de Pongo et Perdita. Ils laissent souvent les frères et sœurs aînés, Dylan et Dolly, en charge alors qu'ils sont occupés au travail. Ils vivent seuls au 101, rue des Dalamtiens, situé à Camden Town, à Londres au XXIe siècle, sans surveillance humaine, leur propriétaire, Dodie Smith, une milliardaire excentrique, leur a laissé sa maison pour aller vivre sur une île.

1.title: FR - Archer - S01E01 - Mole Hunt
1.plot: Archer is in trouble with his Mother and the Comptroller because his expense account is way out of proportion to his actual expenses. So he creates the idea that a Mole has breached ISIS and he needs to get into the mainframe to hunt him down (so he can cover his tracks!). All this leads to a surprising ending.

1.title: FR - Archer - S01E02 - Training Day
1.plot: Lana's residual lust for Archer prompts Malory to promote Cyril to field agent. Archer then trains his new competition as only he can, whilst Malory frets over her own past and her son's future.

1.plot: Owing to a rash of agent deaths (the result of Sterling's carelessness), ISIS can't meet government diversity standards. Enter the gruffly elegant Conway Stern, an "onyx" agent who wears a Star of David around his neck. Conway is "a diversity double whammy," gushes Malory, but that and his secret-agent skills aren't the only reasons she hired him.

1.title: FR - Archer - S01E04 - Killing Utne
1.plot: Malory hosts a dinner party for the UN intelligence chairman, Torvald Utne, in an effort to get a new weapons contract for ISIS. Unfortunately, a group of rival assassins have targeted Mr. Utne for elimination.

1.title: FR - Archer - S01E05 - Honeypot
1.plot: Malory's career is threatened when a sensitive videotape falls into the hands of a rogue (and roguish) Cuban agent, so she calls on Archer’s expertise in seduction to turn the tables on her blackmailer.

But Archer soon finds out the real threat is his protectee: an underage nymphomaniac who will stop at nothing to bed the world’s greatest spy.

2.plot: After Malory is wiped out in a Ponzi scheme, she hatches a scheme of her own: selling ISIS - lock, stock and snack machines - to archrival spy agency ODIN. Archer and the rest of the ISIS employees, rightfully fearing for their jobs, must use every trick in the book (ISIS Field Manual, 3rd Edition) to try to stop the sale.

2.title: FR - Archer - S02E03 - Blood Test
2.plot: When Archer's favorite call girl suddenly arrives for a visit, Archer is shocked to learn that she claims her new baby boy was fathered by him.  She obtains a court order that forces him to take a paternity test in hopes of proving her claim.

Back at ISIS headquarters, Mallory orders the staff to go green to get “freebie socialist tax credits.” A flashback recalls Lana’s introduction to ISIS.

2.title: FR - Archer - S02E05 - The Double Deuce

8.title: FR - Archer - S08E02 - Berenice

9.title: FR - Archer - S09E04 - A Warrior in Costume
9.plot: Archer keeps an eye out for a past nemesis.

9.plot: But there is no joy in Mudville- mighty Pam has struck out.

9.plot: Archer helps defend a village from party crashers intent on ruining oysterfest.

9.title: FR - Archer - S09E08 - A Discovery
9.plot: The Band finally close on a discovery.

10.plot: The crew provides entertainment for Bort while Barry-6 tries to crack Archer's safe.

10.title: FR - Archer - S10E04 - Dining with the Zarglorp
10.plot: Deep in space, Archer and the crew encounter a terrifying cosmic beast. Even deeper, they encounter a self-aggrandizing life coach.

10.title: FR - Archer - S10E05 - Mr. Deadly Goes to Town

10.title: FR - Archer - S10E06 - Road Trip
10.plot: Daydreams of an interstellar road trip turn into an existential nightmare. Written by Mike Arnold.

10.title: FR - Archer - S10E07 - Space Pirates
10.plot: A voyage home gets interrupted by an alien battle cruiser carrying precious cargo.

10.title: FR - Archer - S10E08 - Cubert
10.plot: Archer is convinced a mysterious object is causing the crew to act strangely. Is it magnetic? Is it supernatural? Does it need to be cleaned with some sterile wipes?

10.title: FR - Archer - S10E09 - Robert De Niro

11.plot: Archer is back in the spy game and his first mission is to guard a priceless statue; then, he must tell Lana his true feelings and get blind drunk.

11.title: FR - Archer - S11E02 - Bloodsploosh
11.plot: Archer and the gang attend a martial arts tournament to capture an international arms dealer.

11.title: FR - Archer - S11E03 - Helping Hands
FR - Archer - S11E04 - Robot Factory
11.plot: Archer and the gang team up with Barry to stop an army of Barrys from turning the world into Barrys.

11.plot: Archer is head over heels for his new valet, Aleister. Will Archer do Aleister's recommended rehabilitation exercises or just eat himself to death?

11.title: FR - Archer - S11E06 - The Double Date
FR - Archer - S11E07 - Caught Napping
11.plot: When AJ is kidnapped, it's up to Archer to get her back and keep Lana's rampage pointed in the right direction.

11.title: FR - Archer - S11E08 - Cold Fusion
11.plot: Archer and the gang travel to Antarctica to solve a murder mystery with international implications.

12.title: FR - Archer - S12E01 - Identity Crisis
12.plot: Archer and the gang just saved the world from a nuclear catastrophe and their reward is five nights in a rat-infested Moldovan hotel.

12.title: FR - Archer - S12E02 - Lowjacked
12.plot: The Agency embarks on a team building exercise that doesn't quite get off the ground.

12.title: FR - Archer - S12E03 - London Time
12.plot: A mission across the pond turns into a trip down memory lane for Malory while Cheryl/Carol teaches Pam about British history.

12.title: FR - Archer - S12E04 - Photo Op
12.plot: Archer and Lana face off against snakes, crocodiles and mercenaries to reunite a family.

12.title: FR - Archer - S12E05 - Shots
12.plot: Sex, drugs, and monster trucks! Archer and the gang celebrate another barely successful mission.

12.title: FR - Archer - S12E06 - Dingo, Baby, Et Cetera
12.plot: Lana makes rookie mistakes as ghosts from Archer's past haunt him on a special mission.

12.title: FR - Archer - S12E07 - Colt Express
12.plot: A mysterious stranger and a scavenger hunt helps Archer and the gang get a jump on their enemies.

12.title: FR - Archer - S12E08 - Mission: Difficult
12.plot: Archer is trapped inside IIA headquarters and Barry is trapped inside Other Barry.

13.title: FR - Archer - S13E01 - The Big Con
13.plot: Free drinks, party rooms and swag bags are just a few of the things the gang is not enjoying at the world's foremost spy convention, Clandesti-con!

13.title: FR - Archer - S13E02 - Operation: Fang
13.plot: Gillette is in charge of a creepy crawly mission in a tropical jungle.

13.title: FR - Archer - S13E03 - Saturday
13.plot: Mommy daughter day turns into a lesson in fellowship and tactical awareness.

13.title: FR - Archer - S13E04 - The Laws of Attraction
13.plot: Fabian tasks The Agency with recovering a piece of valuable tech from a nefarious threat, the Swiss!

13.title: FR - Archer - S13E05 - Out of Network
13.plot: Archer seeks professional help but IIA's health plan is murder.

13.title: FR - Archer - S13E06 - Bank Run at Mr. Bank's Bank
13.plot: Is Fabian asking The Agency to rob a bank? No, because we won't use those words.

13.title: FR - Archer - S13E07 - Distraction Action
13.plot: Archer has a brilliant plan to evade capture. There is only one problem, he refuses to follow it.

13.title: FR - Archer - S13E08 - Dough, Ray and Me
13.plot: Archer and the gang knead proof in order to temper expectations and ice the mission.

14.plot: The Agency teams up with Interpol to take down a highly organized ring of jewel thieves. Archer’s skeptical as their Interpol contact seems to be treating the mission as more of an audition... but for which side?

14.plot: Archer, Lana and Zara travel to England to stop a thief who is stealing possibly-cursed artifacts. Can Archer break the curse before it breaks him?

14.title: FR - Archer - S14E04 - Chill Barry
14.plot: Barry’s back, but will he give the gang the cold shoulder in their quest to put Other Barry on ice?

14.plot: An unplanned vacation forces Lana to accompany Archer, Pam and Cyril on a mission that quickly goes off the rails. Will Lana blow the mission when she crosses the line?

14.title: FR - Archer - S14E06 - Face Off

14.plot: A former adversary lends a hand as Archer and the gang bond together to try and stop a fleet of killer drones.

meta.plot: Sterling Archer is the world's most daunting spy. He works for ISIS, a spy agency run by his mother. In between dealing with his boss and his co-workers - one of whom is his ex-girlfriend - Archer manages to annoy or seduce everyone that crosses his path. His antics are only excusable because at the end of the day, he still somehow always manages to thwart whatever crises was threatening mankind.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E01 - The Avengers Protocol (1)
1.plot: When Captain America is apparently destroyed by Red Skull, Iron Man reunites the team to avenge him.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E02 - The Avengers Protocol (2)
1.plot: Red Skull steals Tony Stark's armor and The Avengers put aside their differences and stop him and M.O.D.O.K. from destroying New York City.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E03 - Ghost of a Chance
1.plot: The rookie Falcon stands alone to save his team and stop a full scale invasion of Earth after the Avengers fall victim to the body-swapping Space Phantoms.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E04 - The Serpent of Doom
1.plot: Thor believes he must sacrifice himself to save the world from Doctor Doom, who summons the Midgard Serpent using a powerful Asgardian weapon.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E05 - Blood Feud
1.plot: To save Black Widow, Captain America leads the team into battle against a former World War II ally who he struggles to convince the team is a real person.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E06 - Super Adaptoid
1.plot: The Avengers are out-gunned by the high-tech, power-mimicking Super-Adaptoid, and Captain America is the last man standing against the ultimate artificial intelligence!

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E07 - Hyperion
1.plot: Hyperion arrives to save the Earth but his methods become too extreme and the Avengers must stand up to him.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E08 - Molecule Kid
1.plot: Hawkeye and Black Widow take on a covert S.H.I.E.L.D. mission to bring in the son of a super-villain, but when he is revealed to have a world-bending weapon, they realize keeping their mission a secret may be a fatal mistake.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E09 - Depth Charge
1.plot: When Attuma tries to sink Manhattan, Hulk is forced to prove his strength or perish trying.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E10 - The Doomstroyer
1.plot: Doctor Doom takes command of the Asgardian Destroyer armor and Thor has to convince the team to trust the one person who may be able to stop him, Loki!

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E11 - Hulked Out Heroes
1.plot: The Avengers learn what it's like to walk a mile in Hulk's shoes when a Gamma attack by Red Skull turns them into raging monsters - the unlikely duo of Hulk and Black Widow are the last line of defense between the city and the Hulk-Vengers.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E12 - Avengers: Impossible!
1.plot: The Avengers' world is turned upside down when the shape-shifting mischief-maker Impossible Man makes Falcon the star of his own action movie, but the blockbuster puts all of Earth on the line.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E13 - In Deep
1.plot: Iron Man and Captain America disguise themselves as villains to infiltrate Red Skull's Cabal, but when their disagreements over strategy cause their cover to get blown, they're forced to take on the entire Cabal alone.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E14 - Hulk's Day Out
1.plot: When Hulk crash-lands on Earth with amnesia, The Avengers reconstruct a day-in-the-life of Hulk to find out what world-ending threat could have knocked out The Strongest There Is.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E15 - Planet Doom
1.plot: Thor returns to find Earth under the rule of Doctor Doom, who has changed the past drastically to ensure that the Avengers never formed.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E16 - Bring on the Bad Guys
1.plot: The Avengers start to see how tough the Cabal is and how much strength they'll need to take it down.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E17 - Savages
1.plot: Tony becomes too reliant on his tech so Cap challenges him to go without it for one full day.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E18 - Mojo World
1.plot: Hulk and Hawkeye suddenly find themselves stuck in a death match at the hands of the intergalactic broadcasting master, Mojo.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E19 - The Ambassador
1.plot: The Avengers put their lives at risk to protect none other than Doctor Doom.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E20 - All-Father's Day
1.plot: Odin comes to the Avengers Tower demanding his son cease his "fun" on Earth and return to Asgard. Thor promises that if he can't prove the good he does on Earth he'll return home forever.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E21 - By the Numbers
1.plot: The Avengers and the Cabal have a huge confrontation that leaves the team forever changed. Tony also learns that "the stats" can't be trusted every time -- there's no substitute for human intuition.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E22 - Guardians & Space Knights
1.plot: When Galactus attacks Earth, Iron Man is able to lead him to another planet but discovers that it is populated and under the protection of the Guardians of the Galaxy.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E23 - One Little Thing
1.plot: While Iron Man and Ant-Man are trying to stabilize particles that can shrink or grow matter, Falcon gives them terrible news -- his mom is coming to visit, and she has no idea he's an Avenger.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E24 - Crime and Circuses
1.plot: When the Circus of Crime rolls into town, Hawkeye's dark past begins to surface and puts the Avengers in danger.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E25 - Exodus
1.plot: Iron Man's confidence is shaken after he inadvertently puts Falcon in harm's way. When the Cabal pulls the trigger on its final plan, Tony has to put aside his personal dilemma and be the leader he was born to be.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E26 - The Final Showdown
1.plot: With the Tesseract now in the hands of the Cosmic Skull, the world is in catastrophic peril. Iron Man realizes teaming up with the rest of the Cabal might be their only chance for victory.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E01 - The Arsenal
2.plot: When Red Skull comes crashing to Earth with a fleet of alien ships chasing him, the Avengers learn there's a villain in their midst a thousand times more dangerous than the Cabal ever was: Thanos! Earth's Mightiest Heroes are forced to face the fact they're big fish in a small pond -- and this new villain wants to conquer the entire ocean! Will the mightiest superheroes on Earth be able to stop the super-villain of the galaxy... before he succeeds in becoming all-powerful?

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E02 - Thanos Rising
2.plot: With the help of Arsenal, a robot created by Howard Stark for Tony, the Avengers must stop Thanos from gaining the Power Stone - an energy force so powerful that it could cause mass destruction.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E03 - Valhalla Can Wait
2.plot: Hulk and Thor are tricked into a battle and transported to Valhalla to find out who is the strongest, once and for all. But under Hela's rule, only the loser of their contest may return to Earth while the winner will become her consort and champion.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E04 - Ghosts of the Past
2.plot: Red Skull has information that could help the Avengers save the world from Thanos, but an intruder kidnaps Skull before they can retrieve it. Cap discovers that the trespasser is none other than his old partner Bucky Barnes, now the Winter Soldier, who's back and seeks revenge.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E05 - Beneath the Surface
2.plot: When Hawkeye and Black Widow stumble upon the Serpent Crown, they must work together to stop Attuma's battalion from destroying Atlantis.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E06 - Nighthawk
2.plot: When a mysterious new villain uses the individualized counter measures Falcon created when he was at S.H.I.E.L.D. to take out the Avengers one by one, he must figure out a way to save his team.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E07 - The Age of Tony Stark
2.plot: When the Time Stone becomes attached to Tony's arc reactor, it causes him to de-age and brings dangers from other eras, including dinosaurs, into present-day New York City.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E08 - Head to Head
2.plot: Tony believes the Avengers have reached the pinnacle of perfection, but when M.O.D.O.K. uses the Mind Stone to assume control of S.H.I.E.L.D., the team is put to the test as they are forced to swap minds.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E09 - The Dark Avengers
2.plot: In a 'flipped reality,' the Avengers discover that their world has been reshaped by the Reality Stone, wielded by the Squadron Supreme. In this new reality the Squadron Supreme have made themselves the heroes and the Avengers the villains! Find out if the Avengers can take down the Squadron Supreme and prove that they're the real heroes.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E10 - Back to the Learning Hall
2.plot: When Thor is tricked into returning to Asgard, he and the Avengers discover they must defeat Loki and prevent Earth and Asgard from crashing into one another and foil Loki's plan to escape Valhalla and seek revenge on his brother.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E11 - Downgraded
2.plot: Stranded without his gear in a dangerous realm where technology doesn't work, Falcon must prove to himself and a skeptical Hawkeye that he's still a hero.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E12 - Widow's Run
2.plot: The Avengers must protect Widow and Thor as they carry out Widow's plan to rid the Earth of the Infinity Stones before Thanos arrives to claim them and control the Universe.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E13 - Thanos Triumphant
2.plot: With the power and might of all five Infinity Stones finally in his gauntlet, Thanos plans to wield his power over the Universe while the Avengers make a desperate attempt to stop him.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E14 - Crack in the System
2.plot: Iron Man and Captain America try to rebuild their relationship, until Cap discovers Iron Man's hiding dangerous information about an artificial intelligence unit named Ultron.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E15 - Avengers Disassembled
2.plot: An even more powerful Ultron resurfaces and takes control of Avengers Tower and Iron Man's Hall of Armors, leading to the destruction of the Avengers as we know them.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E16 - Small Time Heroes
2.plot: With the team divided and the Avengers Tower wiped out, Tony seeks help from Ant-Man. Learning he's busy fighting MODOK, Tony's team joins Ant-Man to stop the Pym Particle thief.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E17 - Secret Avengers
2.plot: Working for S.H.I.E.L.D. isn't everything Captain America's team had hoped when they're expected to unquestionably follow orders involving the Crimson Dynamo and The Winter Guard.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E18 - The Ultron Outbreak
2.plot: The Avengers reunite when Captain America and Iron Man learn to appreciate their differences while trying to save the world from ultimate destruction at the hands of Ultron!

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E19 - The New Guy
2.plot: When Ant-Man joins the Avengers, Hawkeye resigns and trains his replacement on Monster Island, unaware that Red Skull is nearby planning to cloak himself using Dormammu's powers!

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E20 - Terminal Velocity
2.plot: The Squadron Supreme's fastest member Speed Demon is on the loose and wreaking havoc throughout Avengers Tower. Hulk must save the day by fighting the high velocity villain. Meanwhile, the other Avengers face off against Hyperion.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E21 - Spectrums
2.plot: New Avenger, Ant-Man, begins to atone by bringing his former allies to justice. His quest for redemption leads the team to an epic battle with Squadron Supreme's Dr. Spectrum.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E22 - Midgard Crisis
2.plot: Thor is convinced that Zarda wants to defect from Squadron Supreme, but Hulk knows better and must protect Thor from Zarda's duplicitous ways.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E23 - Avengers' Last Stand
2.plot: Falcon tries to prove he can be a leader when the Squadron Supreme enacts their end game and kidnaps Captain America and Tony. Things become even more difficult when the Avengers discover the Squadron Supreme's last few plots were all part of an even bigger plan to revive their previously unknown sixth member named Nuke.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E24 - Avengers Underground
2.plot: Unbeknownst to the Squadron and the rest of the world, the Avengers are in hiding and working on a plan to save the planet and stop the Squadron Supreme once and for all!

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E25 - New Frontiers
2.plot: When an alien race begs the Avengers to save them from mysterious invaders, the team discovers that a recently-escaped Thanos and his Black Order are plundering the planet. Meanwhile, Tony seeks new challenges for the team.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E26 - Avengers World
2.plot: When Thanos attacks Earth, planning to finally take over the planet by destroying the Avengers, the team discovers they are more than eight heroes - they are an ideal.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E01 - Adapting to Change
3.plot: The Avengers learn what it's like to work as a team again as they battle a new and improved Super Adaptoid that was developed by A.I.M.'s Scientist Supreme.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E02 - The Ultimates
3.plot: Ultron is back and plans to replace humanity with robots known as Ultimates.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E03 - Saving Captain Rogers
3.plot: Captain America battles to rescue Winter Soldier who has been captured by Baron Zemo.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E04 - Under Siege
3.plot: Hawkeye must defend the Avengers Tower from Baron Zemo who has taken the Masters of Evil members Beetle, Fixer, Goliath, Moonstone, and Screaming Mimi under his leadership.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E05 - The Thunderbolts
3.plot: The Avengers fight to stop Justin Hammer’s new weapons factories, but are both helped and hindered by a mysterious new team of heroes known as the Thunderbolts.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E06 - Thunderbolts Revealed
3.plot: When the Avengers discover that the Thunderbolts are actually the Masters of Evil, they must decide whether they can trust the villainous team to turn on their leader, Baron Zemo.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E07 - Into the Dark Dimension
3.plot: Dr. Strange needs the Avengers' help when Dormammu steals the Eye of Agamotto.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E08 - Dehulked
3.plot: Hulk is drained of his gamma radiation and stuck as Bruce Banner.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E09 - Inhumans Among Us
3.plot: When townspeople transform into primitive creatures, the Avengers attempt to help them by putting themselves into conflict with the Inhumans.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E10 - The Inhuman Condition
3.plot: The Avengers must team up with the Inhumans to stop their old foe, Ultron, who plans to unleash a dangerous weapon upon Earth.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E11 - The Kids Are Alright
3.plot: Captain America and Iron Man must partner with new and young Inhumans - Inferno and Ms. Marvel - to stop another Inhuman, The Ghost, from stealing Friday.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E12 - The Conqueror
3.plot: The Avengers try to stop AIM from stealing high-tech weapons from the future, which attracts the attention of the 30th Century warlord - Kang the Conqueror!

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E13 - Into The Future
3.plot: With the exception of Thor, the Avengers become trapped in the 30th century and must beat Kang the Conqueror to find their way back to their own time.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E14 - Seeing Double
3.plot: Black Widow comes face-to-face with Yelena Belova, who in her determination to create the ultimate weapon turns Hulk into the Winter Hulk.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E15 - A Friend in Need
3.plot: Thor teaches the Vision the value of friendship by taking him to Asgard where together they must fight an Ultron-controlled Destroyer.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E16 - Captain Marvel
3.plot: The Avengers join Captain Marvel in a fight to stop a powerful sentient spaceship from destroying Earth.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E17 - Panther's Rage
3.plot: Speaking before The General Assembly of The United Nations, Black Panther is targeted by Crossbones... and has issue with Captain America's possession of vibranium!

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E18 - Ant-Man Makes It Big
3.plot: On the set of a superhero motion picture, the Avengers team up with Ant-Man to stop the madman Egghead from destroying Los Angeles.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E19 - The House of Zemo
3.plot: Baron Zemo returns to target the Avengers alongside his father, whom he's brought back from the 1940s.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E20 - U-Foes
3.plot: The President has signed the New Powers Act in response to the Terrigen Fog creating new Inhumans and Truman Marsh is assigned to be the Avengers liaison to the government. Meanwhile, scientists backed by HYDRA enter a gamma storm with a stolen spaceship and are transformed into the U-Foes where they plan to take over HYDRA when Baron Strucker hasn't returned.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E21 - Building the Perfect Weapon
3.plot: Following Truman Marsh replacing Hulk with Red Hulk, the Avengers must stop Leader from building and unleashing his secret weapon.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E22 - World War Hulk
3.plot: The Avengers must stop an out-of-control Red Hulk as he threatens to destroy an entire town.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E23 - Civil War (1): The Fall of Attilan
3.plot: The Avengers must stop Maximus from wreaking havoc in Attilan and causing its citizens to lose control of their powers.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E24 - Civil War (2): The Mighty Avengers
3.plot: With the Avengers disbanded, a new team - the Mighty Avengers - steps in to take their place.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E25 - Civil War (3): The Drums of War
3.plot: When the Inhumans are mind-controlled into attacking innocent humans, the Avengers must find a way to override their control and end the war.

3.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S03E26 - Civil War (4): Avengers Revolution
3.plot: The Avengers, old and new, must find a way to free the Inhumans and the world from Ultron's control.

4.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S04E01 - Avengers No More (1)
4.plot: The team battles against The Leader and his new cabal.

4.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S04E02 - Avengers No More (2)
4.plot: Black Panther must assemble a new team of Avengers.

4.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S04E03 - The Sleeper Awakens
4.plot: Red Skull loses control of his doomsday sleeper robots and it's up to the new Avengers to stop them.

4.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S04E04 - Prison Break
4.plot: It's up to Captain Marvel to stop Crimson Widow, Typhoid Mary and Zarda from breaking out of the vault.

4.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S04E05 - The Incredible Herc
4.plot: Hercules joins the new Avengers but he hasn't told the truth about why he's in New York City.

meta.plot: Marvel’s Avengers Assemble est une série animée racontant des histoires directement en lien avec le film The Avengers. Iron Man est le leader de cette équipe réunissant les plus puissants des superhéros: Hulk, Captain America, Thor, Hawkeye, Black Widow et un nouveau venu, Falcon. Ils allieront leurs forces face à des menaces qu'un seul ne peut pas vaincre. Quand les Avengers se réunissent, le mal n'a aucune chance de l'emporter.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E02 - Blaze of Glory - Part 2
1.plot: Blaze steps up when a cheating truck uses dirty tricks to try and win the championship race.

1.plot: When Crusher accidentally turns the baker truck's baker bots to messy mode, they sprout wheels and drive away.

1.plot: Blaze and AJ discover a mud-loving monster truck in the woods and set out on an adventure to bring their new friend to Mud Fest.

1.plot: Blaze and his friends join the Truck Rangers, a scouting club where trucks earn badges for their accomplishments.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E15 - Trouble at the Truck Wash
1.plot: Blaze and AJ must track down the missing pieces of Gabby's Truck Wash and rebuild it so their friends can get clean.

1.plot: Zeg, Blaze and AJ find a tiny dinosaur egg and try to return it to its mother.

1.plot: When Crusher tries to cheat at a carnival game, he accidentally strands himself and Pickle on a giant rocket.

1.plot: When Crusher cheats during a tropical island race with Blaze, AJ manages to rescue his best friend while overcoming obstacles.

2.plot: Zeg lands in a mud pit located far away, so Blaze and AJ try to rescue him by using a new engineering design inspired by their dinosaur-truck pals.

2.plot: It's Halloween in Axle City, and Blaze, AJ, and all of their friends are excited to "Truck or Treat." But when Crusher tries to steal all of their candy, his plan goes awry, and he sends their treats far away from Axle City.

2.plot: Blaze and his friends compete in the most epic race in history. They meet pirates and the Sphinx on a whirlwind world-tour. But when Crusher throws them off course, Blaze and pals must persevere to make it to the finish line.

2.plot: Today Darington will attempt his biggest stunt yet: rocketing to the moon! But there's just one problem. His battery-powered rocket is out of energy. To get to the moon Blaze must help Darington recharge his battery.

2.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S02E11 - Five Alarm Blaze
2.plot: There's a fire on the bridge, and it's too much for the Fire Chief and his team to handle. They need Firefighting Blaze to help. With time running out, Blaze hurries across town. But can he get to the bridge in time?

2.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S02E12 - Axle City Grand Prix
2.plot: Axle City Grand Prix: Gabby has the perfect tool to get Blaze ready to race: a special remote that can control any machine. But when Crusher takes her remote, he activates machines all over town to slow Blaze down.

2.plot: Blaze, AJ, and Gabby join Pegwheel the Pirate-Truck for an island treasure hunt! Following their treasure map, the friends search jungle beaches and mountains to find where X marks the spot.

2.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S02E15 - Dinosaur Parade
2.plot: Blaze, AJ, and lots of spectators have gathered to watch herds of dinosaurs march through Axle City! But when Crusher pushes his way into the parade, he scatters dinos everywhere, and it's up to Blaze, AJ, and Zeg to find and rescue them.

2.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S02E16 - Race Car Superstar
2.plot: While visiting another town, a snooty car traps all of the racers, and Blaze must become a racecar to free his new friends.

2.plot: Swoops the helicopter loses his rotor, and without it he can't fly! It's time for Blaze and AJ to retrieve the runaway rotor, adventuring up onto The Sky Track, an amazing course that weaves through the clouds.

2.plot: Blaze, AJ, and Stripes are searching for the Wishing Wheel: a magical treasure that will grant a wish for one lucky race car. But with chomping, stomping, and slithering dangers at every turn, can Blaze and his friends stay on track?

meta.plot: AJ est un mécano de 8 ans qui conduit son gros camion qu'il appelle « Blaze », le bolide le plus rapide d'Axle City. Les deux partent à l'aventure et trouvent sur leur chemin des problèmes de sciences et de maths. Ces problèmes, auxquels ils sont confrontés, sont causés par le rival de Blaze, Crusher, une semi-remorque qui fera tout pour vaincre ses rivaux jusqu'à la ligne d'arrivée.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E01 - Brothers of the Universe
1.plot: Koji Kaboto tries his OVT that he made with pieces of mecano. When flying, he is attacked by the UFOs of Vega. Fortunately Duke Fleed arrives on time to save the day (but not too quickly nonetheless). Koji does not actually know that Duke Fleed is the prince of Fleed.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E02 - Prince of the Other World
1.plot: Koji discovers the identity of the Duke Fleed, but has no time to ask questions because Vega attacks. Duke Fleed and Koji unite their power and push back the enemy.

1.plot: Dampee Makeeba organizes a party at the ranch and invites Koji and Duke Fleed. The latter has no time to eat anything because Vega attacks. Will he have the time to make it to Grendizer before the earth is ravaged? All bets are open...

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E04 - The Island of Fear
1.plot: Gandal wants to discover the hiding place of Grendizer. So he launches a massive attack. Koji tries to confront the enemies alone, but he only succeeds to crush himself on a deserted island. Finally Duke Fleed makes it there and saves the day.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E05 - The Pitfall of Death
1.plot: Koji, Hikaro, Goro and Bunta are taken in hostage. Actarus interrupts his siesta to free them.

1.plot: Hikaro leaves for Perlepolis with Bunta. Their bus is attacked by a monster of Vega. Koji distracts the monster the time that Duke Fleed arrives (Grendizer has trouble to start up in winter).

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E07 - The Feast of the Wolves
1.plot: Janus, from the fearsome Ruins' Division, attacks Grendizer that is powerless in front of the brutality and the agility of his enemy.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E08 - The Radars are Off
1.plot: Blaki sets a trap to Grendizer by hiding mines in a cloud of spatial dust. Koji falls in the trap. Fortunately Duke Fleed helps him and destroys the Golgoth 8.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E09 - The Black Moon Camp
1.plot: Koji is captured with his UFO by the Vegans. Grendizer attacks the camp of the black Moon to save him.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E10 - Vega's Spy
1.plot: An inhabitant of the planet Rubi is contacted by Vega to explode the UFO carrier of Grendizer. The mission fails because of Duke Fleed and the Vegans try to kill the Rubinian. But Duke Fleed flies to his help.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E11 - The Day when the Sun will Stop
1.plot: The Vegans plan is to bring Grendizer to the shadow of the moon during the eclipse because Grendizer's systems will shut down temporarily under it and then destroy it.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E12 - Blood on Snow
1.plot: Daisuke and Kogi are sent to investigate an avalanche and to find survivors. They find a girl named Mirana who lost her memory. Back at Space Science Centre she begins to remember how a saucer destroyed her home.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E13 - By Iron and by Fire
1.plot: A new Vegan mecha comes to destroy Earth. It sucks power from the sun and burns everything in its path. Grendizer is damaged by it and has to withdraw. As the mecha attacks again Grendizer has to go to battle weaponless.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E14 - The Day of the Rising Sun
1.plot: Boss, Nuké, and Mocha are in this episode. They are visiting their old friend Koji Kabuto. The Vegans keep their eye on a mysterious orange robot that is found skiing near-by. Commander Blacki orders the Minifo to follow it and investigate.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E15 - Red Akerae
1.plot: Commander Yara is forced to create a mecha that creates earthquakes and use it on the city Kanto.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E16 - The Fiancé of Death
1.plot: A Vegan pilot lands near the Space Science Centre and makes Mr. Hayashi's fiancé, Kaori, a spy for him. She takes Dr. Umon as a hostage.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E17 - The Infernal Ride
1.plot: The Vegans begin building a base for their operations on Earth. The saucer "Giba Giba" begins to attack but Grendizer comes to save the day by saving a town and a mountain.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E18 - The New Time of the Caves
1.plot: Dr. Umon made a project so that Grendizer is able to launch without revealing his whereabouts to the enemy. Kabuto is control by the Vegans and fights Duke.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E19 - The Crushed Town
1.plot: A huge meteor is headed straight gives order to fire on the meteor and change its course to head for the planet Earth. The meteors are detected and Grendizer launches to intercept them before they hit land.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E20 - Earth in Danger
1.plot: Daisuke gets the suspicion that the Vegans may be planning to pull the moon down to Earth. Duke Freed launches Grendizer and follows Koji who already went to explore the area of Mount Kirofoki.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E21 - The Submerged Continents
1.plot: The Vegans plan to melt ice in the North Pole. This will cause the sea level to rise with catastrophic results to the shores on Earth.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E22 - The Slayers of the Sky
1.plot: The Vegans are planning to steal Dr. Chibana's new device so that they can use it to silence Duke Freed and his Grendizer.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E23 - The Flood of the New Worlds
1.plot: The Vegans continue their attempts to discover Grendizer's secret hideout as they are sure that the Space Science Centre has something to do with it. Hikaru finds out who Daisuke really is.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E24 - The Enforcer
1.plot: Commander Witer successfully sneaks into Earth as Dr. Space who is a well-known acquaintance of Dr. Umon and a reliable person so he can find Duke Fleed and kill him.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E25 - Fleed's Lovers
1.plot: uke Freed's childhood friends Nayda, brainwashed by the Vegans, attempts to put a bomb on Grendizer but Duke stops her. Nayda accuses Duke of being a traitor. Koji attempts to pilot Grendizer but is almost killed.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E26 - The Edges of the Abyss
1.plot: Dr. Umon sends Koji and Hayashi on a mission in outer space to build a satellite station. At the same time, the Space Science Centre is surrounded by a huge Minifo saucer squadron.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E27 - Win or Perish
1.plot: Grendizer's delicate weapon systems malfunction and he finds himself struggling against the enemy. The Vegans arrive and descend upon the Center. Hikaru and Daisuke must fix Grendizer and save the Center.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E28 - The New Masters of Darkness
1.plot: General Zuril is a brilliant scientist who will try to find different ways of taking down Grendizer. Daisuke, Hikaru, and Goro are attacked by Vegans and Danbi puts on his gear and begins fighting them too.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E29 - The Fire Bird
1.plot: Vegans shrink the cells of the living body to make Harook become a young boy for a time so he can spy Space Science Centre. Harrok and Goro become friends but later the effects of the shrinking begin to wear off so Harook captures Goro.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E30 - The Lightning Rock
1.plot: A strange rock full of radiation energy lands on Earth and Dr. Umon can't make much of this new phenomenon. At the same time, the Vegans discover this strong source of energy and put it to use in their next saucer beast.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E31 - A Dreamer from Outer-Space
1.plot: The Boss, Koji, and Bunta go to the Boss Borot to begin their counterattack of the Vegan attack on them but will face some technical difficulties. Grendizer gets into some trouble while trying to help them but the Boss Borot will help Grendizer in the funniest way but will lose his Boss Spazer.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E32 - The Ghost Queen
1.plot: The Vegans send a woman by the name of Marian who looks identical to Duke Freed's mother who passed away on planet Freed.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E33 - The Wings of Death
1.plot: The Vegans send a bird named "Zari Zari" to distroy Grendizer, but Duke remember a similar bird from his home planet Fleed and will use this knowledge to go and finish it off.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E34 - The Mercenary of Oppression
1.plot: Vega promised Commander Gos that if he kills Duke Freed then Vega would spare the Wolf Planet from Vegan brutality.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E35 - The First Raid
1.plot: General Gandal assigns Commander Beetle with his saucer beast to attack the Space Science Centre from underground. Meanwhile, Koji Kabuto's new Double Spazer ship has just been completed and Koji is ready to be air-born again.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E36 - The Invincible Cosmos
1.plot: Dr. Umon calls Daisuke and Koji to show them the way that Grendizer and Double Spazer can unite together and fly. The objective of this is to minimize the need for Grendizer to have to lock in and out of Spazer as these are Grendizer's weakest moments and he is helpless in them.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E37 - A Star is Dead
1.plot: The Vegan plan is to steal a huge capsule full of Super Uranium from Earth. Vegan forces are dispatched immediately to do just that.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E38 - Darkness Makers
1.plot: Hikaru becomes a pilot. Duke Freed faces another Vegan saucer beast loaded with Vegatron rays, and Koji nearly gets captured by the Minifo after gathering the energy but manages to escape very injured.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E39 - The Patrol of Eagles
1.plot: Danbi tells Daisuke that his daughter is outstanding and capable of helping him and Koji. Daisuke disagrees insisting that war and sport are two different things. Finally Daisuke will allow Hikaru to be part of the team after her vital help.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E40 - The Awakening of Volcanoes
1.plot: A series of explosions start to occur under the sea and General Zuril wastes no time in discovering that this is raw Uranium. Saucer beast "Boi Boi" is launched to go and get this energy as this saucer beast naturally collects Uranium. At the same time Dr. Umon is alerted by these explosions which are close to an island with a Uranium capsule.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E41 - Baptism of Fire
1.plot: Hikaru loses her consciousness during training and Duke Freed gets injured and his old wound gets worse. The Vegans begin their attack and Daisuke goes to the battle even though he is injured.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E42 - Peril in Abode
1.plot: Dr. Umon's Space Science Centre is undergoing some major changes to keep up with Vega's attacks. A super computer is installed in the base, and turning it on will be the final step. The Vegans plan to get rid of the base and leave Grendizer without a place to hide.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E43 - The Victory of Eagles
1.plot: A strange meteor heads slowly towards Earth and Koji will go unilaterally and see what it's all about. After nearly getting blinded by a ray that came out of the meteor, Koji's Double Spazer begins to exit the Earth's atmosphere.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E44 - When Dogs are Loosened
1.plot: A young man by the name of Hiyoshi is very interested in searching for ancient evidence to prove that spacemen came to Earth in the past. He goes to look at walls in a near-by cave for ancient scripts to prove his theory, but the villagers think he is crazy. Hundreds of years ago, the Vegans had sent some of their people to Earth. There still is a metal on the wall that they used for landing, and this metal cannot be detected by the radar.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E45 - Ants and Men
1.plot: With his telescope, Goro spots a meteor that splits in two with each piece landing in a different mountain. These actually contain eggs of the Vegan ants. When Goro tells everyone about it he is not taken seriously. Soon Grendizer and Drill Spazer will unite to face the new danger.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E46 - The Ballet of Sharks
1.plot: Vegan robot sharks land one night and are hidden in a public pool for their next plan. Koji finds himself a hostage of the Vegans who tell him about their plans to take all of the people as hostages.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E47 - The Ignited Lake
1.plot: Danbi induces a race between Daisuke and Koji. Koji takes it to seriously. The group goes camping near a lake. Vegans begin to descent in the lake and then the Space Science Centre suddenly gets attacked by missiles from the near-by lake where the Vegans stay hidden.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E48 - World in Fusion
1.plot: Duke Freed unites with Koji and the Drill Spazer to chase a Vegan saucer beast. The Vegans make an acid swamp to sink the Space Science Centre.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E49 - The Last Survivor
1.plot: Maria tries to kill Duke, thinking the person who pilots Grendizer is evil but during the fight Duke necklace falls and the siblings discover who each other is.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E50 - The Four-Headed Eagle
1.plot: Maria the new member on the team, is able to control Grendizer and Marine Spazer. She also has the ability to foresee events so she is able to save Koji from Vegans.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E51 - The Black Star
1.plot: The Vegan plan is to make this moon enter the Earth's atmosphere and cause a catastrophe. The battle between Vegans and Grendizer takes longer than anticipated and it is too late for Grendizer to fire the missile.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E52 - The Generation Of Monsters
1.plot: General Zuril orders a powerful attack with his latest saucer beast "Domo Domo" to defeat Grendizer before General Dantos gets the chance.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E53 - The Beast
1.plot: Duke Freed will go after Hikaru who is hostige on foot not using Grendizer and help her escape from the giant beast while Koji takes Grendizer back for repairs.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E54 - The Snake
1.plot: The Vegan built a base underwater knowing that Grendizer cannot withstand depths great than 400 meters.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E55 - The Loch Ness Monster
1.plot: Vegans gather some fuel from an industrial island. General Zuril instructs General Gandal on what to do but he doesn't listen and he gets into trouble because his unilateral action revealed that the Vegans have a base on Earth.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E56 - The Lynx of Outer-Space
1.plot: Dr. Umon launches a satellite into space to track Vegan movements on Earth.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E57 - The Monster And The Child
1.plot: Koji and Maria are on their vacation in Tokyo, they get into a fight as usual and split up.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E58 - The Lookalike
1.plot: The Vegans make a false Grendizer that attacked Earth people so the real Grendizer will be hated.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E59 - The Commando
1.plot: A group of Vegan kids come to Earth and hold hostages the people inside the observatory.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E60 - Rats
1.plot: The Vegans attract a huge number of rats to use for their next mission. These rats are implanted with Vegatron bombs for the purpose of blowing up different targets in Tokyo.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E61 - Pegasus
1.plot: Toko 1, Toko 2, Toko 3, and Toko 4 are Vegan agents taking appearances of other people trying to distroy Space Science Centre.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E62 - Swans
1.plot: Swans are implanted with Vegatron missiles for the next Vegan plan. Duke Freed is forced to kill the swans and must head to the city and face saucer beast "Go Go".

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E63 - The Polar Bear
1.plot: Kirika, a Vegan scientist, is sent to freeze with her new weapon Duke Fleed.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E64 - 5 Minutes To Die
1.plot: The Vegans invent a bomb and General Gandal threatens to blow up Tokyo is Grendizer does not surrender.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E65 - A Great Between The Greats
1.plot: The Vegans fire a big group of missiles towards Tokyo. The Grendizer Team launches to destroy the missiles before they hit the city.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E67 - Diving Operation
1.plot: General Zuril launches an attack on the Space Science Centre with air balloon bombs. Koji gets caught by the Vegans and held as hostage.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E68 - The Great Pain
1.plot: A young man from Freed named Kane is a loyal soldier of the Vegans. He comes to Earth to fight. Maria tries to face him and they both crash. Soon she will realize that Kane was her childhood friend from Freed.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E68 - The Great Pain
1.plot: A young man from Freed named Kane is a loyal soldier of the Vegans. He comes to Earth to fight. Maria tries to face him and they both crash. Soon she will realize that Kane was her childhood friend from Freed.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E69 - Like Father, Like Son
1.plot: The son of Zouril,Zuril Jr. wants to fight Grendizer but Zouril doesn't want him to. Zuril Jr. sacrifice himself for his father in the end.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E70 - The Imposter
1.plot: Maria has a nightmare about her father being hostage. She goes to the cave where she saw her father in her dream along with Koji where she learns the truth.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E71 - Best Friend
1.plot: Moros, Duke's best friend from Freed was made to believe that Duke Freed destroyed Freed by Vega and now comes to Earth to kill Duke.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E72 - Princess In Love
1.plot: Princess Rubina, Duke Fleed's fiancé comes to Earth to tell Duke that his planet is no longer polluted but dies after being shoot by one of Vega's generals.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E73 - For The Love Of Earth
1.plot: King Vega prepares to attack Earth but Duke and company are ready to stop him with the help of Grendizer and Spazers.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E74 - This Is Not Goodbye
1.plot: Duke finally destroys King Vega but he and Maria must return to planet Fleed.

meta.plot: Vega, Grand Stratéguerre de la planète Stykadès, s'empare d'Euphor, une planète pacifique qu'il va ravager avec sa flotte de soucoupes et de robots géants. Durant l'attaque qui mènera à la destruction finale d'Euphor, la famille royale est exterminée. Actarus, fils du roi et prince, parvient à s'échapper après s'être emparé de Goldorak, le plus perfectionné des robots mis au point par les scientifiques de la planète, et s'enfuit vers la Terre. Il est recueilli par la professeur Procyon qui dirige le Centre de recherches spatiales. Poursuivant sa conquête de nouvelles planètes, Vega établit une base sur la face cachée de la Lune, à partir de laquelle il compte lancer l'offensive sur la planète bleue. Actarus se voit alors dans l'obligation d'utiliser Goldorak afin d'éviter que la Terre subisse le même sort que sa planète natale.

1.title: FR - Blood Free (SUB) - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: It is Christmas Eve of 2025. BF showcases their new product. Everyone praises Jayu, the CEO, but the primary industry suffers because of BF. Two other incidents occur on the same day. A stockbreeder falls on Jayu's vehicle...

1.title: FR - Blood Free (SUB) - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Chaewoon becomes Jayu's bodyguard. They attempt to fix the hacking but realize governmental power is needed. Jayu asks Seonu Jae, the prime minister, for help. A BF chief researcher gets in a car accident. Jayu suspects these incidents are related, and Chaewoon finds something suspicious about the hacking.

1.title: FR - Blood Free (SUB) - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: It is suspected that the hacking could have been an inside job. Could the culprit be nearby? Ja Yu digs into Chae Woon's past. She finds out that he was present alongside her during the terrorist attack that involved the president a few years ago.

1.title: FR - Blood Free (SUB) - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Seon U Geun, the chairman of DORSON Group and Seon U Jae's biological father, suggests that Ja Yu sells her cultured meat technology to him. Meanwhile, the hacker is found dead. Ja Yu is suspected of being responsible and she even receives death threats.

1.title: FR - Blood Free (SUB) - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: In a life-and-death situation, Chaewoon is moved to a hidden laboratory in BF's basement.

1.title: FR - Blood Free (SUB) - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Just when Chaewoon thinks he found a lead, he faces with an even bigger tragedy.

1.title: FR - Blood Free (SUB) - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: The police suspect Chaewoon and arrest him. Seonu Jae takes interest in Chaewoon.

meta.plot: After diving down a rabbit hole of tangled leads, a former bodyguard finds himself recruited to protect the CEO of a controversial lab-grown meat company who is also a survivor of the fateful attack that changed his life.

1.title: EN - You and Me - S01E01 - Our 17th Spring
1.plot: Shun is now a Second year High School student, together with his childhood friends Yūta, Yūki, and Kaname. During their break at the rooftop, Kaname wants Yūki to join a club, but turns out to be a bit difficult for them to find him one.

1.title: EN - You and Me - S01E02 - The Day the Tulips Bloomed
1.plot: Shun, waiting for his friends to eat lunch together finds a girl with a scraped knee. He attempted to confront her, but she ran away. While the girl was stunned at the hallway, Shun succeeded in chasing her, and gives her a bandage. The next day, Shun finds a letter that states that he will get cursed.

1.title: EN - You and Me - S01E03 - The Boy With Straw-colored Hair
1.plot: A new student came to Yūki and Kaname's class. His name is Chizuru Tachibana, a half-Japanese student from Germany. He, seated next to Yūki, stated that they were played together when they were kids. However, Yūki doesn't remember him at all.

1.title: EN - You and Me - S01E04 - Noisy Medicine
1.plot: After an evening with his friends, Kaname catches a cold in which was not the worst of his troubles for today.

1.title: EN - You and Me - S01E05 - Sometime During Summer
1.plot: It's the first day of summer. Chizuru decides on inviting some of his friends to go out, but ended up being rejected. Shun decides to invite everyone to the summer festival.

1.title: EN - You and Me - S01E06 - Glasses and Et Cetera
1.plot: At Kaname's house, Shun, and his friends decided to cut Shun's hair. While preparing to study, they then talk about when did Kaname started wearing glasses.

meta.plot: The story revolves around four teens - the good-looking twins Asaba Yuuta and Yuuki, the effeminate Matsuoka Shun, and the class head Tsukahara Kaname - who have known each other since early childhood. While they are not necessarily good or bad friends, they continue to hang out well into high school. The half-Japanese transfer student Tachibana Chizuru joins the circle of friends in this comedy about the everyday life of adolescence.

meta.plot: Wrongfully accused of a crime she didn't commit, 13 year old Guadalupe Santos is sentenced to 30 years in jail, while in jail she gives birth to a baby girl who is taken from her by her older sister Milagros. 15 years later she escapes jail and meets with Daniel Moncada who turns out to be the brother of the man she was accused of killing.

1.title: FR - Supersex - S01E01 - Superpower
1.plot: Porn icon Rocco Siffredi makes a shocking announcement. Even at the top of his career, demons dating back to his childhood in Italy still haunt him.

1.title: FR - Supersex - S01E02 - The Flesh
1.plot: Young Rocco leaves everything behind to join Tommaso in Paris, starting a journey of self-discovery through the force that rules the world: sex.

1.title: FR - Supersex - S01E03 - The Beast
1.plot: In the '80s, torn between a turbulent career kickoff and an increasingly unstable relationship with Tommaso, Rocco feels a lack of purpose in his life.

1.title: FR - Supersex - S01E04 - The Dream
1.plot: Rocco Siffredi is born. As he navigates his new identity, his old self is still on the back of his mind. Tommaso and Lucia deliver great news.

1.title: FR - Supersex - S01E05 - The Island
1.plot: After a revealing on-set encounter, Rocco realizes that balancing his love life with his career will be harder than he'd expected.

1.title: FR - Supersex - S01E06 - Resurrection of the Bodies
1.plot: As his mother's health deteriorates, Rocco returns home. Lucia prompts him to reconsider his relationships with women. Tommaso continues to spiral.

1.title: FR - Supersex - S01E07 - The Cock Comes Last
1.plot: In Cannes in 1994, Rocco finds a woman to lead his next movie — and she ends up changing his life. A decade later, someone reappears with a proposal.

meta.plot: Inspired by true events, this is the story of how Rocco Siffredi escaped a humble life and emerged as the world's greatest porn star.

1.title: FR - Transformers: Cyberverse - S01E01 - Fractured
1.plot: Windblade arrives on Earth before the Decepticons and meets her old friend Bumblebee who has no idea who she is.

1.title: FR - Transformers: Cyberverse - S01E02 - Memory
1.plot: Realising that Bumblebee’s memory is in bad shape, Windblade must resort to extreme measure to try and help fix her friend.

1.title: FR - Transformers: Cyberverse - S01E03 - AllSpark
1.plot: While searching his memories to understand the Allspark, Bumblebee makes a more important discovery… the memory of his friend Optimus Prime

1.title: FR - Transformers: Cyberverse - S01E04 - The Journey
1.plot: During its journey from Cybertron, the ARK’s Energon supplies run low and the desperate crew is forced to enter stasis.

1.title: FR - Transformers: Cyberverse - S01E05 - Whiteout
1.plot: A mysterious clue from Bumblebee’s memory leads Windblade on a treacherous journey.

1.title: FR - Transformers: Cyberverse - S01E06 - Megatron Is My Hero
1.plot: Windblade tries to make Bee understand who Megatron is.

1.title: FR - Transformers: Cyberverse - S01E07 - Cube
1.plot: Bumblebee learns how he first met Windblade and relives a Golden Age encounter with a young Starscream and his Seekers.
