1.plot: An innocent game of hide-and-seek becomes a race through the city when two thugs kidnap Amy. With the clock running against them, can the Junior Detective League rescue her before it's too late?

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E13 - Mystery Mastermind
1.plot: Richard finds the missing father of a girl named Michelle. Unfortunately, the next day, the father is found murdered and Michelle has vanished. It’s up to Conan to find the girl before it’s too late!

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E14 - The Shooter
1.plot: As Conan’s gang fishes on the riverbank, they witness a most unusual sight. Can they convince Inspector Meguire and Richard of its importance before it’s too late?

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E15 - The Two Faced Brother
1.plot: When Conan has to deal with a disappearing body, an oddly similar pair of brothers, and a jaded law enforcement system, everything is helter-skelter!

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E16 - A Loan Repaid
1.plot: What starts out as a lazy day soon takes an exciting turn when an antique collector meets his end by the edge of an ancient sword. Can Conan cut through all the confusion?

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E17 - The Case of the Hi-Jacked Department Store
1.plot: When Conan and his pals find themselves locked in a department store, they stumble right into the hands of a vicious ring of burglars. Will anyone come to their rescue?

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E18 - Wedding Day Blues
1.plot: While Conan suffers through the wedding of a former teacher, someone is plotting to poison the bride’s favorite drink! What diabolical mind is behind this act of evil?

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E19 - Fashion Sense
1.plot: What began as an enjoyable day for Conan, Richard, and Rachel, who is being interviewed for a potential job as a fashion model, soon turns toxic. A beautiful young lady has been found dead!

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E20 - The Disappearing Act
1.plot: Conan, George, Mitch, and Amy explore a haunted house. With strange noises and mysterious screams around every corner, what they find is more bizarre than any ghost ever imagined.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E21 - Lights, Camera... Murder
1.plot: When a crewmember is killed, a movie set becomes a crime scene! Everyone involved in the movie is labeled a suspect, but who could be capable of such a horrendous deed?

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E22 - Smooth Sailing (1)
1.plot: Conan, Richard, and Rachel attempt to relax aboard a cruise ship, but the gang soon ends up being cast into the middle of a dangerous family drama. Can Conan find the killer before he takes out the entire family?

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E23 - Smooth Sailing (2)
1.plot: Lucas becomes the next victim on the voyage, and it’s revealed that Theodore’s escape from his makeshift cell was only possible with an accomplice. Amid two-timing and back-stabbing, Conan’s on the case.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E24 - Better Off Forgotten
1.plot: During Richard’s day at the track, he must dodge a revenge-driven ex-con and help a beautiful woman recover her memories.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E25 - The Counterfeit Ransom Kidnapping
1.plot: A dramatic car chase leaves two people dead - or does it? What does a diving watch, a sun tan, and five million dollars add up to? Just another puzzling case for Conan.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E26 - Jack Attacks!
1.plot: A dog named Jack kills a college student, shocking the dog’s owner and Conan as well! Conan’s known the pooch forever, and if he doesn’t get to the bottom of the attack, Jack will be put to sleep!

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E27 - Richard's Class Reunion (1)
1.plot: Conan and Rachel join Richard for the 15-year reunion of Moore’s state-winning Judo team. But when the knock-out Jamie Hummelford turns up dead in her room, reminiscing will have to wait.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E28 - Richard's Class Reunion (2)
1.plot: Richard’s class reunion continues, and the killer is still among them. Can Conan apprehend him in time? Everyone’s a suspect in this exciting episode of Case Closed!

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E29 - The Computer Murder
1.plot: A chance meeting with a corporate executive lands Conan in the middle of a murder investigation. A curious cat, a suspicious limo driver, and pile of melted chocolates have Conan wondering who the killer is.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E30 - The Missing Melody
1.plot: When an attorney’s wife is murdered under strange circumstances, Conan steps in to make sense of it all. A music box, a telephone call, and a staple all point to a killer no one would expect.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E31 - Murder at the Television Studio
1.plot: Richard Moore stars on the popular television show Prime Time Mystery Hour, and while Conan and Rachel enjoy the broadcast from the audience, a vicious murder takes place at the studio.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E32 - Murder at the Local Diner
1.plot: Rachel has a date and Conan is determined to find out who this guy is. But when a brutal murder takes place at the diner he’s in, Conan steps into his detective shoes to solve the case.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E33 - A Hunting We Will Go
1.plot: A treasure hunt turns scary for the Junior Detective League. They’re lost in the wild, miles from civilization, and two suspicious-looking men are sneaking around!

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E34 - Mountain Villa Murder (1)
1.plot: When Rachel is invited to a friend’s villa, it seems like an ideal get-away from the city. But when one of the guests is murdered, the holiday turns into a nightmare - and Rachel’s the killer’s next target!

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E35 - Mountain Villa Murder (2)
1.plot: A group of Rachel’s old friends seek to defend themselves against a deadly axe-murderer. But is the assailant really stalking them from outside of the villa - or is he lurking within?

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E36 - Wrong Place at the Wrong Time
1.plot: When a real estate agent is murdered in his condo, the police suspect a well-known dentist in town. Will Conan’s investigation vindicate the beautiful dentist or debunk her perfect alibi?

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E37 - Prickly Past
1.plot: When a pretty girl hires Detective Moore to help her find an old flame, Conan finds out that the man she is looking for was responsible for the death of her fiancé!

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E38 - Flames of Confusion
1.plot: When a body is discovered in a bonfire, Moore finds out that the victim is the same man he’s been tailing for the past three days! Can Conan crack the case before the prime suspect leaves the country?

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E39 - Billionaire Birthday Blues (1)
1.plot: A billionaire hosts a birthday gala for his daughter Reika and Detective Moore is the celebrity guest of honor. But when one of Reika’s suitors turns up dead, the remaining guests are suspects for murder.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E40 - Billionaire Birthday Blues (2)
1.plot: When a beautiful heiress is murdered on her birthday, Conan springs into action to solve the baffling crime. The stakes are soon raised, as Rachel becomes a target for the assassin’s sinister game.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E41 - Left in Tatters
1.plot: A baseball game is interrupted when the School Chairman reveals that someone has slashed the cherished Championship Flag! Scandal rocks Shore View High as Conan investigates.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E42 - Karaoke Killing
1.plot: Rachel and Serena find themselves in a Karaoke Bar with the hottest band in the land! It seems like a dream come true until the brash lead singer - Justin Moon - is poisoned right in front of their eyes.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E43 - Conan Is Kidnapped
1.plot: A lady who claims to be Conan’s mother might really be a spy working for the organization that poisoned him! Can Conan escape from her murderous intentions and find an antidote for the poison?

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E44 - Unhappy Birthday
1.plot: A lazy drive through Chiyoda mountain, Tokyo, lands Kogoro, Ran, and Conan in the middle of a murder mystery surrounding the death of billionaire industrialist, Kosaku Hotta. As Conan tries to unravel the clues before the killer can strike again, he faces one disturbing reality. The prime suspects are the victim's children. It's an explosive whodunit you won't want to miss.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E45 - Unexpected Visitors
1.plot: Another day, another case as Kogoro stumbles upon the death of the President of a popular apparel company. Just why would the President be wearing an unflattering facial mask if she had been expecting company? It's just one of the many perplexing elements of a most unusual case.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E46 - A Game of Murder
1.plot: Conan and the gang's ski-trip turns deadly when a medical professor is murdered right under their noses. A secret message left by the victim points to one of his students as being the killer. However, unraveling the secret proves one of the greatest challenges the pint-sized sleuth has ever faced.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E47 - The Last Dive
1.plot: The bitter rivalry between two world-class high divers boils over as the reigning champion is found dead. Due to the nature of the injuries and eye witness testimony, it seems as if this death was nothing more than a tragic accident. But nothing is ever as it seems as the brilliant mind of Conan soon reveals.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E48 - No Immunity for the Diplomat (1)
1.plot: Conan, Richard and Rachel are joined by Harley Hartwell, a teen detective from the west coast, in solving the sealed room murder of a diplomat.

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E49 - No Immunity for the Diplomat (2)
1.plot: Jimmy Kudo returns to the surprise of everyone, especially himself! As Jimmy tries to expose the real secret behind the perfectly sealed room, the rivalry between he and Harley Hartwell heats up!

1.title: FR - Case Closed - S01E50 - The Book Without Pages
1.plot: A routine afternoon at the library turns into the hunt for a corpse after an attendant turns up missing. When Conan and the Detective Boys try to solve the mystery by staying after-hours, they find themselves trapped, in the dark, and not alone. Will they catch the killer before he catches them?

meta.plot: The son of a world famous mystery writer, Jimmy Kudo, has achieved his own notoriety by assisting the local police as a student detective. He has always been able to solve the most difficult of criminal cases using his wits and power of reason.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E01 - The Duel
1.plot: A wandering stranger with a mysterious past defends a village from powerful bandits.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E02 - Tatooine Rhapsody
1.plot: A band with big dreams must save one of their own from Jabba the Hutt and Boba Fett.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E03 - The Twins
1.plot: Twins born into the dark side clash aboard a massive Star Destroyer.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E04 - The Village Bride
1.plot: A Jedi on the run takes in the unique customs of a remote village under threat by a warlord.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E05 - The Ninth Jedi
1.plot: The daughter of a lightsaber-smith is pursued by dark forces while on a dangerous mission.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E06 - T0-B1
1.plot: A cybernetic boy, who dreams of being a Jedi, discovers a dangerous truth about his creator.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E07 - The Elder
1.plot: A Jedi and his Padawan pursue a dark and powerful presence.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E08 - Lop & Ochō
1.plot: A family is torn about what to do when the Empire encroaches on their planet.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E09 - Akakiri
1.plot: A Jedi returns to his forbidden love to help defend her kingdom from a Sith-like Shogun.

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E01 - Sith
2.plot: A former Sith apprentice, leading a peaceful, but isolated life, is confronted by the past when her old master tracks her down.

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E02 - Screecher's Reach
2.plot: A young girl, seeking reprieve from her days in a rural workhouse, discovers a legendary haunted cave with her friends. The cave’s dark pull will change the trajectory of her life forever.

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E03 - In the Stars
2.plot: Two sisters, the last of their kind who live in hiding on their ravaged land, squabble about how to survive with the Empire encroaching. On a water run, the sisters must fight back when they are discovered.

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E04 - I Am Your Mother
2.plot: Young pilot Anni, who is embarrassed by her sweet, but clingy mum, must team with her for a madcap family race at the academy. Along the way, their relationship is tested by the elements, their old ship, other racers...and each other!

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E05 - Journey to the Dark Head
2.plot: A hopeful mechanic and disillusioned young Jedi team up for a risky and unlikely quest to turn the tide of the galactic war, but dark forces tail them.

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E06 - The Spy Dancer
2.plot: The premier dancer at a famous, Imperial-frequented cabaret uses her unique skill-set to spy for the Rebellion, but the presence of a mysterious officer threatens to derail her mission.

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E07 - The Bandits of Golak
2.plot: Fleeing from their village by train and pursued by ferocious Imperial forces, a boy and his force-sensitive younger sister seek refuge in a vibrant and dangerous dhaba.

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E08 - The Pit
2.plot: A fearless young prisoner, forced to dig for kyber by the Empire, plans a risky escape for he and his people.

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E09 - Aau's Song
2.plot: An alien child who longs to sing is raised by her loving, but stern father to stay quiet because of the calamitous effect her voice has on the crystals in the nearby mines.

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E01 - The Bounty Hunter
3.plot: A rogue bounty hunter takes on a job for a shady industrialist that has unexpected consequences for her and her droid.

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E02 - The Duel: Payback
3.plot: With the help of some unexpected allies, Ronin faces off against his greatest foe – a twisted Jedi known as the Grand Master who is bent on revenge

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E03 - The Song of Four Wings
3.plot: A princess-turned-rebel protects a child from the might of the Empire on a snowbound planet.

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E04 - The Ninth Jedi: Child of Hope
3.plot: Pursued by Jedi Hunters, and blasted adrift into space, Kara encounters a seemingly abandoned ship tended to by a mysterious droid.

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E05 - The Smuggler
3.plot: A smuggler, desperate for a quick payday, agrees to take on a job to bring a wanted young prince to safety as the Empire pursues.

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E06 - Yuko's Treasure
3.plot: A sheltered orphan teams with a street rat kid to rescue his droid caregiver and find a long lost treasure.

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E07 - The Bird of Paradise
3.plot: After she is blinded in battle, a hot headed Jedi padawan must undergo a series of spiritual trials in order to overcome the temptation of the Dark Side.

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E08 - The Lost Ones
3.plot: After assisting refugees escape a natural disaster, an incognito F is forced to confront the ghosts of her past when their refugee ship is intercepted by the Empire.

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E09 - BLACK
3.plot: A psychedelic battle between past and present, light and dark, and life and death plays out in the haunted psyche of an Imperial trooper who is on the cusp of defeat.

meta.plot: This anthology of animated shorts from around the world celebrates the myth of Star Wars through unique cultural lenses.

1.title: FR - The Chosen - S01E01 - I Have Called You by Name
1.plot: Two brothers struggle with their tax debts to Rome while a woman in the Red Quarter wrestles with her demons.

1.title: FR - The Chosen - S01E02 - Shabbat
1.plot: Matthew validates Simon's claims with Praetor Quintus, Nicodemus investigates the miracle reported in the Red Quarter, and Mary receives surprise guests at her Shabbat dinner.

1.title: FR - The Chosen - S01E03 - Jesus Loves the Little Children
1.plot: Jesus befriends and teaches the group of children who discover His camp on the outskirts of Capernaum.

1.title: FR - The Chosen - S01E04 - The Rock on Which it is Built
1.plot: With his life and family under threat from Rome, Simon spends one last night fishing in a desperate attempt to square his debts. Andrew spots a familiar face waiting for them on the shores of Galilee.

1.title: FR - The Chosen - S01E05 - The Wedding Gift
1.plot: Nicodemus interrogates John the Baptizer while Jesus and his students make their way to a wedding celebration in Cana. When the wine runs low, Mary asks her son to intervene on behalf of the bridegroom's family.

1.title: FR - The Chosen - S01E06 - Indescribable Compassion
1.plot: After witnessing the healing of a leper on the road to Capernaum, a woman forces her paralytic friend through the crowd to meet Jesus.

1.title: FR - The Chosen - S01E07 - Invitations
1.plot: Matthew struggles to reconcile the miracles he has witnessed with reality. Nicodemus meets with Jesus by night.

1.title: FR - The Chosen - S01E08 - I Am He
1.plot: Jesus and His students complete their preparations and leave Capernaum for Samaria. Jesus meets with a suffering woman at Jacob's Well and announces that He is the Messiah.

2.title: FR - The Chosen - S02E01 - Thunder
2.plot: Tension builds among the disciples as they wrestle with the increasing fame of Jesus in Samaria. Jesus rebukes Big James and John for their prejudice and, after a near-violent encounter, gives them a new nickname.

2.title: FR - The Chosen - S02E02 - I Saw You
2.plot: A mysterious visitor seeks to meet Jesus, but the disciples are hesitant. Tension builds between Simon and Matthew. As the group heads to a new city, word arrives that Jesus’ fame is growing.

2.title: FR - The Chosen - S02E03 - Matthew 4:24
2.plot: A long, exhausting day turns into night as the disciples help Jesus deal with a large crowd hoping to be healed. Around the campfire, over dinner, the group tried to get to know each other better. But tensions erupt.

2.title: FR - The Chosen - S02E04 - The Perfect Opportunity
2.plot: As Jesus and the disciples head to Jerusalem to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles, a new enemy follows them, while a familiar enemy awaits.

2.title: FR - The Chosen - S02E05 - Spirit
2.plot: After stirring the water, Jesus is now pursued by Simon the Zealot, Atticus, and Shmuel. John the Baptizer visits the group and tells Jesus his dangerous mission. Meanwhile, back at the camp, Mary Magdalene is devastated by an encounter with a mysterious and dangerous stranger.

2.title: FR - The Chosen - S02E06 - Unlawful
2.plot: Matthew and Simon try to get along as they search for Mary in dark places. The group fears for Mary as they struggle with lack of food and bad news about John the Baptist. Meanwhile, Jesus continues to upset Pharisees across multiple regions.

2.title: FR - The Chosen - S02E07 - Reckoning
2.plot: After learning of Jesus' whereabouts, Quintus sends Gaius to arrest him. The disciples lose control as they argue about how to respond. While seeking information about where Jesus has been taken, Andrew and Philip encounter old friends.

2.title: FR - The Chosen - S02E08 - Beyond Mountains
2.plot: While Jesus and Matthew prepare the content of the big sermon, the disciples spread the word while fighting amongst themselves. A high-ranking Sanhedrin member is shocked by Shmuel’s reports on Jesus. Thousands arrive for the sermon, including familiar faces.

3.title: FR - The Chosen - S03E01 - Homecoming
3.plot: Jesus delivers the most life-altering sermon in history. The result? More followers, more enemies, and disciples ready to follow Jesus anywhere. Simon and Eden reunite, Matthew faces his past, and Andrew visits John the Baptist in prison.

3.title: FR - The Chosen - S03E02 - Two by Two
3.plot: Jesus is a problem for the Romans. With pilgrims from everywhere setting up a tent city at the gates of Capernaum to see Jesus, tensions rise. Jesus officially sends the twelve apostles on an exciting but dangerous mission, causing Little James to ask why he hasn’t been healed.

3.title: FR - The Chosen - S03E03 - Physician, Heal Yourself
3.plot: Jesus returns to his childhood home for the big Jewish new year celebration. His childhood friends and family are all buzzing with what they’ve heard about Jesus…until he tells them the truth of who He is.

3.title: FR - The Chosen - S03E04 - Clean, Part 1
3.plot: Two by two, the disciples carry out Jesus’ mission to heal, cast out demons, and preach his  words. But upon returning, they struggle with understanding what happened while Simon and  Eden struggle to reconnect.

3.title: FR - The Chosen - S03E05 - Clean, Part 2
3.plot: As tensions mount at home, Simon and Gaius work together to fix the water problem in Capernaum. Meanwhile, Jairus and Veronica are equally desperate to find Jesus as the only hope for their crises.

3.title: FR - The Chosen - S03E06 - Intensity in Tent City
3.plot: Andrew and Philip discover their previous mission resulted in devastation that will require a return. Simon Z is finally forced to confront his past, but then two disciples of John the Baptist come to Capernaum with an important question for Jesus.

3.title: FR - The Chosen - S03E07 - Ears to Hear
3.plot: "Having ears to hear." Jesus leads the disciples into a dangerous region, where they will face a crowd armed with sharp tongues and dull ears… but even his closest followers are finding it very hard to hear.

3.title: FR - The Chosen - S03E08 - Sustenance
3.plot: Thousands arrive to first argue with, then listen to Jesus as he preaches. Shmuel and Atticus hear what’s happening and journey towards the Decapolis to catch Jesus in the act of a possible revolt. Meanwhile, as the preaching extends to the next day, the disciples realize they have a significant problem: the thousands are hungry, and there’s no food.

4.title: FR - The Chosen - S04E01 - Promises
4.plot: An intoxicating dance leads Herod to put an end to John the Baptizer, but no one can stop what-or Who-he's ushered in.

4.title: FR - The Chosen - S04E02 - Confessions
4.plot: Jesus founds his church on unholy ground and Simon goes public with Jesus' true identity, getting a new name in the process. But can the new "Peter" forgive old wrongs?

4.title: FR - The Chosen - S04E03 - Moon to Blood
4.plot: When Jesus heals a blind man on the Sabbath, religious leaders confront him, drawing a riotous crowd. Gaius defies a direct order leading Quintus to take matters—and someone’s life—into his own hands.

4.title: FR - The Chosen - S04E04 - Calm Before
4.plot: Beginning with a funeral procession, time marches rapidly toward the final days of Jesus’ ministry. While the disciples seek status for themselves, a Roman ruler comes with a humble request.

4.title: FR - The Chosen - S04E05 - Sitting, Serving, Scheming
4.plot: Roman soldiers demand the disciples carry their armor, but Jesus goes one step farther. Frustrated by the direction of Jesus’ ministry, Judas visits an old friend for advice.

4.title: FR - The Chosen - S04E06 - Dedication
4.plot: Jesus and the disciples celebrate Hanukkah. Matthew confronts Judas about irregularities, and the festival turns into a fight, then flight. The disciples escape with their lives, but learn a friend hasn’t been so lucky.

4.title: FR - The Chosen - S04E07 - The Last Sign
4.plot: Jesus brings Lazarus back to life—and sets off the chain of events that will lead to His own death.

4.title: FR - The Chosen - S04E08 - Humble
4.plot: Jesus refuses to look and act like the Messiah everyone expects—arriving like a lamb instead of a lion and riding a donkey instead of a war horse.

5.title: FR - The Chosen - S05E01 - Entry
5.plot: Jesus rides into the holy city as king, but finds that the rulers have turned His Father’s house from a place of prayer to a corrupt market.

5.title: FR - The Chosen - S05E02 - House of Cards
5.plot: Why kill Jesus when Rome can do it for you? As the Jewish High Priest schemes to bring Him down, Jesus strikes first: turning the tables.

5.title: FR - The Chosen - S05E03 - Woes
5.plot: Jesus preaches one last time to the massive Passover crowd, and the religious leaders try to trap him in his words.

5.title: FR - The Chosen - S05E04 - The Same Coin
5.plot: Afraid of public outcry—and further embarrassment—Caiaphas resolves to arrest Jesus quietly at night. Only one problem: no one knows how to find Him.

5.title: FR - The Chosen - S05E05 - Because of Me
5.plot: The decision to arrest Jesus leads to a fiery debate. Roman soldiers track down a troublemaking crowd. Shmuel finds help from an unexpected source.

5.title: FR - The Chosen - S05E06 - Reunions
5.plot: As Jesus’ followers gather for the Passover meal, His enemies assemble for a man hunt. Judas holds a secret meeting.

5.title: FR - The Chosen - S05E07 - The Upper Room (1)
5.plot: Jesus arrives at the Last Supper. The disciples fear for their safety as Jesus’ enemies close ranks around them.

5.title: FR - The Chosen - S05E08 - The Upper Room (2)
5.plot: Pilate summons Atticus to read him the riot act. The Sanhedrin boils over. The Last Supper ends.

meta.plot: The life of Christ through the eyes of those who encountered him called The Chosen.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E01 - WHAT'S YOUR NAME?
1.plot: Bounty hunter Chateau runs into an assassin named Ryang-ha Song while on a job. After their meeting, he ends up giving her information on other bounties. One day, a different job comes in and Ryang-ha ends up being the target.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E02 - TARGET
1.plot: Despite knowing that her boss is beginning to suspect that she might be in contact with Ryang-ha, Chateau goes on to carry out a hit that he had tipped her off to.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E03 - ROOM
1.plot: Chateau wakes up in a motel after being helped out of a pinch by Ryang-ha. She passes on to him the warning that Hou had given for the "traitor." What was his crime five years ago?

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E04 - REAL FACE
1.plot: Chateau goes to church on the anniversary of her father's death. She runs into Ryang-ha, who is his usual self, before they are met by an attacker. Meanwhile, Chateau's boss is meeting with her mother to try to understand her past.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E05 - LIMIT
1.plot: Chateau is being held hostage in a car filled with explosives, and so Ryang-ha confronts Hou. This is Chateau and Ryang-ha's most dangerous situation yet.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E06 - DARK DREAM
1.plot: Chateau boards a luxury cruise ship for a mission. There, she runs into Ryang-ha, who makes things difficult for her once again. They spend a night in a room together, in part so that Chateau can keep an eye on him.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E07 - BULLET
1.plot: Chateau tries to determine Euripedes' whereabouts, but is bothered by Ryang-ha's suspicious behavior. He lets a mysterious attacker escape, and when he meets with Chateau, she pulls out a gun.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E08 - CONFUSION
1.plot: Chateau leaves herself with Jinon and his associate, Nikka, in order to carry out her operation. Meanwhile, both the boss and Jim are put in danger.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E09 - A WAR TRIGGER
1.plot: Ryang-Ha confronts Donny, who had brought him here with some unresolved business. Meanwhile, Chateau makes a commitment to finding Ryang-Ha.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E10 - HELP
1.plot: With some help, Ryang-Ha and Chateau hide out in a tent under a bridge. Chateau is concerned about Ryang-Ha's wounds. They pretend to be married in order to hide their identities.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E11 - WORST
1.plot: 17 years ago. Ryang-Ha was assisting Donny, when he takes in a boy who was being chased. A job Donny gives him leads him to another fateful encounter.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E12 - MY NAME
1.plot: Two "Ryang-Has" survive desperately with a young Chateau. But Ryang-Ha is cornered by his enemies, and the other Ryang-Ha, too, is severely injured.

meta.plot: Two assassins face off at a certain "workplace." The cool bounty hunter Chateau and the mysterious and powerful Ryang-Ha. Chateau and Ryang-Ha become enemies after this fight—at least, they should have, but for some reason Ryang-Ha takes a liking to Chateau and begins following her around. Little by little, Chateau develops a cooperative partnership with Ryang-Ha, which gets her caught up in the struggle against the organizations hunting him down. Furthermore, that battle is related to her past as well. Why did Ryang-Ha approach Chateau? What is Chateau's secret past?

1.title: FR - Skull Island - S01E01 - Maritime Pilot
1.plot: A mysterious castaway appears while Charlie, Mike and their dads search the ocean for mythical creatures, throwing all their plans into chaos.

1.title: FR - Skull Island - S01E02 - The Last Blank Space on the Map
1.plot: As they adjust to wild new surroundings, Mike and Charlie realize that getting to shore was the easy part. Cap encounters another explorer.

1.title: FR - Skull Island - S01E03 - What's Up, Croc?
1.plot: On the run from a terrifying predator, the boys glimpse an unbelievable sight. Irene leads her team deeper into the island. Mike makes a confession.

1.title: FR - Skull Island - S01E04 - Breakfast Fit for a Kong
1.plot: Annie and Dog stage a subterranean rescue operation. Irene gets better acquainted with the island's wildlife. Cap explains an intriguing theory.

1.title: FR - Skull Island - S01E05 - Doggone It
1.plot: A risky plan pays off, leading to a reunion — and new revelations. Stuck in a precarious situation, Charlie and Dog form an uneasy alliance.

1.title: FR - Skull Island - S01E06 - Terms of Endearment
1.plot: Mike's injury catches up with him, while Annie and Irene unpack their complicated histories. Dog and Charlie's journey across the island continues.

1.title: FR - Skull Island - S01E07 - You're Not a King, You're Just a Stupid Animal
1.plot: Years in the past, Kong roams the island with a beloved human friend. But when his temper gets the better of him, the consequences could be dire.

1.title: FR - Skull Island - S01E08 - You'll Never Catch a Monkey That Way
1.plot: Charlie proposes a daring plan to defeat the sea monster and save Mike's life. But it will take all his courage — and Kong's strength — to pull it off.

meta.plot: Shipwrecked in the South Pacific, a group of explorers encounter a menagerie of fearsome creatures — including the giant ape who rules the island: Kong.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures - S01E01 - The Young Jedi
1.plot: Jedi younglings Kai, Lys and Nubs go on their first adventure.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures - S01E02 - Yoda’s Mission
1.plot: Yoda gives the younglings a mission.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures - S01E03 - Nash's Race Day
1.plot: Nash’s Jedi friends help her compete in a race.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures - S01E04 - The Lost Jedi Ship
1.plot: The young Jedi find a long-lost Jedi ship.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures - S01E05 - Get Well Nubs
1.plot: Kai and Lys seek out a cure for Nubs’ illness

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures - S01E06 - The Junk Giant
1.plot: The young Jedi set out to catch a thief.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures - S01E07 - Lys and The Snowy Mountain Rescue
1.plot: The younglings help wrangle creatures.

meta.plot: Set during the High Republic era and the prime of the Jedi Order, follow Jedi younglings as they study the ways of the Force, explore the galaxy, help citizens and creatures in need, and learn valuable skills needed to become Jedi along the way.

1.title: FR - À l'école du chocolat - S01E01 - Breaking Molds and Bending Chocolate
1.plot: The chefs create edible illusions, including a planter box with earthy flavors, then form teams to bend chocolate into architectural shapes.

1.title: FR - À l'école du chocolat - S01E02 - Dessert Deception
1.plot: From a coconut cake croque madame to a taco packed with chocolate popcorn, deceiving desserts fool the senses. The chefs learn to polish chocolate.

1.title: FR - À l'école du chocolat - S01E03 - Make It Ooze
1.plot: A tense class vote follows a near disaster with a towering chocolate showpiece. Later, Amaury Guichon assigns an exercise with oozing elements.

1.title: FR - À l'école du chocolat - S01E04 - Chocolate Hanging by a Thread
1.plot: After a controversial win in the pastry round, the students break into teams of two for a gravity-defying chocolate showpiece challenge.

1.title: FR - À l'école du chocolat - S01E05 - Bittersweet Surprises
1.plot: A pastry challenge divides the class in two after Amaury shows his pupils how to form exquisite flower petals and a functional chocolate hinge.

1.title: FR - À l'école du chocolat - S01E06 - Flying Chocolate
1.plot: When teams push their skills to new heights to craft kid-friendly showpieces, unfamiliar tools send chocolate flying — and stress skyrocketing.

1.title: FR - À l'école du chocolat - S01E07 - Give Me Some Sugar
1.plot: Amaury creates a mind-blowing sugar dome with plastic wrap, a bucket and trapped air. Can the chefs use the technique for their own winning sweets?

1.title: FR - À l'école du chocolat - S01E08 - The Best in Class Is...
1.plot: The top two go head-to-head to build the biggest chocolate showpiece yet. The final assignment? Deliver A+ work on a prehistoric theme.

meta.plot: Coachés par un célèbre chocolatier, huit professionnels étudient l'art du chocolat. Un seul sera désigné "premier de la classe" et se verra offrir une opportunité unique.

1.title: FR - Hollywood et la reine de l’arnaque [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Crazy, Mad, Crazy, Genius
1.plot: The Con Queen lures victims to Indonesia to work on fictitious film projects. Scott, a journalist, and Nicole, a private investigator, take on the case.

1.title: FR - Hollywood et la reine de l’arnaque [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - A Different Animal
1.plot: In a bizarre twist, the Con Queen finds unexpected success in London. With new leads in hand, Scott travels the globe to hunt them down.

1.title: FR - Hollywood et la reine de l’arnaque [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Thank You for the Story
1.plot: After finding the Con Queen in Manchester, Scott sets out to learn about their past and motives before law enforcement closes in.

meta.plot: Un personnage mystérieux, connu sous le nom de la Reine de l'Arnaque, se fait passer pour de puissantes dirigeantes d'Hollywood, attirant ses victimes par des promesses d'opportunités de carrières qui changeraient leur vie. Un journaliste et une enquêtrice privée entreprennent de découvrir l'auteur de cette arnaque.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: When he's hired at Acapulco's hottest resort, Maximo thinks he's scored his dream job—but quickly learns there's more to it than he thought.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E02 - Jessie's Girl
1.plot: Maximo strives to master the art of the upsell while attempting to help a wealthy young man propose to his girlfriend.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E03 - Invisible Touch
1.plot: Don Pablo teaches Maximo how to become an elite waiter so he can work an important dinner. Julia tries to impress a fashion editor.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E04 - Crazy Little Thing Called Love
1.plot: A pop superstar staying at the resort takes an interest in Julia, which concerns Maximo. Nora goes on her first date in a long time.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E05 - All Night Long
1.plot: Maximo and Chad go on an all-night journey outside the resort, while the staff must come together for a never-ending wedding reception.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E06 - Uptown Girl
1.plot: Maximo has a magical dream date with an American tourist. Memo bonds with his coworkers over a soccer match.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E07 - For Your Eyes Only
1.plot: When he learns that an eye doctor is staying at the resort, Maximo sneaks Nora in for the day. Diane discovers problems with the hotel.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E08 - Time After Time
1.plot: As Diane shows a group of journalists a photo exhibit of Las Colinas' history, the story of Don Pablo's long tenure at the resort is revealed.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E09 - The Most Wonderful Time of the Year
1.plot: Chaos erupts at the Christmas staff dinner when Maximo and Memo's plans backfire. Julia pieces together the truth behind her birthday gift.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E10 - You Should Hear How She Talks About You
1.plot: Las Colinas hosts a big New Year's Eve bash. Maximo tries to dazzle Diane so he'll earn a promotion. Chad makes a bold gesture.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E01 - Break My Stride
2.plot: Maximo is determined to start the new year with a clean slate. Julia struggles with Chad's surprise proposal.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E02 - Hit Me With Your Best Shot
2.plot: Desperate to pay off his family's debt, Maximo seizes an opportunity to wait on rival tennis stars. Diane tries to derail Julia and Chad's nuptials.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E03 - Glory Days
2.plot: Maximo gets swept up in a busy night with Isabel‘s family. Chad's fraternity brothers surprise him.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E04 - Love Is a Battlefield
2.plot: On Valentine‘s Day, Maximo and Julia have to decorate a romantic suite together. Memo and Lorena beg Lupe to let them spend time alone.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E05 - We Don't Need Another Hero
2.plot: Maximo takes Memo to a club to find his favorite soccer star. Sara spends an eventful night at Las Colinas.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E06 - Hollywood Nights
2.plot: Diane‘s past catches up with her as Las Colinas hosts the wrap party for a big Hollywood movie. Maximo faces a moral dilemma.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E07 - Always Something There to Remind Me
2.plot: Chaos ensues on the night of Chad and Julia's joint bachelor and bachelorette party.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E08 - Money Changes Everything
2.plot: Maximo is tasked with taking care of a billionaire investor. Chad and Julia discover a secret about Diane.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E09 - The Power of Love
2.plot: Maximo doubles down on his new life with Isabel. Sara receives a potentially life-changing offer.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E10 - Against All Odds
2.plot: Maximo gets a second chance at Las Colinas. Julia learns to go after what she wants.

3.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S03E01 - Just the Two of Us
3.plot: Maximo learns a hard lesson of how to balance being a manager and friend to the staff at Las Colinas.

3.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S03E02 - Mamma Mia
3.plot: On Mother's Day, Maximo wrestles with an opportunity to get closer to Diane despite his promise to spend the day with his mom.

3.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S03E03 - Dead Man's Party
3.plot: Don Pablo comes to Maximo with a task that puts his training to the test. Julia faces a tough decision over whether to be honest with Nora.

meta.plot: In 1984, Maximo Gallardo's dream comes true when he gets the job of a lifetime at Acapulco's hottest resort, Las Colinas. But he soon realizes that working there will be far more complicated than he ever imagined.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E02 - The Naked Now
1.plot: Stardate: 41209.2. The crew of the Enterprise are infected with a virus contracted by the away team while they were investigating  the mysterious deaths of the entire crew of the Starship Tsilkovsky.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E03 - Code of Honor
1.plot: Stardate: 41235.25. Tasha Yar must fight for her life and a vaccine to save a race of people when she is kidnapped and forced to battle with her abductor's wife.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E04 - The Last Outpost
1.plot: Stardate: 41386.4. A powerful entity disables the Enterprise and a Ferengi ship. Their only means of escape is if they can correctly answer the riddles he asks.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E05 - Where No One Has Gone Before
1.plot: Stardate: 41263.1. The Enterprise is flung across space into a distant galaxy billions of light years away when a propulsion engineer and his mysterious companion, attempt to re-design the ship's engine systems.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E06 - Lonely Among Us
1.plot: Stardate: 41249.3. Picard's mind is taken over by an energy field that the Enterprise passes through.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E07 - Justice
1.plot: Stardate: 41255.6. Picard is forced to choose between friendship and the Prime Directive when Wesley Crusher is sentenced to death for accidentally breaking the law on Rubicon III.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E08 - The Battle
1.plot: Stardate: 41723.9. The Ferengi hand over an old ship which Picard once captained, the U.S.S. Stargazer. The Ferengi have installed a mind altering device that alters Picard's mind to make him think that he is reliving a past battle, and the target is the Enterprise.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E09 - Hide and Q
1.plot: Stardate: 41590.5. Q places the senior crew of the Enterprise in a war game that pits them against a boar-faced, Napoleonic enemy.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E10 - Haven
1.plot: Stardate: 41294.6. The mother of Deanna Troi, Lwaxana,  pays a surprise visit to the Enterprise and announces the prearranged marriage of Deanna to the son of her mother's late husband's best friend.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E11 - The Big Goodbye
1.plot: Stardate: 41997.7. Picard, Dr. Crusher and Data are placed in great danger when the holodeck malfunctions while they are running a Dixon Hill program, which pits them against 1940's mobsters.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E12 - Datalore
1.plot: Stardate: 41242.4.  While exploring his homeworld, the crew of the Enterprise find android parts that are identical to Data's. When assembled, an 'evil' twin of Data named Lore is revived.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E13 - Angel One
1.plot: Stardate: 41636.9. The Enterprise discovers the male crew of a crashed Federation freighter are hiding as fugitives on the planet Angel One, which is dominated and ruled by women.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E14 - 11001001
1.plot: Stardate: 41365.9. While undergoing repairs, the Bynar Engineers steal the Enterprise to save their planet from destruction.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E15 - Too Short a Season
1.plot: Stardate: 41309.5. The aging and terminally ill Starfleet Admiral Mark Jameson, who is negotiating the release of hostages, suddenly begins growing younger through an unexplained phenomenon.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E16 - When the Bough Breaks
1.plot: Stardate: 41509.1. The children of the Enterprise, including Wesley Crusher, are abducted by a race of sterile people who are unable to have children of their own.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E17 - Home Soil
1.plot: Stardate: 41463.9. The members of an away team investigating the death of an engineer encounter vengeful microscopic life forms.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E18 - Coming of Age
1.plot: Stardate: 41416.2. While Wesley takes the entrance exam to Starfleet Academy, the Enterprise is investigated by the Inspector General's office and Picard's competency is questioned.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E19 - Heart of Glory
1.plot: Stardate: 41503.7. Two Klingons, rescued by the Enterprise, try to take over the ship.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E20 - The Arsenal of Freedom
1.plot: Stardate: 41798.2. The crew encounters bizarre phenomena while searching for the missing U.S.S. Drake.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E21 - Symbiosis
1.plot: Stardate: Unknown. Picard attempts to break an ancient co-dependency between two species on one planet without violating the Prime Directive.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E22 - Skin of Evil
1.plot: Stardate: 41601.3. When Troi's shuttle crashes on an alien planet, a new being is discovered: an entity that thrives on the suffering of others.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E23 - We'll Always Have Paris
1.plot: Stardate: 41697.9. Picard meets an old flame, whose husband has created a haywire dimensional experiment.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E24 - Conspiracy
1.plot: Stardate: 41775.5. The strange behavior of high-ranking officers leads Picard to uncover a twisted alien conspiracy within Starfleet.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E25 - The Neutral Zone
1.plot: Stardate: 41986.0. A derelict satellite is found with cryonically frozen humans aboard as the USS Enterprise is sent to investigate the destruction of outposts near Romulan space.

1.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S01E26 -

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E01 - The Child
2.plot: Stardate: 42073.1. Troi undergoes a mysterious pregnancy when the Enterprise tries to escape from a system that has recently fallen victim to a deadly plague.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E02 - Where Silence Has Lease
2.plot: Stardate: 42193.6. A mysterious life form known as the 'Nagilum' threatens the life of the crew in his attempt to understand humanity.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E03 - Elementary, Dear Data
2.plot: Stardate: 42286.3. Data and Geordi become involved with a holodeck program about Sherlock Holmes and his investigations, when they create Sherlock's arch nemesis, Moriarty; however, modifications to the Moriarty character include the capability of out-smarting Data, which leads to some unexpected consequences.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E04 - The Outrageous Okona
2.plot: Stardate: 42402.7. The Enterprise is placed in a compromising situation when the captain of a disabled starship places the crew in the middle of a love triangle.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E05 - Loud as a Whisper
2.plot: Stardate: 42477.2. A deaf-mute mediator meets with disaster while being escorted by the Enterprise.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E06 - The Schizoid Man
2.plot: Stardate: 42437.5. Data is possessed by the consciousness of a brilliant scientist. However, it has a disturbing impact on Data's personality.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E07 - Unnatural Selection
2.plot: Stardate: 42494.8. A mysterious hyper-ageing sickness kills the crew of a Federation cargo ship, and Dr. Pulaski must race against time to find a cure.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E08 - A Matter of Honor
2.plot: Commander Riker participates in an officer's exchange program which lands him an assignment on a Klingon Bird-of-Prey.  Meanwhile, a Bezite ensign has trouble assimilating to the routines of the Enterprise.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E09 - The Measure of a Man
2.plot: Stardate: 42523.7. When Data's rights as a sentient individual are placed under trial, Starfleet forces Riker into a position where he must prove that Data is only an Android.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E10 - The Dauphin
2.plot: Stardate: 42568.8. Wesley falls in love with a passenger the Enterprise is escorting, who has the secret ability to shape-shift.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E11 - Contagion
2.plot: Stardate: 42609.1. A strange power source disables the Enterprise's computer systems, damages Data's programming and leaves the ship and crew vulnerable to a Romulan attack.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E12 - The Royale
2.plot: Stardate: 42625.4. An away team is trapped in an alien environment based around a novel entitled 'The Hotel Royale.'

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E13 - Time Squared
2.plot: Stardate: 42679.2. Picard encounters his double from six hours in the future, whose Enterprise had been destroyed.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E14 - The Icarus Factor
2.plot: Stardate: 42686.4. Riker is promoted to Captain of another Federation ship. Worf must confront his past and his Klingon heritage.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E15 - Pen Pals
2.plot: Stardate: 42695.3. Wesley must investigate the causes of strange tectonic activity on the planet where Data's pen pal lives.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E16 - Q Who
2.plot: Stardate: 42761.3. Q hurls the Enterprise into the Delta Quadrant and introduces the Federation to a powerful new enemy that may destroy the Alpha Quadrant: The Borg.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E17 - Samaritan Snare
2.plot: Stardate: 42779.1. A race known as the Pakleds kidnap Geordi La Forge. Picard must face surgery when he is left in a near-dead state.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E18 - Up the Long Ladder
2.plot: Stardate: 42823.2. Picard must convince two dying civilizations that they must co-exist on the same planet to survive, however, they have other plans to ensure their survival: in the form of clones of the Enterprise crew.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E19 - Manhunt
2.plot: Stardate: 42859.2. While being escorted to a Federation conference by the Enterprise, Lwaxana hunts for a man to satisfy her needs when her sex-drive is quadrupled during a natural mid-life cycle.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E20 - The Emissary
2.plot: Stardate: 42901.3. Worf is re-united with his former lover, K'Ehleyr, while the Enterprise is ordered to intercept a Klingon ship whose crew has been in stasis for a century.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E21 - Peak Performance
2.plot: Stardate: 42923.4. Trouble begins when a Ferengi warship stumbles over a war simulation between Riker and Picard, each on different ships, and begins attacking them.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E22 - Shades of Gray
2.plot: Stardate: 42976.1. Riker is infected with an alien organism that takes over his mind. Dr. Pulaski must force Riker's mind back to a state where it can access primitive survival skills.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E01 - Evolution
3.plot: Stardate: 43125.8. A system-wide computer malfunction places the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise in grave danger while they are escorting a scientist to a star in the process of exploding.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E02 - The Ensigns of Command
3.plot: Stardate: 43133.3. A human colony is forced to evacuate a planet when the original inhabitants return and threaten the colonists with annihilation if they do not leave within four days.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E03 - The Survivors
3.plot: Stardate: 43152.4. The Enterprise discovers a planet that has had all life eradicated, except for two mysterious residents and their home, which has been left in perfect condition.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E04 - Who Watches the Watchers
3.plot: Stardate: 43173.5. An away team inadvertently breaks the Prime Directive and reveal themselves to a primitive culture on Mintaka III, causing the inhabitants believe that Captain Picard is a God.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E05 - The Bonding
3.plot: Worf and Wesley must help a 12 year old boy cope with the death of his mother; an archaeologist killed during an away mission to a deserted planet.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E06 - Booby Trap
3.plot: Stardate: 43205.6. While investigating an ancient ship left adrift in space, the Enterprise accidentally trips the ancient booby trap that disabled the old vessel over 1000 years ago.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E07 - The Enemy
3.plot: Stardate:43349.2. A blind Geordie is trapped on a hazardous planet with a paranoid and severely injured Romulan. In orbit, a Romulan Warbird is preventing the Enterprise from attempting a rescue mission.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E08 - The Price
3.plot: Stardate: 43385.6. The Enterprise hosts the negotiations for the rights to a newly discovered, stable wormhole to the Delta Quadrant. One of the negotiators, Devinoni Ral, becomes attracted to Deanna Troi, but he holds a dubious secret.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E09 - The Vengeance Factor
3.plot: Stardate: 43421.9. The Enterprise crew tries to mend the relationship between a race known as the Acamarians and a faction known as the Gatherers.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E10 - The Defector
3.plot: Stardate: 43462.5. A defecting Romulan warns the Federation about an impending attack by the Romulans, who are secretly establishing bases within the Neutral Zone.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E11 - The Hunted
3.plot: Stardate: 43489.2. A potentially new member of the Federation enlists the help of the Enterprise to track down a wanted criminal who has a reputation for his excessive violence. However, the fugitive's actions may not be of his own will.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E12 - The High Ground
3.plot: Stardate: 43510.7. Dr. Crusher is abducted by a group of terrorists while delivering crucial medical supplies to a planet ravaged by civil war.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E13 - Déjà Q
3.plot: Stardate: 43539.1. A Calamarian starts attacking the Enterprise while seeking revenge on a powerless Q.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E14 - A Matter of Perspective
3.plot: Stardate: 43610.4. Riker is accused of murder when a scientist is killed in an explosion. Picard must recreate the recent events in the holodeck to prove his commander's innocence.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E15 - Yesterday's Enterprise
3.plot: Stardate: 43625.2. A rift in the space/time continuum brings the U.S.S. Enterprise - C forward into the 24th Century, and alters the timeline. In this future, the Federation is at war with the Klingons, Tasha Yar is on the bridge, Worf did not join the Federation, and only Guinan's unique perception of reality may restore the timeline.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E16 - The Offspring
3.plot: Stardate: 43657.0. Data becomes a father when he creates a Soong-type android in the form of a daughter named Lal. Issues are complicated when Lal starts showing signs of a more evolved consciousness, including the ability to feel emotions, which attracts the attention of Starfleet scientists who want to take her away from Data and examine her advanced systems.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E17 - Sins of the Father
3.plot: Stardate: 43685.2. Worf is reunited with his long-lost brother when their father is charged with treason for helping the Romulans. Together they make an appeal to the Klingon High Council to challenge the charges, and have them revoked.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E18 - Allegiance
3.plot: Stardate: 43714.1. Picard is secretly abducted and switched with an alien double. The crews' suspicions are raised when he starts exhibiting unusual behaviour, and is relieved of command.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E19 - Captain's Holiday
3.plot: Stardate: 43745.2. While on vacation on Risa, Captain Picard encounters two Vorgons from the 27th Century who claim they are searching for a powerful weapon hidden somewhere on the planet.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E20 - Tin Man
3.plot: Stardate: 43779.3. The Enterprise encounters a 'living' ship in the Neutral Zone, and risks breaking the Romulan Federation alliance in order to bring it into contact with a Betazoid emissary.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E21 - Hollow Pursuits
3.plot: Stardate: 43807.4. A nervous and insecure officer, Lt. Reginald Barclay, places the Enterprise in great danger when he neglects his duties in Engineering, and instead spends his time acting out his fantasies on the holodeck.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E22 - The Most Toys
3.plot: Stardate: 43872.2. The crew are shattered by the apparent death of Data in a shuttle explosion, and are prevented from carrying out a detailed investigation when Starfleet gives them orders for a new mission elsewhere. However, the crew don't realize that he was actually abducted and placed on display as part of a collection of rare and valuable items held by a disreputable character.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E23 - Sarek
3.plot: Stardate: 43917.4. Spock's Vulcan father, Sarek, boards the Enterprise to negotiate political relations with the Legaran. However, Sarek has contract Bendii syndrome, which causes a Vulcan to gradually lose control, and become overpowered with emotions.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E24 - Ménage à Troi
3.plot: Stardate: 43930.7. Riker and Deanna, both on shoreleave, are unexpectedly joined by Deanna's mother, Lwaxana, on Betazed. Shortly, all three are kidnapped by the Ferengi who want to study Lwaxana's telepathic abilities.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E25 - Transfigurations
3.plot: Stardate: 43957.2. Dr. Crusher becomes attracted to an injured alien with mysterious powers, who is being tracked down by his government like a wanted criminal.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E26 - The Best of Both Worlds (1)
3.plot: Stardate: 43989.1  An Starfleet expert on the Borg, Lt. Cmdr. Shelby, is assigned to the Enterprise to investigate the disappearance of a Federation colony. Picard is abducted by the Borg and assimilated into the Collective, which forces Riker to attempt a rescue mission.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E01 - The Best of Both Worlds (2)
4.plot: Stardate: 44001.4. Riker must pull out all the stops in order to save Earth from a Borg invasion being lead by none other than Locutus - otherwise known as Captain Jean-Luc Picard.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E02 - Family
4.plot: Stardate 44012.3. Picard meets with his older brother in France, and contemplates resigning his Starfleet commission after his ordeal with the Borg. Worf's adoptive parents spend time with their son on the Enterprise, and succeed in embarrassing him in front of his crewmates.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E04 - Suddenly Human
4.plot: Stardate: 44143.7. A custody battle between Picard and a child's adoptive father arises when a boy showing evidence of abuse is discovered.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E05 - Remember Me
4.plot: Stardate: 44161.2. Dr. Crusher begins to question her sanity when members of the crew start disappearing one by one, and all evidence of their existence is erased.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E06 - Legacy
4.plot: Stardate: 44215.2. The Enterprise is caught in the middle of a civil war when they encounter Tasha Yar's long-lost younger sister, Ishara.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E07 - Reunion
4.plot: Stardate: 44246.3. Picard is asked to choose between two candidates to succeed the current Chancellor of the Klingon High Council as the new ruler of the Empire. Worf is disturbed by unexpected news when he is paid a visit by his former lover.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E08 - Future Imperfect
4.plot: Stardate: 44286.5. Riker awakens one morning to discover he is suddenly 16 years in the future as the captain of the Enterprise, and negotiating a peace treaty with the Romulans with no recollection of how he arrived at that point in time, or of any recent events.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E09 - Final Mission
4.plot: Stardate: 44307.3. Wesley must keep Captain Picard alive on the eve of his entrance exam to Starfleet Academy when their shuttle crashes on a barren moon.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E10 - The Loss
4.plot: Stardate: 44356.9. Troi loses her empathic abilities when the Enterprise is caught in the gravitational pull of a black hole.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E11 - Data's Day
4.plot: Stardate: 44356.9. A Vulcan Ambassador being escorted by the Enterprise starts exhibiting suspicious behavior. Miles O'Brien marries his fiancée, Keiko Ishikawa in Ten-Forward.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E12 - The Wounded
4.plot: Stardate: 44429.6. When the Cardassians start re-arming themselves, a Federation Captain takes it upon himself to remove a potential threat before it escalated. Now, Picard must fight for the Cardassians and stop the renegade from slaughtering innocents.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E13 - Devil's Due
4.plot: Stardate: 44474.5. The crew of the Enterprise must defend the planet Ventax from a mythological Devil who re-appears when a 1000 year long era of peace comes to an end.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E14 - Clues
4.plot: Stardate: 44502.7. Picard orders a secret investigation when the crew suspects Data of lying about the discovery of a wormhole.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E15 - First Contact
4.plot: Riker is abducted by a xenophobic race of aliens during a first contact mission. They believe the Enterprise is a scout for an invasion.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E16 - Galaxy's Child
4.plot: Stardate: 44614.6. Geordi must work with the real Leah Brahms when she arrives on the Enterprise when a space-borne alien life form thinks the ship is its mother. Tensions rise when she learns that Geordi created a holographic version of her several months before in order to save the ship from danger.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E17 - Night Terrors
4.plot: Stardate: 44631.2. Troi faces a recurring nightmare when the Enterprise is caught in a rift in space. Soon, the crew begins to slip into insanity through dream deprivation.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E18 - Identity Crisis
4.plot: Stardate: 44664.5. Geordi and a former crew mate begin evolving into bizarre creatures when they return to a planet both of them were on during an Away Mission five years earlier.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E19 - The Nth Degree
4.plot: Stardate: 44704.2. An alien probe transforms Barclay from a shy, awkward character into an arrogant super-genius who is able to interface with the Enterprise's computer through the holodeck.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E20 - Qpid
4.plot: Stardate:44741.9. Q places Vash and the senior Enterprise crew in a recreation of Robin Hood and his merry men.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E21 - The Drumhead
4.plot: Stardate: 44769.2. Picard is accused of treason when an explosion aboard the Enterprise is investigated by a ruthless and paranoid Starfleet Admiral.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E22 - Half a Life
4.plot: Stardate: 44805.3. Lwaxana Troi falls in love with a man who must return home to commit suicide, as is customary for their race when they reach a certain age.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E23 - The Host
4.plot: Startdate: 44821.3. Dr. Crusher falls in love with a Trill Ambassador, until she discovers the Trill's symbiotic relationship.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E24 - The Mind's Eye
4.plot: Stardate: 44885.5. While en route to Risa for shore leave, Geordi is abducted by the Romulans and brainwashed into becoming an assassin.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E25 - In Theory
4.plot: Stardate: 44932.3. Data experiences the complexities of love when a fellow crewmate becomes attracted to him.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E26 - Redemption (1)
4.plot: Stardate: 44995.3. Worf must choose between his people and the Federation when a civil war threatens to destroy the Klingon Empire.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E01 - Redemption (2)
5.plot: Stardate: 45020.4. Picard suspects a Romulan influence in the recent Klingon civil war, and must force the Federation to intervene before the Empire collapses.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E02 - Darmok
5.plot: Stardate: 45047.2. Picard must find a way to communicate with the newly discovered Tamarians, who speak entirely in metaphors, when a Tamarian Captain is brutally killed.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E03 - Ensign Ro
5.plot: Stardate: 45076.3. Picard exposes a planned genocidal attack on the Bajorans with the help of a new officer, Ensign Ro Laren.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E04 - Silicon Avatar
5.plot: Stardate: 45122.3. Picard attempts communications with the Crystalline Entity - a life form responsible for hundreds of deaths throughout the Alpha Quadrant. However, a scientist on board the Enterprise has plans of revenge over the death of her only son at the hands of the Entity.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E05 - Disaster
5.plot: Stardate: 45156.1. A natural disaster leaves Troi in command of the Enterprise, Picard stuck in a turbo lift with three small children and Keiko O'Brien stuck in Ten-Forward giving birth with an anxious Worf.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E06 - The Game
5.plot: Stardate: 45208.2. An addictive game is distributed among the crew of the Enterprise, however, it appears that this game interferes with a person's logic and reason, which leaves the crew open to manipulation. Only a young Ensign and a vacationing Wesley Crusher are able to think for themselves, and must find a way to reverse the damage before the ship falls into the wrong hands.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E07 - Unification (1)
5.plot: Stardate: 45233.1. Ambassador Spock has disappeared and intelligence finds him on Romulus.  Captain Picard is sent to Romulus to find Spock.  Meanwhile Riker and the rest of the crew investigate the fragments of a Vulcan ship discovered in the wreck of a Ferengi vessel.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E08 - Unification (2)
5.plot: Stardate: 45245.8. Picard and Data find Spock and discover the reason behind the secret meetings. However, a darker scheme planned by the Romulans is also uncovered in the process.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E09 - A Matter of Time
5.plot: Stardate: 45349.1. While on a mission to help a planet recently struck by an asteroid, the Enterprise is payed a visit by a man who claims to be from the future.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E10 - New Ground
5.plot: Stardate: 45376.3. Worf's son, Alexander, unexpectedly arrives on the Enterprise to stay with his father. However, Alexander wants to stay permanently.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E11 - Hero Worship
5.plot: Stardate: 45397.3. The Enterprise investigates the cause of an explosion which destroyed a small ship and its entire crew, except for a small boy.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E12 - Violations
5.plot: Stardate: 45429.3. While escorting a group of telepaths, crew members on board the Enterprise suddenly start to slip into comas.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E13 - The Masterpiece Society
5.plot: Stardate: 45470.1. A natural disaster in the core of a system's sun threatens to destroy a colony of genetically engineered people on an otherwise desolate planet. However, the crew's intervention may cause more harm than good.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E14 - Conundrum
5.plot: Stardate: 45494.2. The Enterprise crew unknowingly receives a new first officer who claims that the Federation is at war with another species.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E15 - Power Play
5.plot: Stardate: 45571.2. While en route to the source of a subspace distress signal coming from a desolate moon, Data, Troi and O'Brien take over the bridge and force the ship to change course.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E16 - Ethics
5.plot: Stardate: 45587.3. When Worf is paralysed in an accident he must undergo drastic back surgery. However, this experimental technique may cost him his life.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E17 - The Outcast
5.plot: Stardate: 45614.6. While investigating the disappearance of a J'naii shuttlecraft, the crew finds reason to believe the missing ship is stranded in an abnormal pocket called "null space." Riker and Soren, a member of the J'naii race, begin preparing to rescue the craft, and the two strike up a friendship. Their relationship develops quickly as the pair question each other about mating habits, since the J'naii are androgynous and do not identify themselves as either male or female. Despite this difference, sparks begin to fly between them.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E18 - Cause and Effect
5.plot: Stardate: 45652.1. While exploring the Typhon Expanse, the Enterprise is caught in a time warp in which they are repeatedly destroyed while colliding with another starship.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E19 - The First Duty
5.plot: Stardate: 45703.9. Wesley is involved in a cover-up at Starfleet Academy when a cadet is killed and five shuttles are destroyed during a forbidden maneuver performed by Starfleet Academy's best cadets.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E20 - Cost of Living
5.plot: Stardate: 45733.6. Deanna's mother pays a surprise visit to the Enterprise with even more surprising news: she plans to marry a man she has never met. After destroying an asteroid, the ship becomes infected with parasites that eat away at the ship's hull.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E21 - The Perfect Mate
5.plot: Stardate: 45761.3. The Ferengi try to abduct an empathic Metamorph who could bring peace between two warring worlds.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E22 - Imaginary Friend
5.plot: Stardate: 45832.1. While exploring a strange form of energy in a region of space, a little girl's imaginary friend becomes real and places the Enterprise in great danger.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E23 - I, Borg
5.plot: Stardate: 45854.2. An injured Borg is discovered and brought back to the Enterprise where he is 'repaired' by Dr. Crusher and befriended by Geordi, who names him 'Hugh.' Soon, Hugh starts showing signs of individuality while Picard must choose between destroying him or returning him to the collective.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E24 - The Next Phase
5.plot: Stardate: 45092.4. While the Enterprise helps a Romulan science vessel, an accident occurs which forces Geordi LaForge and Ro Laren slightly out of 'phase', causing them to become undetectable to everyone but each other. As a result, the crew thinks they are dead and make arrangements for their funerals, even though they are closer than the crew realise.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E25 - The Inner Light
5.plot: Stardate: 45944.1. Picard awakes to find himself living in a small village where he is a well-known member of the community who is suffering from a delusion of being a starship captain.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E26 - Time's Arrow (1)
5.plot: Stardate: 45959.1. Data's head is uncovered in an archaeological dig on Earth, where evidence is also found that aliens may have been on Earth as early as the 19th Century. Using modified technology, an away team follows Data into the late 1890s to investigate.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E01 - Time's Arrow (2)
6.plot: Stardate: 46001.3. The away team's investigations are hampered by a nosy Samuel Clemens. Picard discovers that he originally met Guinan in the 1890s on Earth.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E02 - Realm of Fear
6.plot: Stardate: 46041.1. Lt. Barclay's fear of using transporters is eerily justified when he sees bizarre aliens within the transporter beam.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E03 - Man of the People
6.plot: Stardate: 46071.6. Deanna becomes attracted to an alien ambassador. Shortly thereafter, she starts ageing rapidly and starts becoming violent.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E04 - Relics
6.plot: Stardate: 46125.3. Montgomery 'Scotty' Scott is discovered suspended in a transporter beam 75 years after he disappeared. After the Enterprise crew re-materialise him, he has a hard time adjusting to the new society.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E05 - Schisms
6.plot: Stardate: 46154.2. Members of the crew are secretly abducted from the Enterprise to be used in bizarre experiments where they are dismembered and re-assembled without anyone's knowledge - including their own. The only signs that anything is wrong is a strange form of tiredness and no recollection of having slept well the night before.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E06 - True Q
6.plot: Stardate: 46192.3. A young intern visiting the Enterprise captures the interest of Q when she starts displaying Q-like powers.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E07 - Rascals
6.plot: Stardate: 46235.7. A transporter accident transforms Picard, Ro Laren, Guinan and Keiko O'Brien into small children who appear to be about 12 years old. Matters are complicated when the Ferengi seize the Enterprise.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E08 - A Fistful of Datas
6.plot: Stardate: 46271.5. Worf and his son, Alexander, become trapped in the holodeck when their Wild West program malfunctions. However, they must find a way to defeat the holographic bandits who have Data's appearance and abilities.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E09 - The Quality of Life
6.plot: Stardate: 46315.2. Data discovers that the maintenance robots built by Dr. Farallon may have become sentient.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E10 - Chain of Command (1)
6.plot: Stardate: 46357.4. Picard resigns as Captain of the Enterprise to lead a top-secret espionage mission into Cardassia with Worf and Dr. Crusher.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E11 - Chain of Command (2)
6.plot: Stardate: 46360.8. Picard is captured and tortured by the Cardassians, while Riker tries to prevent a Federation attack on Cardassia.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E12 - Ship in a Bottle
6.plot: Stardate: 46424.1. While performing holodeck maintenance, Barclay accesses the stored hologram of Professor Moriarty, who wreaks havoc on board the Enterprise.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E13 - Aquiel
6.plot: Stardate: 46461.3. Geordie falls in love with a lieutenant who is the prime suspect in a murder case.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E14 - Face of the Enemy
6.plot: Stardate: 46519.1. Troi is abducted and surgically altered by the Romulans as part of a ploy to smuggle intelligence operatives into the Federation.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E15 - Tapestry
6.plot: Stardate: Unknown. A mortally wounded Picard is forced into re-living a time of his life when he was back in Starfleet Academy, with the intervention of Q.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E16 - Birthright (1)
6.plot: Stardate: 46578.4. While visiting Deep Space Nine, Worf learns that his father is still alive and being held captive in a secret Romulan prison camp.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E17 - Birthright (2)
6.plot: Stardate: 46759.2. Worf is captured by the Romulans where he learns why the other captives did not attempt an escape years before.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E18 - Starship Mine
6.plot: Stardate: 46682.4. The crew evacuates the Enterprise when the ship needs to be cleaned of particles that have built up over the ship's hull. However, Picard accidentally stumbles over a terrorist group who plan on destroying the ship. He only has a short time to stop their attempts before the ship is swept by a beam of radiation to remove the particles that is lethal to all forms of life.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E19 - Lessons
6.plot: Stardate: 46693.1. Picard must choose between love and command when he must make a decision that could place the woman he loves in a potentially deadly and high-risk mission.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E20 - The Chase
6.plot: Stardate: 46731.5. Picard's old archaeology professor is found murdered, the crew try to complete his research. Soon, the crew must compete with Romulans and Klingons and Cardassians to uncover the truth behind his discoveries.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E21 - Frame of Mind
6.plot: Stardate: 46778.1. Riker questions his sanity when his reality seems to shift between an alien psychiatric hospital and a play he is performing with other members of the crew.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E22 - Suspicions
6.plot: Stardate: 46830.1. Dr. Crusher puts her career on the line when she tries to clear the name of a murdered scientist whose invention could allow starships to pass through a sun's corona.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E23 - Rightful Heir
6.plot: Stardate: 46852.2. While on a quest to summon a vision of Kahless, Worf questions his faith when the real Kahless rises from the dead to lead the Empire.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E24 - Second Chances
6.plot: Stardate: 46915.2. Riker discovers that eight years ago, an exact clone of him was created when he beamed through a planet's surface while returning to his starship. This clone, named Thomas Riker, has secretly remained on the planet for the past eight years, and still has romantic feelings for Troi.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E25 - Timescape
6.plot: Stardate: 46944.2. Picard, Geordi, Troi and Data return from a Federation conference to find the Enterprise frozen in time and under attack from a frozen Romulan Warbird.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E26 - Descent (1)
