25.title: FR - Les Simpson - S25E09 - Steal This Episode
25.plot: Homer becomes annoyed with movie theaters, so Bart teaches him how to download movies illegally. Homer is delighted with his discovery of free movies until he's caught for piracy. Deputy Director Gratman, the FBI's anti-piracy boss, is tasked with hunting down Homer, who stands accused of illegally downloading a film.

25.title: FR - Les Simpson - S25E10 - Married to the Blob
25.plot: When Comic Book Guy meets a woman writing an autobiographical manga, he seeks Homer's advice on dating.

25.title: FR - Les Simpson - S25E11 - Specs and the City
25.plot: When Marge tries Homer's new high-tech glasses on, he learns she's seeing a marriage counselor; Bart refuses to buy Nelson a Valentine's Day card.

25.title: FR - Les Simpson - S25E12 - Diggs
25.plot: A recent transfer student named Diggs rescues Bart from a confrontation with bullies.

25.title: FR - Les Simpson - S25E13 - The Man Who Grew Too Much
25.plot: During a research trip, Lisa learns that Sideshow Bob is the chief scientist at a big chemical engineering company; Marge tries to teach a teen church group about healthy sexual practices.

25.title: FR - Les Simpson - S25E14 - The Winter of His Content
25.plot: When Retirement Castle is closed, Marge asks Grampa and two other octogenarians to move in; Nelson befriends Bart after Bart defends him.

25.title: FR - Les Simpson - S25E15 - The War of Art
25.plot: After Lisa's new pet guinea pig destroys the Simpsons' living room art, Marge finds a beautiful painting at the Van Houten's yard sale, which Homer snaps up for 20 bucks

25.title: FR - Les Simpson - S25E16 - You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
25.plot: Homer is recruited as a World Cup referee after Lisa extols his integrity on the youth soccer field in a Springfield Elementary speech contest. But when the Simpsons travel to Brazil (again), Homer finds his honesty tested by one of South America's slickest gangsters in the soccer match-bribing business.

25.title: FR - Les Simpson - S25E17 - Luca$
25.plot: Lisa dates a competitive eater; Bart benefits from helping convict Snake Jailbird escape from a jam.

25.title: FR - Les Simpson - S25E18 - Days of Future Future
25.plot: Set in the future, Homer has a new clone for every time he dies. Lisa is married to a zombie version of Milhouse, while Bart deals with custody issues with his ex-wife, Jenda. Each defines what love means to them.

25.title: FR - Les Simpson - S25E19 - What to Expect When Bart's Expecting
25.plot: When Bart's voodoo doll spell accidentally makes his teacher pregnant, he becomes a savior to couples hoping to conceive.

25.title: FR - Les Simpson - S25E20 - Brick Like Me
25.plot: Homer wakes up in a Springfield where everyone and everything is made out of Legos, and he must figure his way out before he gets stuck in the plastic world forever.

25.title: FR - Les Simpson - S25E21 - Pay Pal
25.plot: Marge swears off befriending any more couples when Homer offends their charming new British neighbors, but when Lisa declares that she, too, doesn’t need friends, Marge reconsiders.

25.title: FR - Les Simpson - S25E22 - The Yellow Badge of Cowardge
25.plot: Bart feels guilty after he wins the annual "last day of school" race around Springfield Elementary School, with help from Nelson, who beats up the frontrunner, Milhouse. Meanwhile, Homer tries to bring back 4th of July fireworks after they are canceled due to budget cuts.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E01 - Clown in the Dumps
26.plot: A Springfield resident dies, Krusty retires after he's offended by a comedy cable channel roast of him, and Lisa tries to protect Homer from getting hurt.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E02 - The Wreck of the Relationship
26.plot: When Bart disrespects Homer's authority, Homer makes a point to try his hand at parenting. This proves fruitless, so Marge signs them up for the Relation Ship, where they'll resolve their conflicts at sea. Meanwhile, Marge is in charge of Homer's fantasy football league, but manages to win despite being the underdog.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E03 - Super Franchise Me
26.plot: Marge opens a sandwich franchise store after her sandwiches become a huge hit at Springfield Elementary. But running day-to-day at the store proves challenging, especially when the same franchise opens another location across the street.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E04 - Treehouse of Horror XXV
26.plot: In a Halloween-theme episode Bart reads Aramaic symbols from the bottom of his desk and he and Lisa are transported to an alternate world filled with demons. Also, Moe organizes a "Clockwork Orange"-ish gang in which member Dum (Homer) falls for a young lady (Marge) who wants him to quit. In a homage to "The Others," the Simpsons reconnect with their earlier incarnations from the Tracey Ullman era.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E05 - Opposites A-Frack
26.plot: Lisa brings in assembly woman Maxine Lombard to put a stop to Mr. Burns' fracking operation, but is taken aback when the two political opponents find themselves attracted to one another.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E06 - Simpsorama
26.plot: The Planet Express crew come to present-day Springfield to prevent the Simpsons from destroying the future.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E07 - Blazed and Confused
26.plot: Bart schemes to bring down his new teacher, Mr. Lassen, who is a terrible bully. Meanwhile, The Simpsons go to Burning Man.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E08 - Covercraft
26.plot: Homer has a mid-life crisis, takes up bass guitar and forms a cover band with some of the other dads in town. But the band's modest early success is soon overwhelmed by the breakout potential of their most unlikely star, Apu.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E09 - I Won't Be Home for Christmas
26.plot: After Moe convinces Homer to stay out drinking on Christmas Eve, Marge tells Homer not to come home. This leads to Homer's sad trek through lonely Springfield, where he learns that the only place where one should truly get drunk on Christmas is home.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E10 - The Man Who Came to Be Dinner
26.plot: During a trip to "Dizzneeland" the Simpsons board the wrong ride, Rocket To Your Doom, and are transported through the galaxy to Kang and Kodos' home planet, where they are held captive at the local zoo and the inhabitants decide to eat Homer.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E11 - Bart's New Friend
26.plot: Bart has a new accomplice and best friend when Homer is hypnotized at the circus and believes he is a young boy again.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E12 - The Musk Who Fell to Earth
26.plot: When inventor Elon Musk lands in Springfield, he and Homer become fast friends and revolutionize the town's nuclear plant. But when Musk goes overboard and Mr. Burns wants him removed, Homer must figure out a way to break up with him.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E13 - Walking Big & Tall
26.plot: When Lisa learns Springfield's anthem was stolen from another town she writes a replacement. Meanwhile, Homer learns the meaning of "Wide Pride".

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E14 - My Fare Lady
26.plot: When Marge gets fed up with the thankless duty of chauffeuring her kids around, she begins working as a driver for a transportation app service. Meanwhile, Homer bankrupts Moe when he watches over the bar for one night, which forces Moe to take a temporary job as a janitor at the nuclear plant.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E15 - The Princess Guide
26.plot: Homer is put in charge of keeping Princess Kemi out of trouble while her father, a Nigerian king, works out a uranium deal with Mr. Burns.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E16 - Sky Police
26.plot: Chief Wiggum is mistakenly delivered a military jet pack, which he gleefully accepts and uses in order to fight crime. But when the jet pack crashes into the church, the congregation, led by Marge, must resort to gambling and counting cards in order to collect money to repair the church.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E17 - Waiting for Duffman
26.plot: When Duffman (guest voice Stacy Keach) undergoes hip replacement surgery and retires, the company sets up a reality show competition to find his replacement. Homer wins the competition, and because the job requires him to stay sober, he learns that beer isn't as necessary as he thought to have a good time.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E18 - Peeping Mom
26.plot: Bart lies about being involved in a bulldozer crash, so Marge decides to follow him everywhere until he confesses. Meanwhile, Homer ignores Santa’s Little Helper when Flanders gets a new dog.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E19 - The Kids Are All Fight
26.plot: When Homer gets an old film roll developed, the family takes a trip down memory lane to see the origins of how Bart and Lisa first started fighting with each other.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E20 - Let's Go Fly a Coot
26.plot: The Simpsons learn about Grampa’s days in the Air Force, and Bart takes up smoking to impress Milhouse’s Dutch cousin, Annika.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E21 - Bull-E
26.plot: After Bart gets bullied at the school dance, Marge convinces the town to pass anti-bullying legislation. Homer then gets arrested and sent to rehab for bullying Ned Flanders, only to subsequently leave rehab as a hero.

26.title: FR - Les Simpson - S26E22 - Mathlete's Feat
26.plot: When a modernized Springfield Elementary has a technical meltdown, Lisa transforms it into a Waldorf school. Meanwhile, Groundskeeper Willie becomes the coach of the mathletes.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E01 - Every Man's Dream
27.plot: Homer is diagnosed with narcolepsy, but instead of returning home with his prescription medication, he returns home drunk. He and Marge visit a marriage counselor and have a trial separation, during which Homer begins dating a 20-something.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E02 - Cue Detective
27.plot: Scotty Boom, a Chew Network super-chef, challenges Homer to a smoke-off. But when someone steals Homer’s secret weapon – a smoker he bought off a mysterious man at a BBQ shack – Lisa and Bart are on the case.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E03 - Puffless
27.plot: Upon learning that their father really died of lung cancer, Selma and Patty agree to quit smoking. When Selma relapses, an angry Patty moves in with Marge and Homer.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E04 - Halloween of Horror
27.plot: When Lisa becomes scared at the Krustyland Halloween Horror Night, Homer is forced to take down his Everscream Terrors decorations. Halloween pop-up employees seek vengeance on Homer for causing them to lose their jobs, and rob his house while Homer and Lisa hide out in the attic. Homer and Lisa light up their stored holiday decorations to attract attention and stand up to the intruders.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E05 - Treehouse of Horror XXVI
27.plot: In the annual fright fest Halloween episode, Sideshow Bob finally kills Bart, only to reanimate him; Homer wakes up with short-term memory loss; and Lisa, Bart, and Milhouse get super powers from radiation.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E06 - Friend with Benefit
27.plot: Lisa makes a new pal at school named Harper, whose internet billionaire father becomes buddies with a different Simpson: Homer. Soon, though, Lisa becomes worried that Harper is a little too entitled.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E07 - Lisa with an 'S'
27.plot: When Homer loses $5,000 at a poker game with Broadway legend Laney Fontaine, the only way he is able to settle the bet is if he loans Lisa to Laney for a month. Then, Laney turns Lisa into a show biz kid and Marge and Homer fear they made a mistake letting her go. So they head to New York to get her back.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E08 - Paths of Glory
27.plot: Lisa sets out to restore the tarnished reputation of Springfield’s first female inventor. To find her invention, she scours an abandoned asylum and a restaurant that caters to men. Bart joins Lisa at the asylum, stealing one of the homicidal patient’s notebooks, and bragging to the boys at school that he wrote the entries himself. This revelation causes Homer and Marge to believe he is a sociopath, which Bart decides to use to his advantage until things go too far.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E09 - Barthood
27.plot: Bart’s coming of age story a la “Boyhood” chronicles his life from six years old to his time as an accomplished young man. Along the way, his tense relationship with Homer, an overly uncaring version of himself, and Lisa, who overshadows him in every way possible, shape Bart more than he realizes.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E10 - The Girl Code
27.plot: After a photo Marge posts on social media gets Homer fired, he returns to the best job he ever had, a dishwasher at a Greek restaurant. This same post inspires Lisa to code an app that predicts the real-life consequences of anything you post online, only to create sentient artificial intelligence.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E11 - Teenage Mutant Milk-Caused Hurdles
27.plot: There is a new teacher at Springfield Elementary, and a captivated Bart tries everything to win her over. Meanwhile, Homer decides to buy a new brand of “milk,” which causes early puberty, both for Bart (augmenting his wooing powers) and Lisa (whose small bout with acne opens her up to the world of makeup and popularity).

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E12 - Much Apu About Something
27.plot: Sanjay passes his stake in the Kwik-E-Mart to his millennial son, Jay, who turns it into a hip, health food market against Apu’s insistence on tradition. Bart, whom Homer had convinced to give up pranking, is called upon to return to his trickster life and take down the new store.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E13 - Love Is in the N2-O2-Ar-CO2-Ne-He-CH4
27.plot: Lonely Professor Frink uses science to turn himself into a man whom women find attractive. Then,  overwhelmed by the attention, he invents an algorithm to perfectly pair the lonely men and women of Springfield, realizing that scientific exploration is his true love. Meanwhile, Marge, Bart, and Lisa visit Grampa for Valentine's Day and try to rescue the old folks from a drug-induced hallucination that allows them to relive their happiest memories.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E14 - Gal of Constant Sorrow
27.plot: After Bart accidentally sends a sweet homeless woman's cart into the river, he allows her to live in his closet for a small fee. When Lisa discovers that the woman is an incredible folk singer, she offers her own closet and plans a concert, only to be disappointed by Hettie's surprising substance abuse and violent nature. Meanwhile Homer tries to prove he's handy, but accidentally traps the cat in the walls of the house.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E15 - Lisa the Veterinarian
27.plot: After performing CPR on a tased raccoon, Lisa discovers her calling to be veterinarian and becomes an intern at the local office, but learns a tough lesson when her neglected class hamster dies. Meanwhile, Marge moonlights as a crime scene cleaner for a little extra money, and the trauma of the gory scenes make her increasingly dead inside.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E16 - The Marge-ian Chronicles
27.plot: Not feeling unique, Lisa signs up for the Mars One Space Colony – to Marge’s dismay. Then, Marge hires Bart to go through the tryout process with Lisa to make her want to quit.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E17 - The Burns Cage
27.plot: After Smithers is crushed by Mr. Burns' lack of affection towards him, other characters attempt to find a boyfriend for him. Meanwhile, Milhouse competes against a new boy for the lead role in a school production of Casablanca, so he can act alongside his own unrequited love, Lisa.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E18 - How Lisa Got Her Marge Back
27.plot: After getting into an argument, Marge takes Lisa on a touristy trip to Capital City, where, after attending a musical, they meet the show’s star who reminds Lisa how lucky she is to have such a great mom. Meanwhile, Bart is frustrated that everyone expects his pranks, so he teams up with Maggie to trick people.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E19 - Fland Canyon
27.plot: Homer recalls a tense family vacation to the Grand Canyon with the Flanders family. At first, the Flanders’ perfection puts the families at odds, but when they get stranded and Ned and Bart go for help, the families finally bond.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E20 - To Courier with Love
27.plot: "The Simpsons are going to..." Paris (well, Homer and Marge are), but in order to be able to afford the trip, Homer has to smuggle an exotic snake into France so it can be made into a gourmet meal.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E21 - Simprovised
27.plot: After butchering a speech in front of all of his friends at work, Homer turns to improv comedy to gain back his confidence in his public speaking skills.  Meanwhile, Marge decides to rebuild Bart’s lackluster treehouse, but tensions rise when Bart questions her building skills. Also, in the episode’s last three minutes, Homer  appears LIVE for the first time on television (both for East and West Coast broadcasts) to answer fan questions.

27.title: FR - Les Simpson - S27E22 - Orange is the New Yellow
27.plot: Marge goes to prison for letting Bart play in a park unsupervised.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E01 - Monty Burns' Fleeing Circus
28.plot: When a fire levels Springfield, Mr. Burns agrees to the Simpsons' pleas that he fund the town's rebuilding, on the condition that he gets to put on a variety show.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E02 - Friends and Family
28.plot: Mr. Burns hires the Simpsons, except Homer, to be his virtual family; Homer becomes best friends with the girl next door.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E03 - The Town
28.plot: After Homer catches Bart rooting for Springfield’s football rival, the Boston Americans, he plans a family “hate-cation” trip to Boston in an attempt to show Bart that Boston is a terrible city.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E04 - Treehouse of Horror XXVII
28.plot: Better late than never, The Hunger Games come to Springfield!

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E05 - Trust But Clarify
28.plot: Lisa and Bart investigate Krusty’s suspicious new "Krustaceans" candy. Meanwhile, Homer wants a promotion at the nuclear plant and asks Marge to help him dress the part, and news anchor Kent Brockman struggles to find his feet in the changing media world.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E06 - There Will Be Buds
28.plot: Homer gets roped into coaching the kids' lacrosse team with Milhouse's dad, Kirk, who is in desperate need of a friend. When Kirk gets too clingy, Homer vents about how much of a loser he is. Kirk overhears his rant and disappears, right when the team needs him most: the championship game.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E07 - Havana Wild Weekend
28.plot: When the Retirement Castle and the V.A. Hospital can’t solve Grampa’s health issues, the Simpsons decide to take a family trip to Cuba to get him cheap medical care.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E08 - Dad Behavior
28.plot: Homer finds a new app that makes his life much easier and outsources his father-son bonding. Meanwhile, Grampa finds that he is about to be a father again.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E09 - The Last Traction Hero
28.plot: A workplace accident leaves Homer in a cast, and in a position to sue Mr. Burns. This leaves Marge unfulfilled, so she turns to an unexpected source for romance. Meanwhile, Lisa is made "Bus Monitor" and tries to keep the peace.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E10 - The Nightmare After Krustmas
28.plot: Krusty tries to impress his daughter as they spend Christmas with the Simpsons. Meanwhile, Reverend Lovejoy seeks converts after church attendance plummets, and Maggie is haunted by a spooky Christmas toy.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E11 - Pork and Burns
28.plot: When Marge becomes obsessed with a Japanese style of living, the Simpsons must part with any item that no longer brings them joy. For Homer, this means finding a new home for the family pig. For Lisa, it means saying goodbye to her beloved sax

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E12 - The Great Phatsby (1)
28.plot: Mr. Burns tries to relive his glory days and crosses paths with a mysterious music mogul. After being conned by him and reduced to bankruptcy, Mr. Burns seeks revenge on the Music Producer with the help of Homer, Bart, rapper Jazzy James and the mogul's ex-wife, Praline. Also, Lisa is courted by the richest kid in town, Smithers begins a perilous journey and Marge opens an obscure boutique store.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E13 - The Great Phatsby (2)
28.plot: Mr. Burns tries to relive his glory days and crosses paths with a mysterious music mogul. After being conned by him and reduced to bankruptcy, Mr. Burns seeks revenge on the Music Producer with the help of Homer, Bart, rapper Jazzy James and the mogul's ex-wife, Praline. Also, Lisa is courted by the richest kid in town, Smithers begins a perilous journey and Marge opens an obscure boutique store.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E14 - Fatzcarraldo
28.plot: All of the fast food restaurants in Springfield go healthy, forcing Homer to turn to the last bastion of greasy food for comfort.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E15 - The Cad and the Hat
28.plot: Bart deals with his guilt after betraying Lisa; Springfield is in awe of Homer when he is revealed to be a chess savant.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E16 - Kamp Krustier
28.plot: Bart and Lisa return home from Kamp Krustier early, interrupting Homer and Marge's romantic encounters; Bart and Lisa confront a source of trauma.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E17 - 22 for 30
28.plot: Bart goes from delinquent with detention to the star basketball player at Springfield Elementary. Lisa covers Bart’s success for the school paper, and Homer becomes the team’s coach. Things go awry when Bart gets involved with the mafia

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E18 - A Father's Watch
28.plot: Marge turns to a series of parenting experts for advice when she becomes worried that Bart is destined for failure; Homer decides to open a trophy store; Grampa gives Bart a watch coveted by Homer.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E19 - The Caper Chase
28.plot: Disappointed in Yale, Mr. Burns decides to start his own for-profit university and Homer is hired as a professor

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E20 - Looking for Mr. Goodbart
28.plot: Bart gets in trouble on Grandparents Day at school and is forced to hang out with Skinner's mother as punishment. After spending time with various grandmas in the neighborhood, he learns the benefits of hanging out with the elderly, but eventually recognizes the dangers of taking advantage of them. Meanwhile, Peekimon Get has taken over the town of Springfield.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E21 - Moho House
28.plot: Mr. Burns makes a bet with his old friend that nothing can break Homer and Marge apart. But that's where Moe comes in.

28.title: FR - Les Simpson - S28E22 - Dogtown
28.plot: After a successful animal rights campaign, all dogs in Springfield are allowed to go where they want and do what they want. Pack mentality quickly kicks in and the dogs of Springfield assert their dominance by threatening the people.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E01 - The Serfsons
29.plot: In a magical medieval world, Marge's mother is turned into an Ice Walker and the only way for Homer to afford the cure is to force Lisa to use illegal magic. When the King discovers this, he kidnaps Lisa, and Homer must lead a feudal uprising to save her.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E02 - Springfield Splendor
29.plot: Marge and Lisa turn Lisa’s sad experience into a successful graphic novel-turned-Broadway show, but they struggle with creative differences and ego.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E03 - Whistler's Father
29.plot: Homer discovers that Maggie is a whistling savant and launches her baby-celebrity career. Meanwhile, Marge impresses Fat Tony with her interior design taste, and he hires her to style his brothel.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E04 - Treehouse of Horror XXVIII
29.plot: Maggie becomes possessed by an ancient demon, Lisa discovers a creepy/perfect version of her family in an alternate universe and Homer cannibalizes himself.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E05 - Grampy Can Ya Hear Me
29.plot: Grampa gets a hearing aid and finally hears what everyone has been saying about him. Meanwhile, Mr. Skinner discovers that his mother has kept the ultimate secret from him.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E06 - The Old Blue Mayor She Ain't What She Used to Be
29.plot: Frustrated with the local government, Marge decides to run for Mayor. To win public support, she begins making Homer the butt of her jokes.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E07 - Singin' in the Lane
29.plot: Homer and the guys try helping Moe cheer up by getting their old bowling team back together again, but they soon face a team of arrogant millionaires.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E08 - Mr. Lisa's Opus
29.plot: As future Lisa writes her college application essay for Harvard, she recalls past disappointing birthdays that helped shape her.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E09 - Gone Boy
29.plot: When Bart goes missing, the town puts together a search party to find him. After most give up hope, Sideshow Bob manipulates Millhouse into revealing where Bart is hiding.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E10 - Haw-Haw Land
29.plot: When the Simpsons go to a STEM conference, Lisa falls for a crooning jazz pianist named Brendan. Meanwhile, Bart discovers that he has an affinity for chemistry

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E11 - Frink Gets Testy
29.plot: Mr. Burns will build a doomsday ark after he believes that the end of the world is near when he sees an old Orson Welles show about Nostradamus. Meanwhile, Professor Frink comes up with a new way of testing everyone in Springfield after Burns wants a test to determine who should go on a spaceship with him.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E12 - Homer Is Where the Art Isn't
29.plot: When Homer is accused of stealing a million-dollar painting, only a detective from the 1970s can clear his name.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E13 - 3 Scenes Plus a Tag from a Marriage
29.plot: Homer and Marge recount the story of their transition from loving their life without kids to being miserable parents.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E14 - Fears of a Clown
29.plot: Everybody is now horrified of clowns after Bart's prank using clown masks, which also causes  Krusty to lose his job. He attempts a comeback as a dramatic actor in the play "The Salesman's Bad Day", with Llewellyn Sinclair as his director.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E15 - No Good Read Goes Unpunished
29.plot: In an attempt to bring the family together, Marge forces everyone to hand in their electronics and take a trip to a book store.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E16 - King Leer
29.plot: Homer and Marge follow Moe after the bar closes early and discover him and his father fighting. The Simpsons, after finding out that Moe has been excommunicated from his family for years, attempt to bring them back together.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E17 - Lisa Gets the Blues
29.plot: When the Simpsons' flight to Gainesville gets re-routed to New Orleans, Lisa is forced to face her failures, and regain her confidence as a jazz musician. Meanwhile, Bart is intrigued by the voodoo in Louisiana, and Homer is intrigued by the drinking.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E18 - Forgive and Regret
29.plot: Grampa makes a confession to Homer while on his deathbed. After his recovery, he comes to realize that this issue will not be easy to reconcile.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E19 - Left Behind
29.plot: Homer gets Flanders a job at the plant, and he soon learns that no good deed goes unpunished when Flanders starts to insist on carpools and demands more from Homer's work performance. Meanwhile, Marge feels as though their marriage has lost its spark.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E20 - Throw Grampa from the Dane
29.plot: The Simpsons go to Denmark so Grampa can benefit from its free health-care system.

29.title: FR - Les Simpson - S29E21 - Flanders' Ladder
29.plot: Bart falls into a coma after being struck by lightening.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E01 - Bart's Not Dead
30.plot: Bart takes a dare, and ends up in the hospital. To cover for himself and Homer, he says he went to Heaven and met Jesus. Christian producers offer the Simpsons a movie deal, which Homer takes. But Bart can't deal with the guilt and comes clean to Marge after the movie is finished.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E02 - Heartbreak Hotel
30.plot: Marge and Homer's marriage is tested when they travel to a tropical island to compete for a million dollars on Marge's favorite reality competition show.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E03 - My Way or the Highway to Heaven
30.plot: God and St. Peter contemplate what merits a soul getting into heaven, while citizens of Springfield remember their divine encounters.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E04 - Treehouse of Horror XXIX
30.plot: Homer wins an oyster-eating contest against the mythical Cthulhu, Springfield is overrun by plant body-snatchers, Lisa finally snaps and Mr. Burns opens a retirement home with some Jurassic upgrades.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E05 - Baby You Can't Drive My Car
30.plot: A self-driving car company comes to Springfield, poaching all of the power plant employees with their fun work environment.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E06 - From Russia Without Love
30.plot: On a mission to play hardcore pranks, Bart, Nelson and Milhouse get Moe a mail-order bride on the Dark Web.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E07 - Werking Mom
30.plot: Marge wants a job, and stumbles into becoming a plastic food storage container-selling drag queen. Meanwhile, Lisa tries to make the world better in the style of "Amelie"

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E08 - Krusty the Clown
30.plot: Homer finds his calling as a TV recapper, but his harsh grading causes a brawl with Krusty. After almost killing Homer, Krusty hides out at a real circus, and finds happiness there.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E09 - Daddicus Finch
30.plot: Lisa and Homer's bond gets stronger when they start spending real quality time together, and Bart feels neglected. So Marge tries to help Homer balance his attention between the kids.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E10 - 'Tis the 30th Season
30.plot: After a failed Black Friday shopping spree, Marge is determined to fix Christmas; Homer and the kids surprise Marge with a vacation to a Florida resort.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E11 - Mad About the Toy
30.plot: When Marge and Homer leave Grampa to baby-sit the kids, some little green army men trigger a PTSD episode, sending the family on a journey to Grampa's past and the time period when he was a post-war toy model.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E12 - The Girl on the Bus
30.plot: When Lisa spots a new best friend from the window of the bus, she gets a taste of what life could be like with a different, more cultured family.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E13 - I'm Dancing as Fat as I Can
30.plot: Homer angers Marge by binging their favorite show without her, and has to pick up a new skill in order to make amends. Meanwhile, Bart prepares to compete in "Krusty's Holiday Trample".

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E14 - The Clown Stays in the Picture
30.plot: Krusty reveals the untold story of his past in his movie "The Sands of Space". While working as personal assistants on the movie, Bart and Lisa learn about the early years of their parents' relationship.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E15 - 101 Mitigations
30.plot: Comic Book Guy sues Homer for joyriding in his car. Meanwhile, Guillermo del Toro saves Mr. Burns from his troubles with the law.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E16 - I Want You (She's So Heavy)
30.plot: When a romantic night ends in injury, Marge recovers by taking up kite boarding while Homer bonds with his hallucinated hernia; Lisa attempts to fix her parents' strained relationship by seeking advice from an unlikely source.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E17 - E My Sports
30.plot: As Bart begins to excel in video game competitions, Homer discovers a passion for coaching him; Lisa attempts to bring Homer back to reality, but the plan causes chaos.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E18 - Bart vs. Itchy & Scratchy
30.plot: Krusty releases an all-female reboot of “Itchy and Scratchy,” so Bart and his crew of all-male friends decide to boycott the show. After Bart’s friends turn on him for laughing at the reboot, Bart joins a woke group of sixth-grade girls who commit crimes against patriarchy.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E19 - Girl's in the Band
30.plot: Homer works extra shifts at the plant so Lisa can play in the Capitol City Philharmonic.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E20 - I'm Just a Girl Who Can't Say D'oh
30.plot: Marge becomes director of Springfield's local theater, armed with Lisa's script resembling "Hamilton"; Homer joins a baby class with Maggie, and he takes a liking to supervisor Chloe.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E21 - D'oh Canada
30.plot: Lisa is mistakenly given political asylum in Canada during a family trip to Niagara Falls; Homer goes to a “Daddy and Me” class with Maggie.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E22 - Woo-Hoo Dunnit?
30.plot: The documentary crime series “Dateline: Springfield” goes in-depth to solve the case of Lisa’s missing college fund.

30.title: FR - Les Simpson - S30E23 - Crystal Blue-Haired Persuasion
30.plot: Marge starts a business selling healing crystals to the naive mothers of Springfield when Homer’s work cuts children’s health-care benefits, leading Marge to use the crystals as a cheaper solution for Bart’s ADD.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E01 - The Winter of Our Monetized Content
31.plot: When a video of Bart and Homer fighting goes viral, they begin a journey as social media celebrities; Lisa battles the school's new industrialized detention system.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E02 - Go Big or Go Homer
31.plot: Homer must supervise interns, among whom is a go-getter who asks Homer to be his mentor.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E03 - The Fat Blue Line
31.plot: During the San Castellanta street festival, much of the town finds their wallets have been pickpocketed; after the state investigator puts the wrong man in jail, Chief Wiggum sets out to catch the real criminal and show he's still up for police work.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E04 - Treehouse of Horror XXX
31.plot: The 666th episode of the Simpsons parodies the Omen and Stranger Things, not to mention a little Crazy Rich Aliens.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E05 - Gorillas on the Mast
31.plot: After a trip to Aquatraz Water Park, Lisa becomes determined to set free Springfield's most vicious animals in captivity. Meanwhile, Homer fulfills a lifelong dream of buying a boat, and quickly realizes boat ownership sucks.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E06 - Marge the Lumberjill
31.plot: When Marge realizes that everyone views her as boring, she takes up competitive lumber-jacking as a hobby (and has a real gift for it). The circuit of competitive timbersports takes her on a month-long retreat to Portland with her trainer, Paula, whom Homer worries is going to steal her away forever

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E07 - Livin La Pura Vida
31.plot: The Simpsons join other Springfield families on the Van Houten's annual trip to Costa Rica, which they obviously can't afford. While there, Homer befriends Patty's new girlfriend, Evelyn, and Lisa tracks down the real reason the Van Houtens can go on this trip every year

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E08 - Thanksgiving of Horror
31.plot: The Simpsons face various Thanksgiving nightmares, including the first Thanksgiving, an A.I. mishap and a dangerous space mission complicated by a sentient cranberry sauce.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E09 - Todd, Todd, Why Hast Thou Forsaken Me?
31.plot: Todd blames God for the death of his mother and rejects his faith, so Ned sends him to live with the Simpsons, hoping they can scare him into believing in God again.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E10 - Bobby: It's Cold Outside
31.plot: Sideshow Bob gets contracted as this year’s mall Santa. Meanwhile, someone is stealing all the Christmas packages off people’s front porches.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E11 - Hail to the Teeth
31.plot: Homer and Marge attend Artie Ziff’s wedding and become quite uncomfortable when they realize that his bride-to-be is a clone of Marge. Meanwhile, Lisa grapples with the misogynistic implications of the immediate popularity she receives after getting her new Invisalign braces.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E12 - The Miseducation of Lisa Simpson
31.plot: Marge recruits Chrissy Teigen and John Legend for an education-based proposal.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E13 - Frinkcoin
31.plot: Lisa decides to do an essay on Professor Frink just as the scientist invents a new cryptocurrency. When this makes him the richest man in Springfield, Mr. Burns sees red and he starts plotting against Frink in order to restore his former status, while Frink learns who his real friends are.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E14 - Bart the Bad Guy
31.plot: Bart accidentally sees a new superhero movie one month before its intended release, and uses his knowledge to terrorize the other fans. Two executive producers of the film attempt to prevent Bart from leaking any more news to the public.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E15 - Screenless
31.plot: When Marge implements a screen time limit for the family, she realizes that she is the one addicted.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E16 - Better Off Ned
31.plot: Bart bonds with Ned Flanders, which leaves Homer jealous, so he retaliates by mentoring Nelson Muntz; a heroic act by Homer makes Bart look up to him again.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E17 - Highway to Well
31.plot: When Maggie goes to preschool, Marge decides to get a job to pass the time and ends up working at an upscale weed dispensary; Homer decides to open his own dispensary that mimics a sketchy drug deal, putting their two businesses at odds.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E18 - The Incredible Lightness of Being a Baby
31.plot: Mr. Burns tasks Homer with swindling Cletus Spuckler out of his newfound helium fortune. Meanwhile, Maggie is reunited with Hudson from Playdate with Destiny again, only for Marge to tear them apart after his mother annoys her.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E19 - Warrin' Priests (1)
31.plot: Helen Lovejoy's request for a youth pastor is answered by Bode Wright, a charismatic young preacher from Michigan. When Bode quickly has the Springfield congregation enamored by his easy-going and liberal approach to religion, an outcast and suspicious Reverend Lovejoy decides to look into the newcomer's past.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E20 - Warrin' Priests (2)
31.plot: While Bode has won over most of Springfield, he finds one churchgoer he can't sway in Ned Flanders. Meanwhile in Michigan, Reverend Lovejoy finds the ammunition he needs to get rid of his replacement.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E21 - The Hateful Eight-Year-Olds
31.plot: After severing her sibling ties with Bart, Lisa attends a sleepover at her new friend Addy's house, only to discover that Addy's clique are a group of cruel snobby rich girls that taunt her. Meanwhile, Homer takes Marge on a sunset cruise for the evening and finds himself at odds with the boat's cover band.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E22 - The Way of the Dog
31.plot: Santa's Little Helper nips at Marge, causing the family to reflect on the difficult life that the dog led prior to being adopted by the family. They end up reuniting him with his mother to avoid having to euthanize him.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E01 - Undercover Burns
32.plot: Mr. Burns goes undercover as "Fred" at the nuclear power plant and becomes friends with Homer and the gang. Burns implements all sorts of amenities to improve his employees' lives, but a jealous Smithers plots to bring the old, bitter Burns back and destroy Fred.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E02 - I, Carumbus
32.plot: At a museum exhibit of Ancient Rome, Marge and Homer get into an argument about Homer's lack of ambition. They then imagine a Roman version of what would happen if Homer was more career-driven.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E03 - Now Museum, Now You Don't
32.plot: Lisa stays home from school to explore the wonders of Western art. She appears as Lisanardo, while Bart takes the shape of a French impressionist, Homer and Marge as Diego Rivera and Frida Kahlo, and Maggie as a warrior Cupid.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E04 - Treehouse of Horror XXXI
32.plot: The 31st annual Simpsons Halloween special includes a frightening look at the 2020 election, parodies of Toy Story and Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse and a 9th birthday Lisa just can't get over.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E05 - The 7 Beer Itch
32.plot: Homer is tempted by a British femme fatale while Marge and the kids are on a seaside vacation.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E06 - Podcast News
32.plot: Grampa Simpson is accused of a crime; Kent Brockman questions his career.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E07 - Three Dreams Denied
32.plot: Bart becomes a voice-over actor; Comic Book Guy is humiliated at Comic-Con; Lisa is set up for a fall.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E08 - The Road to Cincinnati
32.plot: Odd couple Skinner and Chalmers embark on an 800-mile car ride to Cincinnati to attend an administrator's convention - but can they reach their destination without killing each other first?

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E09 - Sorry Not Sorry
32.plot: Lisa calls her teacher, Ms. Hoover, a hack and refuses to apologize. Then, she learns Ms. Hoover's private pain.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E10 - A Springfield Summer Christmas for Christmas
32.plot: A cable channel films a Christmas movie in Springfield and Skinner falls in love.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E11 - The Dad Feelings Limited
32.plot: Comic Book Guy and his wife Kumiko debate about having a baby and we learn about his awesome origin story.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E12 - Diary Queen
32.plot: Bart finds his old teacher's diary and learns a surprising secret. Then, Lisa discovers an even bigger surprise.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E13 - Wad Goals
32.plot: Bart becomes a successful caddy, but Marge worries it is ruining his character.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E14 - Yokel Hero
32.plot: Cletus becomes a singing sensation, while Homer becomes a new man. Then, Cletus turns on his fans, ruining everything.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E15 - Do Pizza Bots Dream of Electric Guitars
32.plot: Homer tries to reunite a mechanical band from his youth, but film and TV creator J.J. Abrams gets ahold of them first.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E16 - Manger Things
32.plot: A secret of Flanders' Past and a never-before-seen room of the Simpson house are shown off.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E17 - Uncut Femmes
32.plot: It is discovered that Chief Wiggum's wife is more than she seems. Meanwhile, Marge takes part in a jewel heist.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E18 - Burger Kings
32.plot: Mr. Burns gets into the plant-based burger business. Lisa refuses to believe he's up to no good.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E19 - Panic on the Streets of Springfield
32.plot: Lisa gets a new imaginary friend - a depressed British singer from the 1980s. Meanwhile, Homer becomes a truck guy.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E20 - Mother and Child Reunion
32.plot: Lisa makes a shocking college decision, wounding Marge. It leads to a very surprising place.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E21 - The Man from G.R.A.M.P.A.
32.plot: A British secret agent comes to Springfield in search of a Russian spy.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E22 - The Last Barfighter
32.plot: After Moe breaks their most sacred rule, a secret society of bartenders seeks ultimate vengeance on Homer and his friends.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E01 - The Star of the Backstage
33.plot: A musical comes to life in Springfield as Marge stages a revival of her beloved high school show - but her wonderful memories are threatened by the return of a rival from the past.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E02 - Bart's in Jail
33.plot: When Grampa falls victim to a phone scammer, the Simpsons set out on a mission of vengeance to get his money back.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E03 - Treehouse of Horror XXXII
33.plot: The 32nd annual Simpsons Halloween special includes a spoof of "Parasite" and a segment where Bambi gets his revenge.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E04 - The Wayz We Were
33.plot: Evergreen Terrace is overrun with traffic and Moe has a fateful choice to make.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E05 - Lisa's Belly
33.plot: Marge puts a hurtful word in Lisa's brain and Bart gets swole.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E06 - A Serious Flanders (1)
33.plot: When a ruthless debt collector come to Springfield, Homer and Ned's lives are sucked into the artificial world of prestige TV.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E07 - A Serious Flanders (2)
33.plot: Things for Ned and Homer go from bad to gosh-darn worse in the stunning conclusion of this 'Simpflix' prestige crime thriller.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E08 - Portrait of a Lackey on Fire
33.plot: Smithers finds true love with a famous fashion designer, but will his new relationship destroy Springfield?

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E09 - Mothers and Other Strangers
33.plot: In a flashback, Homer goes on a road trip with his father to find his mother.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E10 - A Made Maggie
33.plot: Fat Tony becomes Godfather to Maggie Simpson.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E11 - The Longest Marge
33.plot: Marge and Mr. Burns fight for the soul of a brash young football prodigy.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E12 - Pixelated and Afraid
33.plot: When Homer and Marge are lost in an icy wilderness, they must push themselves to their limits to survive.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E13 - Boyz N the Highlands
33.plot: Bart, Martin and the bullies run for their lives when a weekend in the wilderness takes a dark turn.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E14 - You Won't Believe What This Episode Is About -- Act Three Will Shock You!
33.plot: Homer becomes a pariah when footage of him allegedly leaving Santa's Little Helper in a hot car goes viral.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E15 - Bart the Cool Kid
33.plot: When Bart befriends a famous kid influencer who owns an ultra-cool skate wear brand, Homer leads a rebellion of loser dads against them.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E16 - Pretty Whittle Liar
33.plot: Cletus discovers that his wife Brandine has been hiding a secret love ... of learning.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E17 - The Sound of Bleeding Gums
33.plot: Lisa meets the son of the late musician Bleeding Gums Murphy - and attempts to improve his life.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E18 - My Octopus and a Teacher
33.plot: Bart can't control his feelings when he gets a new teacher. Meanwhile, Lisa befriends an octopus.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E19 - Girls Just Shauna Have Fun
33.plot: When Lisa joins the high school marching band, she finds an unlikely mentor in Shauna Chalmers. Meanwhile, Homer becomes a craft beer brewer.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E20 - Marge the Meanie
33.plot: A surprise from Marge's past has her bonding with Bart and terrifying Homer.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E21 - Meat Is Murder
33.plot: Grampa finds himself in a pickle when his hidden hamburger past comes back to "ketchup" with him.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E22 - Poorhouse Rock
33.plot: After Bart humiliates him at church, Homer finally teaches his son to admire his dad - until a visit from a magical, singing janitor changes everything they thought they knew.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E01 - Habeas Tortoise
34.plot: After Homer humiliates himself in a town meeting, he looks for acceptance in an internet group hunting for a missing tortoise but finds something much more sinister.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E02 - One Angry Lisa
34.plot: Lisa gets called for jury duty while Marge becomes obsessed with her exercise bike.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E03 - Lisa the Boy Scout
34.plot: When the Boy Explorers become co-ed, Bart and Lisa vow to "out scout" each other at the annual jamboree.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E04 - The King of Nice
34.plot: Marge is hired as a segment producer on Krusty's new daytime talk show. But her initial excitement about the job fades when she discovers what an endless nightmare it is!

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E05 - Not It
34.plot: Homer and his teenaged friends are pursued by a killer clown in a spoof of Stephen King's novel "It".

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E06 - Treehouse of Horror XXXIII
34.plot: In a book-themed trilogy, Marge's resentment takes monstrous form, Lisa tries to save the planet through murder and Homer learns he's not the man he thought he was.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E07 - From Beer to Paternity
34.plot: When Homer becomes Duffman's girl-dad hero, they go on a road trip with Lisa that threatens to expose Homer's terrible parenting.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E08 - Step Brother from the Same Planet
34.plot: Homer is stunned by his feelings of rage and resentment when Grampa becomes a doting stepfather to his girlfriend's quirky young son. Lisa and Bart throw the ultimate slumber party.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E09 - When Nelson Met Lisa
34.plot: A future tale of the will-they-won't-they-I-guess-they-won't-maybe-they-will of Springfield's most unlikely couple.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E10 - Game Done Changed
34.plot: When Bart discovers a profitable glitch in an online game, he ropes Principal Skinner into his lucrative criminal enterprise. Marge and Maggie discover paradise.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E11 - Top Goon
34.plot: Coach Moe recruits the world's greatest brawlers to teach Nelson the art of hockey goonery.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E12 - My Life as a Vlog
34.plot: Through a series of YouTube recommended videos, the story of the rise and fall of The Simpson Family Vlog is revealed.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E13 - The Many Saints of Springfield
34.plot: When Ned Flanders falls on hard times, Fat Tony makes him an offer he can't refuse.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E14 - Carl Carlson Rides Again
34.plot: When Carl is smitten by a beautiful woman, he looks into the roots of his own identity by discovering the origins of a mysterious rodeo buckle.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E15 - Bartless
34.plot: When Bart's latest prank leads to chaos at Springfield Elementary, Marge and Homer dream of a world in which their rambunctious son was never a Simpson.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E16 - Hostile Kirk Place
34.plot: When Milhouse's Dad, Kirk, takes exception to a school history lesson that paints one of his ancestors in a bad light, Kirk goes on a crusade to censor and control the school curriculum -- a crusade that Homer co-opts for fun and profit.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E17 - Pin Gal
34.plot: A mysterious figure from Marge's past returns to coach her for a bowling tournament.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E18 - Fan-ily Feud
34.plot: Homer publicly disparages a pop singer and faces the ire of her vindictive and highly organized fan army.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E19 - Write Off This Episode
34.plot: When Marge and Lisa start a charity together, Marge is seduced by the money and prestige of Big Charity fundraising.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E20 - The Very Hungry Caterpillars
34.plot: When a plague of insects shuts down Springfield, the Simpsons face their greatest challenge yet… spending time in lockdown with each other.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E21 - Clown v. Board of Education
34.plot: Krusty opens a school for clowning, and it becomes the most successful thing he's ever done.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E22 - Homer's Adventures Through the Windshield Glass
34.plot: Time stands still after Homer crashes his car and flies through the windshield. As his life flashes before his eyes, a magical friend helps Homer learn the secret truth about his marriage.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E01 - Homer's Crossing
35.plot: Feeling worthless at work, Homer volunteers to be a school crossing guard. But when his safety squad receives too much funding, the crossing guards become a force to be feared.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E02 - A Mid-Childhood Night's Dream
35.plot: Marge feels an overwhelming dread of the empty nest.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E03 - McMansion & Wife
35.plot: When a new neighbor showers him with kindness, Homer thinks he's being tricked into buying a sports car at the dealership where the neighbor works - but the truth turns out to be even more sinister; Lisa neutralizes Nelson after he goes on a bullying spree.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E04 - Thirst Trap: A Corporate Love Story
35.plot: In a parody documentary, a young college-dropout CEO embraces the Silicon Valley "fake it until you make it" philosophy and bewitches Mr. Burns into funding her highly dubious dream project.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E05 - Treehouse of Horror XXXIV
35.plot: After Bart is turned into an NFT, Marge fights though the blockchain to rescue her son. To track down a gruesome serial killer, Lisa turns to a murderer from her past. An outbreak transforms Springfielders into a plague of lazy, beer-loving oafs.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E06 - Iron Marge
35.plot: When Marge's heart is broken by a bad birthday present, Bart and Lisa must dig into their mom's past to show that they really know her. Homer becomes a neighborhood fear-monger.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E07 - It's a Blunderful Life
35.plot: Lisa recounts the story of how Homer was scapegoated for a power outage that plunged Springfield into darkness days before Thanksgiving.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E08 - AE Bonny Romance
35.plot: When Groundskeeper Willie is kidnapped to Scotland, Bart and the Simpsons follow - only to discover that what awaits is Homer's worst nightmare.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E09 - Murder, She Boat
35.plot: Lisa must solve a closed-boat mystery when Comic Book Guy's million-dollar action figure is "murdered" on a pop culture cruise.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E10 - Do the Wrong Thing
35.plot: Homer and Bart become kings of the blue-collar sports circuit, but Marge suspects something dishonest at the core of their father-son bond.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E11 - Frinkenstein's Monster
35.plot: Professor Frink secretly helps Homer, through a zoom interview, land a high-level position at a state-of-the-art nuclear plant in Shelbyville. But since Homer lacks the skills to actually perform the job, Frink must monitor Homer's work situation remotely and dictate his every word... causing Frink to fear he's created a monster.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E12 - Lisa Gets an F1
35.plot: Lisa feels a need for speed as well a need for control of her anxiety when she becomes a pro kid go-cart racer.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E13 - Clan of the Cave Mom
35.plot: A parenting disagreement between Marge and Luann Van Houten escalates into a life-or-death struggle for survival.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E14 - Night of the Living Wage
35.plot: Marge gets a job in a high-pressure ghost kitchen, but when she tries to start a union, she gets more than she (collectively) bargained for.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E15 - Cremains of the Day
35.plot: When someone in Homer's life passes away, he and guys from Moe's go on a road trip to scatter the ashes... but will their friendship die as well?

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E16 - The Tell-Tale Pants
35.plot: Marge comes upon a surprising windfall and, angry with Homer, spends it secretly on herself.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E17 - The Tipping Point
35.plot: Homer loses his mind over tipping culture run amok.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E18 - Bart's Brain

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E01 - Bart's Birthday
36.plot: Bart celebrates the most shocking birthday party of his entire life — one that might just change everyone in Springfield forever.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E02 - The Yellow Lotus
36.plot: The Simpsons encounter death on vacation at a high-end resort.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E03 - Desperately Seeking Lisa
36.plot: Lisa has a blazing misadventure in the dark world of Capital City's downtown art scene.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E04 - Shoddy Heat
36.plot: An unearthed corpse opens up a cold case from Springfield in the 1980s… as well as a steamy relationship between young Grampa and Agnes Skinner.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E06 - Women in Shorts
36.plot: Girls just want to have funny.

36.plot: A tattooed man at a mysterious night circus transports Lisa into three strange stories from the innocent 1950s, the chilling retro-present, and a brutalist future where prestige TV rules the world.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E08 - Convenience Airways
36.plot: The Simpsons are trapped on a flight with the most unruly passengers in America.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E09 - Homer and Her Sisters
36.plot: After a fight in an escape room, Krusty's truth-telling Aunt fixes Homer's relationship with Patty and Selma.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E10 - The Man Who Flew Too Much
36.plot: The new and improved Pin Pals travel to Capital City for their first ever state bowling championship.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E11 - Bottle Episode
36.plot: Marge and Smithers team up to become wine-forging Robin Hoods.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E12 - The Flandshees of Innersimpson
36.plot: Bart dips his toe into the world of celebrity DJ-ing, and Homer finally pushes Flanders too far.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E13 - The Last Man Expanding
36.plot: Springfield becomes hooked on a miracle weight loss drug... all except Homer.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E14 - P.S. I Hate You
36.plot: Marge's "nice-lady" reputation is on the line when an unknown blackmailer threatens to expose the angry woman she is inside.

36.plot: After Grampa and Moe recruit a Macedonian slugger to play in Springfield, it strains their friendship and the very integrity of baseball.

36.plot: Homer reinvigorates a celebrity chef's lost passion for food... with some help from the mob.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E17 - Full Heart, Empty Pool

36.plot: When Bart & Lisa stop watching Itchy & Scratchy together, Marge fears that they'll start to drift apart... but she has no idea how bad things are about to get!

37.plot: When Lisa starts wearing Marge's "vintage" clothes from the 90's, she's welcomed into the school's super-elite fashion club. But as they run out of retro looks, the funky fashionistas become obsessed with getting more... by hook or by crook.

37.title: FR - Les Simpson - S37E02 - Keep Chalm and Gary On
37.plot: Homer gets Superintendent Chalmers a job at the power plant. There, Chalmers discovers huge mutated snails that produce valuable slime launching his new career as a man-o-sphere guru.

37.title: FR - Les Simpson - S37E03 - Treehouse of Horror XXXVI
37.plot: Springfield is threatened by a mysterious killer monster emerging from the sewers, Krusty welcomes a demonic guest to his Halloween special, and the action moves a thousand years into the future in a post-apocalyptic, plastic version of the city.

37.title: FR - Les Simpson - S37E04 - Men Behaving Manly
FR - Les Simpson - S37E05 - Bad Boys... for Life?
37.plot: Is Bart Simpson truly a bad seed? Homer and Marge must find out once and for good.

37.title: FR - Les Simpson - S37E06 - Bart 'N' Frink
37.plot: When Bart becomes Professor Frink's lab assistant, the Simpsons are thrown into a world of tech billionaires determined to live forever, with the future of the internet at stake.

37.title: FR - Les Simpson - S37E07 - Sashes to Sashes
37.plot: Bart runs against Mayor Quimby's son for student council president, while Lisa learns troubling secrets about the Quimby clan... and about the Simpsons.

meta.plot: Située à Springfield, ville américaine moyenne, la série se concentre sur les singeries et les aventures quotidiennes de la famille Simpson : Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa et Maggie, ainsi que des milliers d'autres personnages.

1.title: FR - Comme deux frères - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: The night before a crucial football match, Pini and Nisso are out to make sure the opposition don't get any sleep. Sparks fly when the plan backfires.

1.title: FR - Comme deux frères - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Still in shock from the doctor's announcement, the pair contemplate their futures. Nisso makes a hard decision — before hearing more bad news.

1.title: FR - Comme deux frères - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Still reeling from his diagnosis, Nisso continues acting recklessly. Pini steps in to help, and together they look for new ways to save the bar.

1.title: FR - Comme deux frères - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Pini has his suspicions about the incident next door and decides his partying days are over. Nisso visits Rotem, leaving her even more confused.

1.title: FR - Comme deux frères - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: On a trip away together, Pini looks for a way to explain his decision to his friend. But before he can do so, Nisso gets into even more trouble.

1.title: FR - Comme deux frères - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: A night out proves eventful for the Beitar fans. Searching for a quiet spot, Nisso and Pini end up in a metal bar — and meet some unfriendly regulars.

1.title: FR - Comme deux frères - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: News from last night spreads fast and worries Alma. In Krakow, Nisso avoids Pini and befriends a mysterious stranger.

1.title: FR - Comme deux frères - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Rescued by Pini yet again, Nisso finally tells him the truth. With both their futures depending on the outcome, the long-awaited match kicks off.

meta.plot: Après avoir reçu de troublantes nouvelles, deux meilleurs amis voyagent de Jérusalem à Cracovie pour assister à un match de football dans l'espoir d'oublier leurs soucis.

meta.plot: Le téléroman raconte la vie des locataires d'une résidence étudiante. Avec les jeunes qu'elle accueillait en pension dans sa maison, Louise a certainement joué tous les rôles et les professions possibles: mère, infirmière, confidente, psychologue, agente de probation, etc. Tous ces jeunes étudiants l'aimaient bien et ce n'est pas pour rien que la plupart revenaient à chaque année. Certains finissaient par voler de leurs propres ailes, mais Louise restait toujours disponible pour eux. Malgré tous leurs sentiments pour elle, ils réussissaient à lui en faire voir de toutes les couleurs; guerres entre pensionnaires, amour (souvent surpris en pleine action!), maladie (on introduit le sida par le personnage de Caroline), tours et gaffes, etc. Et ce cher Pete réalisait plus que sa part de frasques et de renversements! Les sept années du téléroman passées à l'antenne ont permis aux téléspectateurs de rire et de pleurer au gré des émissions. Il est à noter que l'engouement qu'a rapidement créé la série (2,5 millions de téléspectateurs), a fait en sorte que TVA a demandé à l'auteur de faire passer de 30 minutes à 60 minutes la durée des épisodes entre la 1re et la 2e saison.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E01 - The Story of Daigo
1.plot: In Japan's Warring States period, Lord Daigo Kagemitsu makes a pact with 12 demons, offering them his unborn son in exchange for the prosperity of his lands. Years later, young thief Dororo is attacked by a ghoul but rescued by a mysterious boy, whose body parts turn out to be almost entirely prosthetic.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E02 - The Story of Bandai
1.plot: Dororo and Hyakkimaru happen upon a village and are brought before its chief, Lady Bandai. However, Hyakkimaru inexplicably draws his sword in her presence, resulting in both him and Dororo being locked in a storehouse by the villagers. It turns out they are not the only ones confined there...

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E02 - The Story of Bandai
1.plot: Dororo and Hyakkimaru happen upon a village and are brought before its chief, Lady Bandai. However, Hyakkimaru inexplicably draws his sword in her presence, resulting in both him and Dororo being locked in a storehouse by the villagers. It turns out they are not the only ones confined there...

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E03 - The Story of Jukai
1.plot: Jukai is a doctor who travels the land fitting prosthetic arms and legs to those who have lost their limbs in war. One day, on the riverbank he finds a baby missing most of its body parts. He decides to raise the child, who he names “Hyakkimaru”. Jukai provides the child with prostheses, but the time comes when Hyakkimaru sets out on a journey to recover his own body parts.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E04 - The Story of the Cursed Sword
1.plot: Dororo Onikimaru confronts Tanosuke, a manly slaughter. The sword he wields was a cursed decoy where the devil lives. Although barely dismissing Tanosuke, the military sword has passed over to the hands of the hands and the horsemans are manipulated by the weapon.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E05 - The Story of the Moriko Song, Part 1
1.plot: Struggling to adapt to an unfamiliar world of "sound", Hyakkimaru is injured in a fight with a ghoul. He is taken in and nursed by a girl named Mio, who looks after children orphaned by war. However, after becoming aware of a demon nearby, Hyakkimaru heads out to fight it before he is fully recovered.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E06 - The Story of the Moriko Song, Part 2
1.plot: Hyakkimaru has regained his voice from the devil god, but one leg was stolen from him. After returning to the deserted temple and having his wounds taken care of, he again goes into battle with the demon. Meanwhile, in the abandoned temple where Mio and the children are waiting ...

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E07 - The Story of the Jorogumo Silk Spider
1.plot: The spider-like ghoul Jorogumo is wounded by Hyakkimaru. To heal itself, it transforms into a woman and takes advantage of the hospitality of a young man named Yajiro. Having let Jorogumo slip through their fingers, Dororo and Hyakkimaru stop at a village where they hear rumors of a kidnapper at large.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E08 - The Story of Saru
1.plot: At a certain village, young girls are offered up as ritual sacrifices to appease a giant centipede demon that appears shrouded in black clouds. Hyakkimaru and Dororo team up with Saru, a boy whose older sister has been offered as a sacrifice, and together they confront the demon.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E09 - The Story of Mercilessness
1.plot: Dororo comes down with a high fever. While woozy from its effects, the youngster catches a glimpse of some red spider lilies, which stirs up memories of past days spent with parents Hibukuro and Ojiya.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E10 - The Story of Tahomaru
1.plot: A village within Daigo's domain is being terrorized by a ghoul that dwells in a nearby lake. Tahomaru, accompanied by his aides Hyogo and Mutsu, volunteers to exterminate the ghoul.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E11 - The Story of Banmon, Part 1
1.plot: After entering Lord Daigo's domain, Dororo and Hyakkimaru hear tales of Banmon, the huge wall that is the last remnant of a fort that once stood on the border. Hyakkimaru squares off against the fox demon that haunts the wall.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E12 - The Story of Banmon, Part 2
1.plot: Kagemitsu, who offered up his own son to the demons. Hyakkimaru, who is trying to get back the body parts that were taken from him. As if drawn together by fate, they face each other.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E13 - The Story of the Blank-faced Buddha
1.plot: Having left Daigo's domain, Dororo finds a statue of Fudo, one of the wisdom gods. But the statue is actually a demon that is harvesting humans' faces in an attempt to find one for itself.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E14 - The Story of Sabame
1.plot: Dororo and Hyakkimaru come across an abandoned, burnt-out temple, where they meet a man named Sabame who rules the surrounding area. Sabame invites the two of them to his residence and tells them the story behind the burnt-out temple and the ghoul that haunts it. However, Dororo and Hyakkimaru suspect that he might not be telling the truth.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E15 - The Story of the Scene from Hell
1.plot: Sabame has been feeding people to the demons to protect the village over which he rules. As Hyakkimaru once again confronts the demon moths, Dororo gets trapped in a storehouse.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E16 - The Story of Shiranui
1.plot: Dororo has been captured by Itachi and is being taken to the cape where Hibukuro supposedly hid the money. As Itachi and his men look for boats to get across to the cape, they are approached by a one-armed boy named Shiranui.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E17 - The Story of Questions and Answers
1.plot: Jukai is reunited with a bloodied Hyakkimaru at the site of a recent battle, and finds out the truth of how Hyakkimaru and the demons are connected. Hyakkimaru asks Jukai for a new prosthetic leg, but...

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E18 - The Story of the Cape of Impermanence
1.plot: The shark demon lets out a roar and attacks Dororo, who is tied up and unable to move. Meanwhile, a troop of soldiers commanded by Tahomaru is also approaching the cape.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E19 - The Story of the Amanojaku
1.plot: To fix Hyakkimaru's broken sword, he and Dororo travel to a village where a master swordmaker named Munetsuna lives. Upon arriving at Munetsuna's house, they are met by his daughter Okowa.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E20 - The Story of Nue

L’émerveillement se transforme rapidement en cauchemar quand il essaie de retourner à sa réalité perdue dans le paysage hallucinant des vies qu’il aurait pu vivre. Dans ce labyrinthe de réalités, il s’embarque dans un voyage éprouvant pour retrouver sa véritable famille et la sauver de l’ennemi le plus terrifiant et invincible : lui-même.

4.plot: Dora's mami is having a baby and Dora is eagerly awaiting the new arrival...she just can't wait to be a big sister! But when Dora arrives to see the new baby, there's a big surprise waiting for her...Twins! Now Dora has a baby brother and a baby sister!

4.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S04E19 - Dora's World Adventure
4.plot: Dora and her friends are excited to celebrate Friendship Day. Soon, they run into a problem when they realize that Swiper has stolen all of the friendship bracelets from around the world. The bracelets won't glow unless everyone from each country wears them, so Dora offers to help Swiper give them back. Along the way, they meet some of Dora's friends in France, Tanzania, Russia, and China.

4.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S04E20 - Star Mountain
4.plot: One night in Dora's house, Dora with her family and friends are having dinner. Dora tells the story about how she first met Boots, it was the during the first time she ever went out exploring. As Dora the Boots go exploring they met the others on the way (Tico, Isa, Benny), when they met the Fiesta Trio who were on their way to perform for the Queen Bee. As they leave they dropped their instruments. Dora and Boots helps take the instruments back to the Fiesta Trio by going through the Nutty Forest, across the Big River and up the Tallest Mountain.

4.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S04E21 - Baby Crab
4.plot: Dora and Boots are playing in the beach, there they hear a call for help from a Baby Crab that is caught in a net. After freeing the Baby Crab and cheering him up, they discover that Baby Crab is lost and is far away from him. Dora and Boots helps Baby Crab get home to his mommy by going through the Sand Castle, through the Snapping Clams and to Crab Island.

4.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S04E22 - La Maestra de Musica (The Music Teacher)
4.plot: Dora and Boots are going to school, on their way they heard someone singing Boots' favorite song. Following the song they discovered it was coming from a lady on a bike, it was Boots' "La Maestra Musica" (Boots' Music Teacher). Boots introduces Dora to his Music Teacher, when they heard the school bell La Maestra had to get to school before all the students does. When La Maestra's bike chain broke down, Dora and Boots helps La Maestra by going through the Town, over Musical Mountain and to the School.

4.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S04E23 - Dora Saves the Mermaids
4.plot: Dora and Boots set out to help Mariana the mermaid recover the magic crown to wish the Mermaid Kingdom to be clean again, and to stop an evil octopus from dumping garbage all over.

4.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S04E24 - Super Spies
4.plot: Dora and Boots need to stop Swiper from swiping Isa's cupcakes by using spy goggles, rocket boots and a spy rope.

5.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S05E01 - The Backpack Parade
5.plot: Dora, Luis and the Backpack are on their way to a parade until Backpack sneezes because of her allergies and drops all the contents of her Backpack.

5.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S05E02 - Benny's Big Race
5.plot: Dora, Botas e Diego estão todos prontos para a festa dos Três Reis! Mas Raposo assustou todos os animais! Será que eles vão conseguir a tempo?

5.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S05E03 - Isa's Unicorn Flowers
5.plot: Dora and Isa help a baby unicorn get back to the unicorn's forest after he gets lost when his magical rainbow disappears.

5.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S05E04 - Dora's Jack-in-the-Box
5.plot: Help the Big Red Chicken perform his magic show!
