1.title: FR - Le Griffon - S01E04 - Easy Peasy
1.plot: Mark and Memo hatch out a plan to free Thomas. Becky doesn't suspect a thing. She is convinced that Mark is imagining everything. So is his mother, who wants him committed to a psychiatric ward. Will Mark manage to escape?

1.title: FR - Le Griffon - S01E05 - He's Ready
1.plot: While Mark and Memo prepare for the arrival of the horned ones, Becky tries to convince Mark's mother that he is not suffering from delusions. But then fate takes a gruesome turn.

1.title: FR - Le Griffon - S01E06 - Feel your Hatred!
1.plot: Mark's mother receives a shocking tip from Bräker about her husband's death. Mark and Memo face the ultimate horror in the tower world.

meta.plot: The Gryphon, a dark power from another world, is a threat to Mark and all he loves. Mark must accept his heavy family legacy and go into battle to save our world from the Gryphon’s clutches.

1.title: FR - Faux profil - S01E08 - Temptation in the Dark

1.plot: Camila refuses to assist with an event, and is promptly reminded of what’s at stake if she doesn’t. What Pedro discovers provokes a hellish response.

1.title: FR - Faux profil - S01E10 - Don't Say Anything
1.plot: An accident leaves the community mourning. Something unthinkable comes to light as a visit to Ángela culminates in a calamitous scene.

1.title: FR - Cecilia - S01E02 - Confessional

1.title: FR - Cecilia - S01E05 - Uninhibited

1.title: FR - Cecilia - S01E06 - Mamma Said
1.plot: Cecilia, prior to undergoing surgery, invites her family over for breakfast to celebrate Mother's Day. Unexpectedly, everyone ignores her. Apparently, they are busy dealing with their own issues.

1.title: FR - Cecilia - S01E07 - Botanical Garden

meta.plot: The story of a woman whose world seemingly crumbles when she suffers a stroke. What at first seems like a tragedy ends up being an opportunity to reunite her family and rebuild her life.

1.title: FR - Diamants bruts - S01E05 - Episode 5

1.title: FR - Tiny Beautiful Things - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: We meet Clare as her husband, Danny, has kicked her out of their home for giving her brother Lucas their daughter Rae’s college fund. But an old friend needs someone to take on his advice column Dear Sugar. And it might be exactly what Clare needs.

1.title: FR - Tiny Beautiful Things - S01E02 - Yours, Sugar
1.plot: Clare grapples with whether or not she wants to become Sugar as she reels from trouble at work and with Rae. In the past, Young Clare and Young Lucas must confront their grief at Frankie’s funeral. If Clare can’t figure out her own life, can she be Sugar?

1.title: FR - Tiny Beautiful Things - S01E03 - The Ghost Ship
1.plot: Danny and Clare try to untangle their relationship – and Rae’s threesome – as Clare considers her path not taken.  In the past, Young Clare finds out she’s pregnant with Rae.

1.title: FR - Tiny Beautiful Things - S01E04 - Under the Stars
1.plot: As Clare deals with her Tik-Tok-famous Montana confrontation and Rae’s recent partying, she’s haunted by a letter writer who desperately needs Sugar’s advice.  In the past, Young Clare learns of Frankie’s diagnosis and desperately tries to save her.

1.title: FR - Tiny Beautiful Things - S01E05 - The Nose
1.plot: When a furious Rae tells Clare and Danny that she doesn’t want to go back to her school, Clare remembers her own college experience with Frankie – and the reason she never got her degree.

1.title: FR - Tiny Beautiful Things - S01E06 - Broken Things
1.plot: Danny and Clare take a good (ahem) hard look at their sex life as a letter writer writes in about her boyfriend’s secret shame. Meanwhile, Rae grapples with letting Montana back into her life as she realizes she might just have the upper hand.

1.title: FR - Tiny Beautiful Things - S01E07 - Go
1.plot: Clare and Amy attend a writer’s retreat, but when Amy gets great news, Clare can’t help but question if her sacrifices for Danny and their family have been holding her back. As she remembers her first marriage to Jess, she wonders: should she stay or go?

1.title: FR - Tiny Beautiful Things - S01E08 - Love
1.plot: Fresh off shocking news from Danny, Rae reveals who really dropped off the missing money – causing Clare to bring Rae along on a mad dash road trip to Clare’s childhood home. In the past, Clare rushes to get Lucas to the hospital for Frankie’s last days.

meta.plot: A floundering writer becomes a revered advice columnist while her own life is falling apart.

FR - Sauver Lisa - S01E02 - Episode 2

FR - L'Art d'être riche - S01E01 - Design Your Rich Life
1.plot: Have you ever wondered how much people make and how much they spend? Three families meet with Ramit and put their financial histories in his hands.

1.title: FR - L'Art d'être riche - S01E02 - Financial Hot Water
1.plot: Twelve credit cards between two people, a potential $1.3 million lost to interest and fees — these money missteps give Ramit lots to work with.

1.title: FR - L'Art d'être riche - S01E03 - HOA Not Okay
1.plot: Ramit debates the merits of home ownership. Then, he helps a couple work better together and evaluates one family's conscious spending habits.

1.title: FR - L'Art d'être riche - S01E04 - New Cash, Old Problems
1.plot: To give a couple a taste of the rich life, Ramit takes them on a fantasy getaway. Then, he meets with a reality star who needs help with his spending.

1.title: FR - L'Art d'être riche - S01E05 - Pet Checking Accounts
1.plot: A recently engaged drag performer living paycheck to paycheck needs to get his finances in order. A couple with a good portfolio makes risky investments.

1.title: FR - L'Art d'être riche - S01E06 - Mult-Level Marketing Madness
1.plot: Ramit helps a couple who say they're financial opposites to plan for their wedding. Next, he broaches the topic of multilevel marketing with a client.

1.title: FR - L'Art d'être riche - S01E07 - Bills & Wedding Bells
1.plot: One couple has an honest dialogue about credit card debt, while another throws their wedding budget out the window upon finding the dream dress.

1.title: FR - L'Art d'être riche - S01E08 - Destination Rich Life
1.plot: One couple learns to speak the same financial language, another makes a plan to pay off personal debt and a third achieves their financial dream.

meta.plot: Money holds power over us — but it doesn't have to. Finance expert Ramit Sethi works with people across the US to help them achieve their richest lives.

1.title: FR - Désobéir : le choix de Chantale Daigle - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: 1988. Chantale is living a fairy tale with Jean-Guy. Eight months later, she wants to terminate her pregnancy. Her ex does not agree.

1.title: FR - Désobéir : le choix de Chantale Daigle - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Chantale fights against the court order preventing her from having an abortion. How could she remain unaware of Jean-Guy's true nature?

1.title: FR - Désobéir : le choix de Chantale Daigle - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Chantale files an appeal. Jean-Guy strengthens his grip. Pro-choice activists organize a fightback.

1.title: FR - Désobéir : le choix de Chantale Daigle - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Chantale is waiting for the Court of Appeal's decision. Jean-Guy suffers the consequences of his fight. Pro-choicers and pro-lifers clash.

1.title: FR - Désobéir : le choix de Chantale Daigle - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: While the lawyers prepare for the Supreme Court, Chantale takes her fate into her own hands. Jean-Guy feels that something is going on.

1.title: FR - Désobéir : le choix de Chantale Daigle - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Chantale was able to terminate her pregnancy, but she is not yet out of the woods. If her secret gets out, she could be in big trouble.

meta.plot: The story of the famous 1989 trial of Chantale Daigle vs Jean-Guy Tremblay. Pregnant at the time of their breakup, Chantale decides to have an abortion. Jean-Guy wants to stop her. This battle goes all the way to the Supreme Court of Canada.

1.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S01E01 - Welcome to Essex
1.plot: As they start settling into college life, first-year suite mates Kimberly, Bela, Leighton, and Whitney navigate relationships, extracurriculars, and culture shock. Later, the girls hit an exclusive party to blow off some steam.

1.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S01E02 - Naked Party
1.plot: The first week of class finds Kimberly feeling out of her league, while Leighton thrives academically… but not so much otherwise. Whitney confronts soccer drama, and – looking to get properly wild – Bela and Kimberly go to a naked party.

1.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S01E03 - Le Tuteur
1.plot: While Kimberly connects with Nico during a tutoring session, Leighton begrudgingly starts volunteering at the women's center, Bela explores the local dating app pool, and Whitney seeks to take things with Dalton to the next level.

1.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S01E04 - Kappa
1.plot: After mingling with an exclusive sorority, Leighton gets roped into a date with a boy, while Whitney confides in a teammate about her relationship with Dalton. With Kimberly in tow, Bela speaks her mind at a high-profile Catullan event.

1.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S01E05 - That Comment Tho
1.plot: While a cryptic message from Nico sends Kimberly reeling, Leighton invites the women's center to her brother's frat party. Bela has an uncomfortable experience with a Catullan editor, and Whitney navigates the fallout of investigative work.

1.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S01E06 - Parents Weekend
1.plot: After reuniting with their families for the first time since move-in day, the girls struggle through an uncomfortable dinner, where parents clash, egos are bruised, and secrets are revealed.

1.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S01E07 - I Think I'm a Sex Addict
1.plot: While Bela anxiously awaits the Catullan's final decision, Kimberly gets hooked on casual sex with Nico, Whitney explores her connection with Canaan, and Leighton takes the next step with Alicia.

1.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S01E08 - The Surprise Party
1.plot: At Leighton's surprise party for Nico, an unexpected guest sends Kimberly reeling. Bela worries she silenced a fellow Catullan writer, and a rumor threatens to upend Whitney's world.

1.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S01E09 - Cheating
1.plot: A heartbroken Kimberly considers cheating on an exam. Leighton's fear of coming out upends her weekend getaway with Alicia. Bela navigates the fallout of exposing assault. Whitney confronts the truth about Dalton.

1.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S01E10 - The Truth
1.plot: While Kimberly faces possible expulsion after her honor code violation, Bela takes a stand against the Catullan's culture, Whitney levels with her mom, and Leighton speaks her truth.

2.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S02E01 - Winter Is Coming
2.plot: As they come to terms with their new status on campus, Bela creates an all-female humor magazine, Whitney copes with the off-season, and Kimberly tries to find money with Leighton's unexpected help.

2.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S02E02 - Frat Problems
2.plot: Bela and Leighton organize a fundraiser to help Zeta so they can get back to their parties. Kimberly tries to find collateral for her loan and Whitney feels threatened by Canaan's new partner.

2.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S02E03 - The Short King
2.plot: While Leighton enjoys the perks of being out, Bela focuses on a short king. Whitney attempts to expand her horizons with a difficult class, and Kimberly considers a new fix for her money problems.

2.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S02E04 - Will You Be My Girlfriend?
2.plot: Bela scrambles to expand The Foxy's reach ahead of its release. Jackson invites Kimberly to a study session. Canaan asks Whitney to be his girlfriend… but she already thought they were dating. Leighton gets called out.

2.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S02E05 - Taking Shots
2.plot: Leighton helps Kimberly administer her hormone injections. Whitney considers how to handle being repeatedly mistaken for the only other Black girl in class. Bela clashes with her Catullan replacement.

2.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S02E06 - Doppelbanger
2.plot: Bela seizes an opportunity when a late-night comic visits campus. Kimberly attempts to prove she hasn't been “med-zoned” by Jackson. Whitney fights to contribute to a group assignment. Leighton pursues a junior… who reminds her of herself.

2.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S02E07 - The Essex College Food Workers Strike
2.plot: Leighton grapples with "dating up" for the first time. Kimberly appeals to an unlikely source for help with the food workers' strike. Whitney sets out to crush her final lab. Bela's faces blowback from a misstep.

2.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S02E08 - Pre-Frosh Weekend
2.plot: For Pre-Frosh Weekend, Bela hosts her nerdy childhood friend Priya, who's had a surprise glow-up. Leighton prepares to come out to her dad. Kimberly seeks commonalities with Jackson, while Whitney finds chemistry with her lab partner.

2.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S02E09 - Sex & Basketball
2.plot: Whitney and Andrew attempt to bring their chemistry into the real world. Bela over-curates The Foxy’s big spotlight. Kimberly accompanies Canaan to the Econ department’s awards banquet. Leighton visits the women’s center – and Alicia.

2.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S02E10 - The Rooming Lottery
2.plot: When Leighton is elected Kappa’s campus social chair, the roommates must figure out what sophomore year will look like.

3.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S03E01 - Welcome Back to Essex
3.plot: As their sophomore year begins, Kimberly is determined to mend her friendship with Whitney. Meanwhile, Bela attempts to change her ways with a new opportunity, and Alicia drops a bomb on Leighton.

3.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S03E02 - Lila by Lila
3.plot: Kimberly tries to upgrade her dorm, Whitney has a specific gripe with a hot classmate, Bella struggles as a FAF and Leighton thinks on her future.

3.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S03E03 - Four to a Suite
3.plot: The girls meet their new roommate, Kacey. Bela weighs whether a nice guy is hot or not, Kimberly visits her first sex shop, and Whitney's increasingly busy schedule leads to some complications with a professor.

3.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S03E04 - Franklin the Fox
3.plot: Bela hooks up with the mascot, Kacey puts herself out there, Whitney struggles to find balance in her life, and Kimberly goes to her first rave.

3.title: FR - The Sex Lives of College Girls - S03E05 - Parents Weekend 2
3.plot: It's Parents Weekend at Essex once again! The girls do everything they can to keep their visiting families out of their dating lives, all while conducting an important science experiment for Bela and learning more about their new roommate Kacey.

meta.plot: Follow four college roommates as they arrive at New England’s prestigious Essex College. A bundle of contradictions and hormones, these girls are equal parts lovable and infuriating as they live out their new, free lives on campus.

1.title: FR - Les bonnes mères - S01E01 - Nella Bocca Del Lupo
1.plot: Anna Colace prepares a revolutionary strategy to challenge the ‘Ndrangheta. Lea Garofalo and her daughter Denise reconnect with their husband and father, Carlo Cosco, hoping to reconcile and put an end to their years of living on the run.

1.title: FR - Les bonnes mères - S01E02 - Famiglia E Lealta
1.plot: Denise is catapulted into an unknown world after a devastating tragedy. Meanwhile, Anna initiates a surveillance operation on the women of the ‘Ndrangheta, focusing on Giuseppina Pesce and Maria Concetta Cacciola.

1.title: FR - Les bonnes mères - S01E03 - Un'altra Vita
1.plot: When migrants whom the Ndrangheta have exploited spill out into the streets to protest their working conditions, Anna makes a risky phone call to accelerate a new phase of her operation. The search for Lea makes significant progress in the meantime.

1.title: FR - Les bonnes mères - S01E04 - Tradimento
1.plot: As the Pesce clan falters after Giuseppina’s arrest, Anna turns her attention to another potential witness: Maria Concetta Cacciola. In the meantime, Denise leaves Reggio Calabria to meet an old acquaintance.

1.title: FR - Les bonnes mères - S01E05 - Madri e figli
1.plot: Giuseppina’s decision to collaborate enables Anna to attack members of the ‘Ndrangheta clans. Her tactics clash with those in the media. Maria Concetta takes matters into her own hands, Giuseppina faces a new challenge and Denise learns a shocking secret.

1.title: FR - Les bonnes mères - S01E06 - Coraggio
1.plot: Anna Colace suffers a setback with Giuseppina. Maria Concetta fights against her new life in isolation and Denise returns to Dalia Masi in order to honour her mother’s memory.

meta.plot: The true story of three courageous women inside the notorious Calabrian ‘Ndrangheta mafia, working with newly-minted female prosecutor, Alessandra Cerreti, to bring down down the criminal empire.

1.title: FR - Florida murders - S01E01 - To Bell or Not To Bell?
1.plot: When a dead body is found on his property, Bell suspects it is connected to an unsolved murder.

1.title: FR - Florida murders - S01E02 - One Billboard Outside Boggsville, Florida
1.plot: Cammie and Bell search for clues to Vida's final days; Cammie receives a surprise visit.

1.title: FR - Florida murders - S01E03 - A Fistful of Sand Dollars
1.plot: Bell is visited by one of Vida's family members; Cammie checks out the Perez's beach home.

1.title: FR - Florida murders - S01E04 - Sex, Lies and Ponce de Leon
1.plot: Cammie finds evidence that could implicate Bell; Bell ventures off the property.

1.title: FR - Florida murders - S01E05 - One Flew Over the Peacock's Nest
1.plot: Bell and Cammie learn another person has been killed; Cammie is pressured to turn over evidence.

1.title: FR - Florida murders - S01E06 - Fear and Loathing in El Calvero
1.plot: Cammie takes Bell on a road trip; Millicent is left alone for the first time in years.

1.title: FR - Florida murders - S01E07 - Machetes Out
1.plot: Bell and Cammie attempt to steal highly confidential files; Bell calls a family dinner.

1.title: FR - Florida murders - S01E08 - Cammie Get Your Gun
1.plot: Bell struggles with his lack of closure; Cammie faces a tense mediation.

meta.plot: Since personal tragedy struck five years ago, loquacious, eccentric Bell Prescott hasn't left the rambling property on the Apalachicola River that he shares with his mother.

1.title: FR - Furtive - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: After her husband, Max, is released from jail but doesn't arrive home, Zenzi Mwale struggles to find him — and gets pulled into a deadly criminal web.

1.title: FR - Furtive - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Zenzi encounters one dead end after another in her search for Max. Enrico threatens to leave her homeless, while Raymond proposes a risky job.

1.title: FR - Furtive - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The police begin to question Zenzi when another suspicious death occurs. Lufuno attempts to learn more about Zenzi's life for his book.

1.title: FR - Furtive - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Zenzi has a harrowing night. Later, the truth of Max's crime and Esulu's death begins to emerge. Fearing for Zenzi's safety, Lufuno calls Naledi.

1.title: FR - Furtive - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: After fleeing town, Zenzi encounters new revelations and perilous obstacles. The police investigation widens, while Joseph's silence worries Raymond.

1.title: FR - Furtive - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: In her furious search for the truth, Zenzi confronts the shooter who tore her family apart. A showdown at Blessing's club may push Zenzi to the brink.

2.title: FR - Furtive - S02E01 - Wallflower
2.plot: Zenzi’s new reality brings with it enemies and alliances, as prison life proves to be harsher than she expected. Detective Lyners begins to dig deeper.

2.title: FR - Furtive - S02E02 - What You Won't Do For Love
2.plot: In the wake of murder, Detective Morkel’s rage sends him on a vengeance-filled mission and Zenzi shows up injured on her sister’s front doorstep.

2.title: FR - Furtive - S02E03 - Homecoming
2.plot: Zenzi’s clean escape is deterred when TK’s threats move to the safety of her sister, but will her protection be enough when the past comes knocking?

2.title: FR - Furtive - S02E04 - Reckoning
2.plot: Detective Morkel goes against orders looking for the truth. Zenzi is now caught between hell and incarceration as law enforcement catches up with her.

2.title: FR - Furtive - S02E05 - Wolves
2.plot: Naledi and her sister part ways, but when Zenzi reaches Lufuno, his fate has already been sealed. Meanwhile, an unlikely partnership is formed.

2.title: FR - Furtive - S02E06 - Collision
2.plot: The tapestry weaves together as police, outlaws and felons all find themselves at Andrew Harting’s trust event. Will Zenzi finally find her vengeance?

meta.plot: A house cleaner desperately searches for her husband as a dreaded criminal syndicate dredges up past tragedies and ultimately drives her to violence.

1.title: FR - Irvine Welsh's Crime - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: DI Ray Lennox and his partner are investigating the disappearance of schoolgirl.

1.title: FR - Irvine Welsh's Crime - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: As Lennox wrestles with his sobriety, the investigation continues.

1.title: FR - Irvine Welsh's Crime - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Lennox must use all his guile and cunning to expose those with something to hide.

1.title: FR - Irvine Welsh's Crime - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Another young girl has gone missing, but Lennox thinks he can lure the perpetrator in.

1.title: FR - Irvine Welsh's Crime - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Lennox interrogates the suspect about the girl. Will he be able to save her in time?

1.title: FR - Irvine Welsh's Crime - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Lennox must face his demons to help him uncover the truth about the case.

2.title: FR - Irvine Welsh's Crime - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: DI Ray Lennox is back - determined to prove he can put the Confectioner case behind him and be a normal cop. When an ex-colleague is assaulted, Lennox gets stuck into a new case.

2.title: FR - Irvine Welsh's Crime - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: There’s a development in the case when a body turns up with similar injuries to the victim of the rumoured hotel attack. The victim has an obscure message carved into his body.

2.title: FR - Irvine Welsh's Crime - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: The attacker floods the internet with their manifesto and declares there will be a third victim. The race is on for Lennox and his team to prevent another death.

2.title: FR - Irvine Welsh's Crime - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: The case continues to evade Lennox; he has a connection between the victims but can’t find a motive. As he struggles to find answers, Lennox’s past trauma comes back hard.

2.title: FR - Irvine Welsh's Crime - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: As Lennox wrestles with the consequences of his actions, the hunt to catch the killer ramps up when one of his own team is targeted. Lennox and Drummond look back at a 1992 case.

2.title: FR - Irvine Welsh's Crime - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: As the series hurtles to a climax, Lennox makes a shocking discovery that turns the case on its head; all is not as it seems and the truth behind these murders lies closer to home.

meta.plot: Detective Inspector Ray Lennox investigates the disappearance of a schoolgirl while battling cocaine addiction and a mental breakdown.

1.title: FR - Hasta el cielo : La série - S01E01 - The Living and the Dead
1.plot: Sole starts collaborating with her late husband's gang of smash-and-grab thieves, who've recently welcomed mysterious Fernan. But her past comes calling.

1.title: FR - Hasta el cielo : La série - S01E02 - New Friendships, Old Enemies
1.plot: A big heist shakes up Sole's relationship with her father, who reveals an eye-opening secret from the past. Rosa unveils her objectives.

1.title: FR - Hasta el cielo : La série - S01E03 - Settling Old Scores
1.plot: An old friend returns from the past with a lucrative but risky proposal. Rosa spies on Mercedes by getting closer to her daughter, Marta.

1.title: FR - Hasta el cielo : La série - S01E04 - Trojan Horse
1.plot: Sole's trust in Fernan is challenged in Paris when a massive heist is put on the table. Rogelio tries to figure out who Duque's mole is.

1.title: FR - Hasta el cielo : La série - S01E05 - Stirring Up a Hornet's Nest
1.plot: While Sole deals with the consequences of Poli's robbery, Mercedes suffers an unpleasant surprise that threatens her life, as well as Rosa's and Marta's.

1.title: FR - Hasta el cielo : La série - S01E06 - Parents and Children
1.plot: Tensions increase between Sole and Mercedes after their latest discoveries. Marta is determined to find her father. Fernan's mission takes a risky turn.

1.title: FR - Hasta el cielo : La série - S01E07 - In the Lion's Den
1.plot: The truth about Estrella's death comes finally to light, and Sole plans her ultimate revenge in Nigeria. Rogelio gives a warning about Fernan.

meta.plot: To remain independent of her father, who is a stolen goods trafficker, a newly widowed single mom joins her late husband’s gang of smash-and-grab thieves.

1.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - The Heirs of the Dragon
1.plot: Viserys hosts a tournament to celebrate the birth of his second child. Rhaenyra welcomes her uncle Daemon back to the Red Keep.

1.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - The Rogue Prince
1.plot: Princess Rhaenyra dives deep into the prophecies about House Targaryen while confronting a realm that resists the idea of a woman on the Iron Throne, and Prince Daemon, embittered over being passed over as the heir to Westeros, prepares to go to war.

1.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Second of His Name
1.plot: Daemon and the Sea Snake battle the Crabfeeder. The realm celebrates Aegon's second nameday. Rhaenyra faces the prospect of marriage.

1.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - King of the Narrow Sea
1.plot: Daemon returns to court after the successful completion of the battle. Princess Rhaenyra must deal with potential suitors in order to keep her line of succession.

1.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - We Light the Way
1.plot: Daemon visits his wife in the Vale. Viserys and Rhaenyra broker agreements with the Valeryons. Alicent seeks the truth about the princess.

1.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - The Princess and the Queen
1.plot: Ten years later. Rhaenyra navigates Alicent's continued speculation about her children, while Daemon and Laena weigh an offer in Pentos.

1.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Driftmark
1.plot: As the families gather on Driftmark for a funeral, Viserys calls for an end to infighting and Alicent demands justice.

1.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - The Lord of the Tides
1.plot: Six years later. With the Driftmark succession suddenly critical, Rhaenyra attempts to strike a bargain with Rhaenys.

1.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - The Green Council
1.plot: While Alicent enlists Cole and Aemond to track down Aegon, Otto gathers the great houses of Westeros to affirm their allegiance.

1.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - The Black Queen
1.plot: Mourning a tragic death, Rhaenyra tries to hold the kingdom together and Daemon prepares for war.

2.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S02E01 - A Son for a Son
2.plot: While Rhaenyra struggles to come to terms with her son's murder, in King's Landing, Alicent grows concerned that Aegon's Small Council may lead them to an all-out war. Larys suggests Aegon needs a new Hand, and Rhaenyra arrives at a fateful decision.

2.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S02E02 - Rhaenyra the Cruel
2.plot: As Otto schemes to turn the public against her, Rhaenyra questions Daemon's loyalty. Meanwhile, Ser Criston Cole concocts a misguided plan for revenge.

2.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S02E03 - The Burning Mill
2.plot: As ancient grudges resurface, Rhaenys suggests that Alicent may see reason while the men around her seek bloodshed. Ser Criston proposes a bold scheme. Daemon arrives at Harrenhal to raise an army for the Blacks.

2.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S02E04 - The Red Dragon and the Gold
2.plot: In Rhaenyra's absence and with no word from Daemon at Harrenhal, Rhaenys tries to keep the peace on the Black Council as Cole mounts a campaign into the Crownlands. In King's Landing, Aemond continues to undermine Aegon's fragile hold on authority.

2.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S02E05 - Regent
2.plot: Amid whispers of bad omens, the Greens consider how to fill a void on Aegon's Council, Jacaerys sets out on a rogue mission to strike a deal, and Daemon enlists Lord Willem Blackwood to help persuade the Brackens to bend the knee.

2.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S02E06 - Smallfolk
2.plot: With few options left, Rhaenyra summons a trusted knight for a risky venture and plots with Mysaria to catalyze the smallfolk. Meanwhile, Daemon's unease grows, and Aemond takes steps to reshape the Green Council.

2.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S02E07 - The Red Sowing
2.plot: As Rhaenyra looks to gain an advantage by unusual means, Daemon pressures a young liege lord to raise up his bannermen.

2.title: FR - House of the Dragon [VOSTFR] - S02E08 - The Queen Who Ever Was
2.plot: As Aemond becomes more volatile, Larys plots an escape, and Alicent grows more concerned about Helaena's safety. Flush with new power, Rhaenyra looks to press her advantage.

meta.plot: The Targaryen dynasty is at the absolute apex of its power, with more than 15 dragons under their yoke. Most empires crumble from such heights. In the case of the Targaryens, their slow fall begins when King Viserys breaks with a century of tradition by naming his daughter Rhaenyra heir to the Iron Throne. But when Viserys later fathers a son, the court is shocked when Rhaenyra retains her status as his heir, and seeds of division sow friction across the realm.

3.plot: Angie's college roommate calls for help when a bottle of wine is stolen.

3.title: FR - Private Eyes - S03E06 - Hog Day Afternoon
3.plot: Shade ends up in the middle of a hostage situation in a high-rise office, while Maz attempts to control the situation on the ground.

3.title: FR - Private Eyes - S03E07 - Dance Dance Retribution
3.plot: When Becca calls on Shade and Angie to investigate a series of potentially supernatural accidents that threaten to derail her new TV special, the PI's find themselves tap dancing their way through the cut throat world of reality television.

3.title: FR - Private Eyes - S03E08 - The Conroy Curse
3.plot: Deputy Conroy needs help with a murder case.

3.title: FR - Private Eyes - S03E09 - It Happened One Fight
3.plot: Angie and Shade investigate the mysterious collapse of Zoe's Cousin.

3.title: FR - Private Eyes - S03E10 - Tex Therapy
3.plot: Shade and Angie investigate Tex, a charming man with amnesia who may be linked to an expensive art heist.

3.title: FR - Private Eyes - S03E11 - Aye, Aye, Tonya
3.plot: Shade and Angie think they're uncovering a simple case of infidelity when they're swept onto the high seas aboard a pirate-themed cruise ship where costumes, treasure, and eye patches are just a cover for a more insidious scheme.

3.title: FR - Private Eyes - S03E12 - Glazed and Confused
3.plot: Angie's long-time nemesis Norm Glinski fakes his own death, and hires her and Shade to investigate.

meta.plot: Ex-pro hockey player Matt Shade irrevocably changes his life when he teams up with fierce P.I. Angie Everett to form an unlikely investigative powerhouse.

1.title: FR - McMafia - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: After a tragic event, Russian exile Alex Godman is drawn into the murky world of global crime as he tries to protect his family from their dark past.

1.title: FR - McMafia - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Semiyon convinces Alex into a venture designed to harm Vadim's business in Prague. Meanwhile, a young girl is taken on a very different journey.

1.title: FR - McMafia - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: With the help of Semiyon’s investment, Benes has grown his operation, leaving Vadim concerned and confused. Deciding to take matters into his own hands, Vadim arrives in Prague determined to get answers - by whatever means necessary.

1.title: FR - McMafia - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Alex unlocks a way to attack Benny Chopra and Vadim in Mumbai. He and Rebecca announce their engagement, but she starts to think he is hiding something.

1.title: FR - McMafia - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Semiyon awakes to an awful accusation. Alex is convinced he's innocent and sets out to try to expose his accusers. Meanwhile Katya unravels a shocking secret.

1.title: FR - McMafia - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Alex fears his family are under threat when Vadim learns the truth about him. His fears appear to be founded when he discovers evidence of a surveillance operation against him – but his paranoid reaction drives a wedge between him and Rebecca, while an unexpected betrayal has devastating consequences. Masha receives an ultimatum, and Joseph seeks an ally in his bid to help Lyudmilla.

1.title: FR - McMafia - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Vadim is convinced to broker peace in Istanbul. Alex learns the dreadful price of his actions, and Dmitri makes a decision that endangers them all.

1.title: FR - McMafia - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Alex arrives in Moscow ready to do business, but he's unaware of the devastation that Dmitri's actions have caused - and the danger that he faces. Alex must play the only card he has left to try and save himself, before facing a final showdown with Vadim.

meta.plot: Alex Godman, the English-raised son of Russian mafia exiles, has spent his life trying to escape the shadow of their past, building his own legitimate business and forging a life with his girlfriend Rebecca. But when a murder forces his family's past to return to threaten them, Alex is drawn into the criminal underworld and must confront his values to protect those he loves.

1.title: FR - For The People - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: The series premiere of the drama about six talented young lawyers who work on opposite sides of the law and handle the most high-profile and high-stakes federal cases in the country.

1.title: FR - For The People - S01E02 - Rahowa
1.plot: The six young lawyers are determined to bring home wins during their second round of cases; Jay must set aside his personal feelings as he defends a client with controversial beliefs; Sandra's idealism leads to an important lesson from Ms. Krissman.

1.title: FR - For The People - S01E03 - 18 Miles Outside of Roanoke
1.plot: Sandra and Kate go head-to-head on a high-profile case involving a young woman accused of leaking classified information, but they learn to find common ground in their fight for justice and pursuit of the common good. Allison struggles to make a case for her client as the courts look to new technology to avoid bias, and Leonard seeks professional legitimacy at the cost of a personal relationship.

1.title: FR - For The People - S01E04 - The Library Fountain
1.plot: After Seth learns that the people of his hometown and former elementary school in Lincoln, Nebraska, have become seriously ill due to groundwater contamination, he becomes invested in seeking justice, potentially jeopardizing the future of his career. Sandra, Jay and Allison assist Jill with a potential murder case, but as they grow skeptical of their client, Jill only grows more passionate.

1.title: FR - For The People - S01E05 - World's Greatest Judge
1.plot: Judge Byrne finds himself at a crossroads in his career when he presides over a case that requires a disproportionate mandatory minimum sentence. Allison represents a charming defendant in a fraud case while on duty for the first time, and Leonard struggles to decide whether or not to bring charges against a political figure.

1.title: FR - For The People - S01E06 - Everybody's a Superhero
1.plot: Allison defends a man accused of stealing supplies intended for victims of a devastating island hurricane and goes up against Celia Chavez, a tough Assistant U.S. Attorney for whom losing is not an option. Sandra defends a peculiar client accused of assault, but with an altered view of reality and on the other side, Kate is being sought after by an ATF agent in need of legal advice for an unlikely suspect.

1.title: FR - For The People - S01E07 - Have You Met Leonard Knox?
1.plot: Leonard is forced to confront some longstanding insecurities when his new high-stakes case leads him to question what is right and what is wrong. Sandra goes head-to-head with Seth who files charges against a daring comedian accused of threatening a U.S. president’s life; and Jay defends a tennis player accused of intentionally throwing a match to help his coach win a bet he placed against him.

1.title: FR - For The People - S01E08 - Flippity-Flop
1.plot: Jill and Roger’s complicated friendship is tested when they finally square off over a DEA raid that left an inmate clinging to life. Meanwhile, Kate is assigned to an animal smuggling case involving the death of an endangered panda; and Jay’s emotions are thrust into a case when he learns his trusting father was a victim in a pyramid scheme.

1.title: FR - For The People - S01E09 - Extraordinary Circumstances
FR - For The People - S01E10 - This Is What I Wanted to Say
1.plot: Sandra defends a hydrologist accused of spying for the Chinese government, but the similarities between this and a former case she lost has her confidence shaken. Meanwhile, Jay faces his fears and goes up against Kate in a case involving a PTA president accused of selling drugs to students; and Allison receives a tempting proposition from her wine-forger client and Leonard reaches out to Kate for advice that culminates with a surprising confession.

2.title: FR - For The People - S02E01 - First Inning
2.plot: Sandra, with the help of new investigator Ted, must defend a teenage gamer whose online argument leads to a police raid that ends with the death of a United States senator. A personal connection to the “swatting” case makes Roger determined to charge the teenager to the fullest extent of the law and pushes Kate to her limits in the process. Meanwhile, Jay is tasked with defending New York’s most spoiled millennial from going to jail for her petty crimes.

2.title: FR - For The People - S02E02 - This Is America
2.plot: Tina faces legal consequences as she defiantly insists on protecting a young boy after his father, a witness in Leonard’s case, has a run-in with ICE agents that could lead to his deportation. Elsewhere, Kate is determined to establish her worth to Roger and takes on a significant murder case involving a prominent New York criminal defense attorney.

2.title: FR - For The People - S02E03 - Minimum Continuing Legal Education
2.plot: Seth becomes committed to taking an immune international diplomat to trial so he can get out of general crime and onto a more senior unit. Sandra works on a kidnapping case and is convinced the kidnapping was an accident. Meanwhile, Jay is certain that taking a different route to work will determine how successful he will be in the courtroom.

2.title: FR - For The People - S02E04 - The Vast, Immovable Object
2.plot: The team in the public defender’s office takes on the case of a young man accused of strangling a woman to death and are determined to prove him innocent. Meanwhile, Tina and Sandra go head-to-head after a man is arrested while transporting a body part through the airport. Elsewhere, Seth and Leonard grow closer after they are tasked with speaking to a conference of an unusually young group of future lawyers.

2.title: FR - For The People - S02E05 - One Big Happy Family
2.plot: Sandra urges Kate to take on a case against a very powerful and well-respected judge who is accused of wrongfully sentencing young children for profit. When Judge Bryne is asked to testify in the case, he questions his role in the rigid justice system and must make a very difficult decision. Elsewhere, Seth temporarily moves in with Jay until a leak in his apartment is fixed.

2.title: FR - For The People - S02E06 - You Belong Here
2.plot: Leonard takes on one of the country’s best and most prolific litigators in a case that leads him to grapple with his personal feelings related to race and privilege in America. Back at the public defender’s office, Jay takes on his first drug case, but things heat up when he has to work with a rather unconventional lawyer. Elsewhere, Sandra tries to prove she’s not a workaholic and bonds with Ted over boxing to let off some much-needed steam.

2.title: FR - For The People - S02E07 - The Boxer
2.plot: Sandra is tasked with negotiating a plea agreement for a homeless man accused of trespassing a national wildlife refuge. However, she later suspects that he might have been involved in a more serious offense and enlists Ted to help her investigate. Meanwhile, Roger and Jill’s relationship is tested when the prosecution is forced to subpoena Sandra after learning she may have further knowledge of the crime. Elsewhere, Seth starts spiraling out of control after accidentally stealing evidence in a drug case.

2.title: FR - For The People - S02E08 - Moral Suasion
2.plot: Allison defends a man arrested for selling illegal cigarettes and is determined to get him released without bail. Elsewhere, Judge Byrne is called to jury duty where his excitement for a chance at experiencing the criminal justice system from another perspective is quickly tempered by the harsh realities of the process. Meanwhile, Sandra is still emotionally recovering after sending her client to prison for murder.

2.title: FR - For The People - S02E09 - Who Are We Now?
2.plot: Sandra and Kate’s relationship is put to the test when they go head-to-head over a high-profile bank robbery case. On the defense side, Alison helps Jay as he decides to take an unconventional approach defending their war veteran client. Meanwhile, Tina gives Roger advice about his relationship with Jill, a relationship beginning to show its cracks.

2.title: FR - For The People - S02E10 - A Choice Between Two Things
2.plot: On Election Day, Jay turns to Kate and the team for help after his parents and other voters are illegally intimidated at their polling place. Meanwhile, Roger and Jill’s relationship is at an impasse when Sandra learns that they are romantically involved and challenges Jill’s judgement. Elsewhere, Seth gets assigned to the case of a lifetime, but his anxiety increases when he is appointed a bodyguard to help protect him, all while Sandra and Ted take their relationship up a notch.

meta.plot: Brand new lawyers work for both the defense and the prosecution as they handle the most high profile and high stakes cases in the country – all as their personal lives intersect.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E01 - Esteban, Child of the Sun
1.plot: Father Rodriguez, who has looked after Esteban since he was a baby, tells him a great secret on his deathbed: somewhere his father may still be alive. So Esteban decides to begin his search in the New World. With the help of Mendoza, a mysterious man who claims to have rescued him as a baby, Esteban hides as a stowaway, aboard the Esperanza. As they are about to set sail, he meets a young Inca girl: Zia.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E02 - Crossing the Atlantic
1.plot: The two children, Esteban and Zia, find out that they both wear the same strange medallion. The Esperanza crosses the Atlantic and nears the entrance of the Straits of Magellan, where wild seas and strong winds create terrible storms. Mendoza, the navigator, prepares to spend four days and nights at the wheel.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E03 - Heroes Again
1.plot: Buffeted by a fierce wind and a wild sea, the Esperanza manages to sail through the Straits of Magellan, under Mendoza's guidance. But now, the ship faces another trial of strength: it is in the grip of a hurricane.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E04 - Adrift on the Endless Sea
1.plot: Esteban and his friends barely cross through the terrible Straits of Magellan before their ship, the Esperanza, sinks in a storm. Tossed around on a small raft and attacked by sharks, they're left in the middle of the ocean, with no provisions. But a seagull overhead guides them towards the closest shores, and they finally reach a small island.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E05 - The Abduction of Zia
1.plot: After a dangerous journey, Esteban and his friends are washed up on a mysterious island. That night, a shadowy figure comes creeping towards them. Silently, the figure steals a chart and a pistol, then snatches up Zia. Esteban gives chase. He discovers a curious house in a tree, where Zia is a prisoner. To Esteban's surprise, the mysterious shadow turns out to be a friendly boy of his own age, called Tao.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E06 - The Ship Solaris
1.plot: On a small island among the Galapagos, Esteban and Zia find a young boy living all alone: Tao. His ancestors left a magnificent ship, the Solaris, which contains their ancient secret knowledge, hidden in a temple on the island. Esteban and Zia want to use the ship to reach the mainland.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E07 - Secret of the Solaris
1.plot: Gomez' Spanish galleon overtakes and attacks the Solaris, the sun-powered ship on which the children are travelling. They manage to outrun the Spanish ship when Tao discovers a wonderful secret solar power boost, just in time. At last, they reach the new continent.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E08 - The New Continent
1.plot: After many adventures, Esteban and his friends finally set foot on the new continent. But there, they meet the soldiers of Governor Pizarro, men who think only of gold. They capture Zia and try to make her tell them the way to the Cities of Gold, but Tao and Esteban help her to escape.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E09 - The End of the Solaris
1.plot: Esteban and his companions escape from Pizarro, but their fabulous ship, the Solaris, is taken by Gaspard and Gomez. They offer to exchange the ship for Zia, and her secret. Trying to save Zia, and the friendly Inca people in the village, Tao blows up Gomez's ship, but sadly the Solaris is also destroyed.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E10 - Secret of the Temple
1.plot: Esteban and his friends are on their way to Zia's village, when they are surrounded by Spanish soldiers. The children manage to escape, and take refuge in an underground temple, where they meet the old priest, Pasha. To help them escape, the priest melts the pillar of ice that supports the temple roof, and it crashes down on top of him. The others just manage to get away.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E11 - Messengers of the Region
1.plot: Gomez captures the children and forces Zia to reveal the secret of the Golden Quipu. It is an Inca message which reveals that the Cities of Gold lie beyond the High Mountain Peak. In the night, Esteban and the children escape. They find a secret underground passage and set off for the High Peak.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E12 - Secret of the Medallions
1.plot: The Spanish army follow Esteban and his friends to the Fort of the Black Eagle. Under cover of darkness, the Spaniards attack the fort, but Tao devises a rocket flare that repels the attackers, saving the fort. The three children leave the fort and at last reach the City of the High Peak, whose chief, Kraka, tells them that the medallions Esteban and Zia wear can open the doors of Sela, one of the Cities of Gold.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E13 - Mystery of the Parents
1.plot: When Esteban arrives at the place called the High Peak, he meets an old man, Mayuka, who seems to know something about his parents.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E14 - Esteban's Medallions
1.plot: Mendoza steals the Spanish army's cannon in order to win the trust of the Indians, but his plan fails. As the three Spaniards are about to be executed, Esteban comes to save them. But he demands that Mendoza give him back the sun section of his gold medallion.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E15 - The Subterranean Secret
1.plot: Gomez and his soldiers attack the Fort of the Black Eagle to try to recapture the cannon Mendoza had stolen. Mendoza uses the cannon to fight back, but cannot stop the Spanish army who storm the fort and drive the Incas out. Esteban, Tao and Zia run away towards the High Peak, following secret underground passages constructed by the Incas.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E16 - The Urubus
1.plot: Searching for the Cities of Gold, Esteban and his friends cross a high plateau up in the Andes. Near Lake Titicaca, they are attacked by the Urubus, a tribe of giants. Tao invents a submarine, and they capture Karuga, chief of the tribe, and hold him prisoner. Karuga tells them that there's a City of Gold on a mountain, guarded by the earth goddess, Pachamama.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E17 - The Great Condor
1.plot: The setting sunlight leads Esteban and his friends to the statue of the earth goddess, Pachamama. The legend goes that when Pachamama takes the sun in her arms, the Gates to the Cities of Gold will open. Estaban and Zia place their medallions in the statue and the mountain opens up to reveal the first City of Gold. Inside they discover a great bird, made of solid gold.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E18 - Maiden Flight of the Condor
1.plot: Inside the first City of Gold, Esteban finds a great Golden Condor. When the volcano on which the Cities are built begins to erupt, the Cities are destroyed. Sheltering inside the body of the Condor, they try to make its mechanism work, using the Medallion of the Sun. Suddenly, the giant bird spreads its wings and takes flight.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E19 - The Nasca Plateau
1.plot: The great Golden Condor, carrying Esteban and his friends away from Pachamama and the erupting volcano, lands in the desert at Nazca. But when Pizarro and his soldiers arrive, Esteban makes sure everyone escapes.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E20 - The Spaniards' Cannon
1.plot: The Golden Condor carries Esteban and his companions to the High Peak, where they encounter the Spanish forces, armed with their cannon. With the help of the Golden Condor, they stop Gomez and Gaspard. And when they had saved their friends, they leave the High Peak, in search of the land of the Mayas.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E21 - The Amazons
1.plot: The group head for the land of the Mayas, on board the Golden Condor, when they are forced to land in the jungle. They are captured by Amazon warriors and taken to their temple, to be sacrificed to the Rain God. But Esteban uses his special powers, and the sun comes out. The Queen is so impressed by his power to command the sun, that she orders their release.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E22 - The Mirror of the Moon
1.plot: Esteban and his friends on board the Golden Condor have to make a forced landing in the jungle, where they're captured by Amazon warriors who want to sacrifice them to their Rain God. After some difficulties, they manage to escape from this dangerous situation. And in the end, the Queen of the Amazons allows them to leave for the land of the Mayas.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E23 - The Jade Mask
1.plot: In the jungle, Esteban and his friends discover some ruins, deserted temples and pyramids. In one of the temples, Pedro and Sancho try to remove a jade mask from the wall when the mask begins to glow. Suddenly the stone beams shoot out of the walls, ceiling and floor and trip them up.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E24 - The Manuscript
1.plot: After solving the secret of the green jade mask, Esteban and his friends find a manuscript which seems to hold the key to the whereabouts of the Cities of Gold. But almost immediately, they are captured by Doctor Fernando Laguerra and his friend, Marinche, who are also searching for the Cities of Gold. However, Kokapetl manages to rescue them all.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E25 - The Lake of Gold
1.plot: Esteban and his friends are captured by Indians who wanted to sacrifice them to purify their sacred lake of gold. Marinche and Doctor Laguerra try to poison the lake so they could get at all the treasure on the bottom. Mendoza foils their plan by breaking through the dam, flooding the village and allowing the children to escape.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E26 - The Swamps
1.plot: The Serpent God of the Mayas was said to have crossed the mountains to build a new city in the east, among the swamps of the Rain God. Setting out to find this second city, Esteban and his friends are tricked by Marinche, and find themselves fighting the alligators in the marshes. After a savage battle, they escape to the other side of the swamp.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E27 - The Doors of Night
1.plot: Esteban and his friends find the second City of Gold, but they are captured by Marinche and the Doctor. The Doctor finds a new manuscript, but is caught in a trap set into the floor of the temple. The children get the manuscript which tells of a third city, to be found near a forest of statues.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E28 - The Forest of Statues
1.plot: After much travelling and many adventures, Esteban and his friends finally discover the third temple built deep inside an enormous cave. A golden statue is holding a third manuscript which mentions a mountain known as "The Burning Shield".

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E29 - The Burning Shield
1.plot: Having found the Burning Shield, Esteban and his friends fall into the hands of the mysterious Olmecs, who possess very advanced technology. They escape from them, but are captured again. So what will happen to them now?

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E30 - The Escape
1.plot: Using their advanced technology, the Olmecs are able to collect energy from the heat of the sun, and from deep inside the Earth. They capture Esteban, Tao and Zia, intent on transplanting their cells to regenerate their elders, so they can become young again. With Mendoza's help, the children manage to escape.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E31 - The Village of the New Sun
1.plot: Esteban and his friends are guests at the Village of the New Sun. But the Olmecs have found the Golden Condor, and prepare to attack the village, with the help of the Doctor and Marinche, who mean to steal the great golden bird for themselves. Meanwhile, Myena discovers that Papacamayo, the old chief, is really Zia's father.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E32 - Attack of the Olmecs
1.plot: With the help of Gomez and Gaspard, Esteban and his friends succeed in getting the Golden Condor to fly. But the Olmecs find the Indian Village of the New Sun, and mount a fierce attack. With the help of the Golden Condor, they are defeated. But Zia's father, Papacamayo, has been seriously wounded.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E33 - The Reunion
1.plot: In the Indian Village of the New Sun, Zia at last finds her father, Papacamayo. But her happiness is short-lived, when he dies from his wounds, after defending the village against an attack by the Olmecs. All the Mayan tribes unite to fight against the Olmecs.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E34 - Revolt of the Mayas
1.plot: The Mayan people arm themselves and attack the Olmecs, who have been tyrannising them for years. A fierce battle takes place near the entrance to the Olmec base. From the Golden Condor, Esteban and the other children bombard the Olmecs with stones, turning the tide of the battle in favour of the Mayas.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E35 - The Olmec Machine
1.plot: Esteban and his friends manage to find their way into the Olmec base. But Kalmec discovers them, and takes Zia prisoner. Suddenly, a gigantic war machine rushes up from deep inside the Olmec underground temple.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E36 - Aerial Pursuit
1.plot: Esteban flies the Golden Condor against the terrible Olmec war machine, to try to rescue Zia. Tao and Esteban manage to leap onto the machine in mid-air, and Zia is saved. But Tao is left behind, a prisoner.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E37 - The City of Gold
1.plot: With Tao as a hostage, the Olmecs force Esteban and Zia to use their medallions to open the doors to the City of Gold.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E38 - The Great Legacy
1.plot: After wounding the High Priest of the Cities of Gold, Kalmec steals the Great Treasure, a concentrated source of the sun's power also called the Sun Power Unit. However, the security systems of the City are activated and destroy the Olmecs' flying machine. Kalmec and Menator make their way back to their base, taking the Great Treasure with them.

1.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S01E39 - End of the City of Gold
1.plot: The Olmecs place the Sun Power Unit at the bottom of their sunlight collecting crystal and activate it. However, the unit does not behave as expected and the Sun Power Unit begins to overheat. The High Priest of the Cities of Gold, who turns out to be Esteban's father, tries to shut it down using Tao's jar which is actually a control unit. But he could be too late.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E01 - Back in Barcelona (1)
2.plot: Six months after their adventures in South America, Esteban, Zia and all the team are back in Barcelona. There, the mysterious Zarès put in jail Mendoza, Sancho and Pedro. But Esteban, Zia and Tao will succeed to help them to escape.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E02 - Back in Barcelona (2)
2.plot: Esteban has disappeared the morning after Mendoza told him the truth about his father. Thanks to Pichu, his friends follow his traces to find him.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E03 - The Secret of the Drum
2.plot: After a long journey, our heroes arrive in the south of China and settle in the region of Guilin. Here, they make the acquaintance of a young Chinese boy called Zhi and his Panda, Yang-Yang who welcome them to their village during the ceremony of the Dragon.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E04 - In the Hands of Pirates
2.plot: Our heroes try to escape the pirates but Esteban and Tao are captured and taken to the pirate camp.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E05 - The Alchemist
2.plot: Will our heroes be able to escape the jaws of Pang-Li's alligator?

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E06 - All Aboard!
2.plot: The pirates attack Ambrosius' ship that transforms itself into an incredible flying Nave!

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E07 - Shaolin
2.plot: On the way to Peking, our heroes find refuge in a Shaolin temple. Mendoza, hurt during a fight, is taken care of by the Great Master. At nightfall, someone sneaks in to leave a venomous snake.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E08 - Treason
2.plot: Our heroes discover that the monk, Tian Li, is able to decipher ancient Chinese similar to that on Ambrosius' book. Tao and Esteban set off to go get the precious text in The Condor.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E09 - The Prophecy
2.plot: After thwarting the attack of The Red Scarves and discovering the treachery of Bao Xing-Ji, our heroes take off for Peking. They must find Ambrosius and get on to the trail of The Yellow Dragon.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E10 - The Black Pearl
2.plot: Learning where the yellow dragon can be found, Mendoza and Ambrosius go off in search of a temple. Meanwhile, the children meet with Mei Li, a young Chinese girl who shows them around Peking.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E11 - In Search of the Yellow Dragon
2.plot: Thanks to Yu Chunhe, the high priest of the Taoist temple, our heroes find the famous Yellow Dragon. Unfortunately, a man who has been spying on them since their arrival, steals the precious Dragon.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E12 - In the Forbidden City
2.plot: While pursuing the man who stole the Yellow Dragon, Esteban finds himself stuck inside the Forbidden City and must pass himself off as the Imperial Prince!

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E13 - Like a Prince
2.plot: Hiding in the Imperial Palace, Esteban finally manages to recover the Yellow Dragon. Tao and Ambrosius concoct a Plan B to help him escape from the Forbidden City.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E14 - The Escape
2.plot: Esteban flees the Forbidden City with the Yellow Dragon thanks to the help of his friends aboard the ship of Ambrosius.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E15 - The Stomach of Buddha
2.plot: While in search of Li Shuang, a friend of Esteban's father, our heroes are separated in a violent sandstorm: Zia is taken away by a young Mongol, Esteban and Tao are imprisoned by Chinese guards.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E16 - The Labyrinth
2.plot: Li Shuang leads our heroes into a secret passage to the Stomach of Buddha. Thanks to their medallions, Esteban and Zia discover an incredible metal labyrinth, whose walls are closing in on them.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E17 - The Sleeping Garden
2.plot: Inside the Stomach of Buddha our young heroes discover an extraordinary lab in which the Yellow Dragon has been charged with energy. While rescuing Tao from a crater, Esteban gets stung by a scorpion.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E18 - The Son of the Sun
2.plot: Stuck inside the Stomach of Buddha, Zia has saved Esteban who was stung by a scorpion. Meanwhile, the grown ups, guided by Ambrosius' compass, explode a hole into the ground to help them escape.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E19 - The Oasis
2.plot: The Pyramid of Mu has put our heroes on to the trail of a fresco depicting The Eyes That See All, near an oasis in the desert. But Zares is there too, and attempts to do away with Mendoza.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E20 - The Fresco of the Evil Eyes
2.plot: While searching for The Eyes That See All in the ruins of a cursed temple, our heroes are attacked by Zares who lashes out on Mendoza, Sancho, and Pedro.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E21 - The Separation
2.plot: After Ambrosius set them free, our heroes learn that the fresco is a copy of The Eyes That See All located in Tibet.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E22 - The Fire of the Dragon
2.plot: At the location of The Eyes That See All, the Yellow Dragon ignited a path of fire to the top of a Himalayan mountain. Back on the ship, Ambrosius and the children notice somebody has come onboard.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E23 - The Expedition
2.plot: In the Himalayas, our heroes discover a frozen Olmec holding a strange map. They meet Lian Li again, who has come to forewarn them of a great danger.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E24 - The Nest of the Condor
2.plot: Our young heroes and Ambrosius have managed to enter the second City of Gold. Esteban and Zia receive a message delivered by holograms of The Sages of Mu and Atlantis.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E25 - The Revelation
2.plot: Our heroes have escaped The City as it was closing in upon itself. So has Ambrosius, who has stolen a matrix of olishark from the City of Gold.

2.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S02E26 - Face To Face
2.plot: Back in the village, the children happily reunite with Ambrosius. Mendoza reveals to Esteban that his father is alive and waiting for him. Esteban meets with his father, but their reunion is cut short.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E01 - Kagoshima
3.plot: After leaving China under the threat of Zares, our heroes finally arrive in Japan. They must absolutely find there the third City of Gold against which the infamous Zarès promises to release Athanaos, the father of Esteban.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E02 - The Daimyo Shimadzu
3.plot: The one who attacks Esteban, Tao and Zia is Yoshi, an old man who keeps fiercely the impressive Orichalcum sphere. Yoshi reveals to the children that it is a utsuro bune, a sacred object, rejected by the sea thousands of years ago and revered since as a gift of the gods.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E03 - The Golden Bird
3.plot: Using his gift to make the sun reappear, Esteban allows Zia to take off the Condor. Under the astonished eyes of Yoshi, the immense golden bird finally emerges from the waves. Mendoza, Sancho and Pedro manage to escape from the castle.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E04 - The Anger Of Nao No Kami
3.plot: Near the temple of Izumo, the children succeed in extracting Esteban from the water, but attract the attention of one of the guards who go after them. Within the walls of the temple, our heroes finally see the mirror shield out for the parade, but an earthquake creates panic!

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E05 - The Mirror-Shield
3.plot: Inside the temple, the shield-mirror leaves the children perplexed: according to the silhouette in the utsuro bune, it is the path and the key to the next golden city. They realize then that the ornaments of the mirror represent a volcano, off Kagoshima. Will the city be underneath?

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E06 - The Return Of Zares
3.plot: At night, as Ichiro goes to take his guard duty at the castle, Esteban follows him and tries to convince him to help him to escape Mendoza and his men. Ichiro refuses, reminding Esteban how his presence and those of his friends already endangers his whole family.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E07 - The Sword of the Samurai
3.plot: Mendoza and his men takes control of the nave and makes the prisoners Gaspard and Ambrosius. They spot the Condor and rediscover the children who introduce Yoshi and his family.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E08 - Unmasked
3.plot: Mendoza narrowly escapes the attack of Ambrosius. The latter claims that it was Mendoza who assaulted him, but he loses his compass, which Esteban picks up and tends to him by reflex.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E09 - The Thallios
3.plot: In the center of the cave, at the top of a pyramid, our heroes discover a sphere of orichalque floating on a lake. Attacked by thousands of giant crabs, they manage to take refuge inside.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E10 - Sundagatt
3.plot: In the treasure chamber of the Golden City, the crowns found by our heroes allow the wearer to control the orichalc cubes by thought. As he goes to look for Tao in the Thallios to show him their discovery, Estéban passes by the statue: he seizes the crystal pearl.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E11 - The Shadows of the Jungle
3.plot: Zarès managed to escape with the crown and the crystal pearl. Aboard the Condor, Esteban explains his plan to his friends. He arranged for Zarès to take the crystal pearl that had guided the Thallios to the golden city.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E12 - The Memorial Temple
3.plot: The mysterious pursuers turn out to be children whose parents were abducted by the men of Ambrosius to work forcibly at the Fort of Pattala. When they learn that our heroes are not friends of Ambrosius and that Esteban's father is also a prisoner, they decide to unite their strength to deliver them all.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E13 - Laguerra
3.plot: At the fort of Pattala, Esteban was spotted by Ambrosius. When escaping, he sees his father in a cell but must flee because he is persecuted by Laguerra, the right arm of Ambrosius, and the guards of the palace.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E14 - The Order of the Hourglass
3.plot: Tao is now in the hands of Ambrosius. The latter tries to return to his good graces, but Tao sees him as a traitor and refuses to give him his confidence. However, Tao discovers the laboratory of Ambrosius and is impressed by all that it reveals to him.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E15 - Ambrosius' Secret
3.plot: According to the plans of Ambrosius, Laguerra and the soldiers find only a deserted village. Laguerra spotted the children hidden in the trees. She hesitates, but does not denounce them and leaves without saying anything with her men in direction of the fort.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E16 - The Black Suns
3.plot: While in the village, the children try to repair the Condor, Pichu sent by Tao finds them and deliver them a message from Atanaos. He reveals that the Rajah was drugged by Ambrosius.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E17 - Free!
3.plot: The fort is taken by assault from all sides: the villagers, Tao and Atanaos are freed. Esteban manages to inject the antidote to the Raja who regains his spirits and realizes the betrayal of Ambrosius. To escape the soldiers of the Rajah, Ambrosius uses the black suns that trigger a fire in the fort.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E18 - Hormuz
3.plot: Esteban spends his own time with his father Athanaos finally found. This one reveals to him well to know Ambrosius, to have been his friend when they were young. For their part, Zia and Tao discover in the Memory Temple a key clue in the search for the fourth golden city.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E19 - A New Beginning
3.plot: Our heroes are surrounded by a troop of Bedouins. Their intrigued chief observed the medallion and then returned it to Zia apologizing for the young thief: a Bedouin never flies. When the children leave, he asks the young boy to follow them to find out what they are doing in Ormuz.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E20 - The Mountain of the Moon
3.plot: On board the condor, Esteban is worried about what happened to Mendoza and his men, but his friends remind him that Mendoza is resourceful and their priority is to prevent Ambrosius from appropriating the muen knowledge and make it Weapons of war like the black suns.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E21 - Up Is The Way Down
3.plot: The children finally managed to penetrate inside the ziggurat. They start their descent in search of the sacred sails of Princess Rana'Ori in the bowels of the pyramid, where, according to the inscription discovered in India, they should be found.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E22 - The Lord of the Desert
3.plot: Zarès aided by Laguerra captures the children and pushes them towards the exit, revealing to them that he possesses, anyway, another track towards the fourth city of gold. They just need them and their medallions to open it.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E23 - The Veils Of Rana'Ori
3.plot: In the desert, the suspected noises heard are produced by none other than Sancho and Pedro lost in the dunes. They finally found their friend Mendoza. In Manfuha, the children try to leave the oasis to reach the Condor, but the compass they steal from Zarès detects something.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E24 - The Chaldean Desert
3.plot: The children reach Condor thanks to Laguerra who confronts the soldiers alone at the risk of his life. Despite the reluctance of Tao, our heroes return to collect it and make it climb aboard. Under the fire of the defensive guns of the fort, they managed with the Condor to recover the box containing the sails.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E25 - The Serpent and the Lion
3.plot: The Bedouin chief presents to the children the second veil they were looking for, transmitted from generation to generation by the Chaldis tribe. They try to read a plan to the city of gold, but the sails do not reveal anything.

3.title: FR - Les Mystérieuses Cités d'or - S03E26 - Kumlar
3.plot: On board the nave, Laguerra prevented Gaspard from killing Mendoza, arguing that Mendoza would be more useful to their living plan than dead. The children enter the city in search of the tomb of Princess Rana'Ori, but the sumptuous city seems deserted.

meta.plot: Le XVIe siècle. Des quatre coins de l'Europe, de gigantesques voiliers partent à la conquête du Nouveau Monde. À bord de ces navires, des hommes avides de rêves, d'aventure et d'espace, à la recherche de fortune. Qui n'a jamais rêvé de ces mondes souterrains, de ces mers lointaines peuplées de légendes ou d'une richesse soudaine qui se conquérait au détour d'un chemin de la Cordillère des Andes ? Qui n'a jamais souhaité voir le soleil souverain guider ses pas, au cœur du pays Inca, vers la richesse et l'histoire des mystérieuses cités d'or ?

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E07 - The Backstabbers
1.plot: Quill gets mixed up in a game of deceit when Gamora tries to pit her siblings, Nebula and Korath, against each other.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E08 - Hitchin' a Ride

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E10 - Bad Moon Rising
1.plot: The Guardians encounter a living planet that's fallen under the control of a revived Ronan.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E11 - Space Cowboys
