FR - Juda - S01E01 - Ye Shall Not Eat of It, Neither Shall Ye Touch It, Lest Ye Die
1.plot: Juda Ben Haim is a showy little thug, on his way to the biggest gambling in Romania with the money of a dangerous French mobster. A mysterious and beautiful woman shows up and changes all the picture.

1.title: FR - Juda - S01E02 - Appoint a Teacher for Yourself and Avoid Doubt
1.plot: The French mafia is chasing Juda. He manages to escape them, but got kidnapped by a mysterious Rabbi, who explains him how to deal with his new power, while the police is chasing him.

1.title: FR - Juda - S01E03 - Traineth My Hands for War, and My Fingers for Battle
1.plot: The Rabbi continues his lessons to Juda. Asher tries to get a new passports for them, and things goes mad when the french mobster finds them.

1.title: FR - Juda - S01E04 - If He Come to Slay Thee, Forestall by Slaying Him
1.plot: Tania pursuing after Juda alone, while Asher got arrested by the police. After his interrogation, Mister Jacques appears to make a threat.

1.title: FR - Juda - S01E05 - Who Is Powerful? One Who Overcomes His Inclinations
1.plot: Orit finds a connection between all the victims. Juda tries to break Asher out of prison by using his abilities despite the Rabbi's advice.

1.title: FR - Juda - S01E06 - And Esau Said to Jacob: Pour Into Me Some of This Red, Red, for I Am Faint
1.plot: Juda gets a lesson about pride. Moti follows after Orit. Dotan convinced Avihai to look into another case to find a connection between all the recent murders.

1.title: FR - Juda - S01E07 - God of Great Deeds, Find Us Forgiveness, at the Time of Ne'ila
1.plot: Shinko and his gang finds Juda and fights him. Tania and The Rabbi has to make tough choices. Asher confronts Menachem to get info about Juda, who needs to find a shelter before dawn.

1.title: FR - Juda - S01E08 - He Perceives a Matter's Outcome at Its Inception
1.plot: Asher and Menachem finds Juda, only to find out that The Rabbi has been kidnapped by Mister Jacques's crew. Juda breaks into Mister Jacques's house, who offers him to play Russian roulette for all or nothing.

meta.plot: Juda Ben Haim is a showy little thug, on his way to the biggest gambling in Romania with the money of a dangerous French mobster. A mysterious and beautiful woman shows up and changes all the picture.

1.title: FR - Strike - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Cormoran Strike, an injured war veteran turned PI, and secretary Robin Ellacott seek the truth surrounding the mysterious death of supermodel Lula Landry.

1.title: FR - Strike - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Strike makes a breakthrough. Robin is offered a permanent job in HR but is reluctant to take it.

1.title: FR - Strike - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Long-buried secrets are revealed, putting Strike and Robin in danger as they close in the killer.

2.title: FR - Strike - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: War veteran turned private investigator Cormoran Strike investigates the disappearance of a provocative author. Robin is caught between Strike and Matthew's hopes.

2.title: FR - Strike - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Delving deeper into the hidden meanings and concealed secrets of Bombyx Mori, Strike and Robin scour all corners of London's literary world to unmask the killer.

3.title: FR - Strike - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: A dismembered leg sent to Strike's office sends both his and Robin's lives into disarray, forcing them to confront spectres from their pasts.

3.title: FR - Strike - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: Strike and Robin's partnership reaches breaking point as Robin's wedding approaches, and they disagree about how to ensnare a man who abuses children.

4.title: FR - Strike - S04E01 - Episode 1
4.plot: Cormoran Strike and Robin Ellacott are at odds following Robin’s wedding to Matthew, but there’s no time to mull over the new distance within their professional relationship, as a frightening visit from a potential client puts a new case on the table - and Robin and Strike set to work looking into reports of a strangled child.

4.title: FR - Strike - S04E02 - Episode 2
4.plot: A startling discovery seems to confirm the story of the strangled child, but the team are forced to leave the scene before they can properly investigate. Fearing their witness is in danger, they redouble their efforts to find him.

4.title: FR - Strike - S04E03 - Episode 3
4.plot: Robin discovers a startling truth close to home. The government minister’s blackmailer becomes the prime suspect in the case, but Robin and Strike believe there was an accomplice.

4.title: FR - Strike - S04E04 - Episode 4
4.plot: Robin admits the truth to Strike, and a valuable clue helps them solve the case. Season finale.

5.title: FR - Strike - S05E01 - Episode 1
5.plot: Strike is approached by a woman asking for help to find her mother, Margot Bamborough, who went missing in 1974 when a psychopathic serial killer stalked the streets.

5.title: FR - Strike - S05E02 - Episode 2
5.plot: The investigation takes a dangerous turn as a disturbing piece of evidence leads Robin and Strike into London’s underworld. Robin risks her life by pursuing a vicious suspect.

5.title: FR - Strike - S05E03 - Episode 3
5.plot: Spurred on by the father of a young woman who also went missing in the 1970s, the detectives attempt to outwit an incarcerated serial killer who may hold the key to the case.

5.title: FR - Strike - S05E04 - Episode 4
5.plot: Strike realises that Margot’s killer is responsible for many other murders that have gone undetected, and lays a trap.

6.title: FR - Strike - S06E01 - Episode 1
6.plot: Edie Ledwell, the co-creator of a cult TV cartoon, The Ink Black Heart, is being harassed by an online figure, Anomie. She asks Robin to uncover Anomie's true identity.

6.title: FR - Strike - S06E02 - Episode 2
6.plot: Robin, Strike and Barclay all take risks to further the investigation now that they think Anomie probably killed Edie Ledwell. Strike receives an unexpected and unwelcome visitor.

6.title: FR - Strike - S06E03 - Episode 3
6.plot: Robin and Strike make a major breakthrough, having eliminated several suspects. Robin's cover is blown, and Strike stays the night at her new flat. Meanwhile, Anomie claims another two victims.

6.title: FR - Strike - S06E04 - Episode 4
6.plot: The agency is the target of a devastating attack. Strike figures out who killed Edie, and having secured proof, Robin puts herself in danger in order to save lives.

meta.plot: A war veteran turned private detective operates out of a tiny office in London’s Denmark Street. Although wounded both physically and psychologically, his unique insight and background as a military police investigator prove crucial in solving complex crimes that have baffled the police. Based on the bestselling novels written by J.K. Rowling under the pseudonym Robert Galbraith.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: With the help of Vic and Henry, Longmire investigates a backcountry murder with ties to a tribal family.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E02 - The Dark Road
1.plot: Longmire and his team investigate the death of an exotic dancer with possible Amish roots. Cady's new relationship stirs up controversy.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E03 - A Damn Shame
1.plot: Longmire uncovers long-buried family secrets when he probes the deaths of a man and his award-winning horses in a barn fire.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E04 - The Cancer
1.plot: A fisherman discovers the bodies of two murder victims, including a teen from the Cheyenne reservation.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E05 - Dog Soldier
1.plot: Walt and the team look into the disappearances of several Cheyenne foster children and an unregistered sex offender.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E06 - The Worst Kind of Hunter
1.plot: Walt suspects a bear was baited to fatally attack a released murderer. Branch's retired uncle, a former sheriff, can't resist the lure of law enforcement.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E07 - 8 Seconds
1.plot: A wealthy beer distributor is brutally assaulted for a seemingly worthless painting; Vic's husband is jealous of her relationship with Walt; Branch's father uncovers information damaging to Walt's campaign.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E08 - An Incredibly Beautiful Thing
1.plot: Henry uses his tracking abilities to locate an unstable young woman who may be involved in the murder of a gas-station owner.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E09 - Dogs, Horses and Indians
1.plot: The Tribal Council president is found dead on county land but it s clear he died elsewhere and there is soon a large suspect list. Walt deals with feelings of betrayal when he uncovers Cady and Branch s affair.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E10 - Unfinished Business
1.plot: In the first-season finale, a teen is murdered after being acquitted of raping a Cheyenne girl. Later, Walt is forced to finally confront his wife’s death.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E01 - Unquiet Mind
2.plot: A prison transfer goes awry and Walt urgently pursues a serial killer and his fellow escapees, who have taken hostages, up a mountain. Facing an impending storm with very limited resources, Walt’s mettle is put to the test and hypothermic hallucinations force him to face his past.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E02 - Carcasses
2.plot: When a body is found in a compost heap, the victim's history of abusive behavior leads to a varied list of suspects. Walt and the team must cross county lines to track down the killer. Branch looks into Cady's abrupt departure from Absaroka.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E03 - Death Came in Like Thunder
2.plot: Walt and the team explore Absaroka's Basque community when a shepherd and his dog are found dead. Branch walks a thin line in his alliance with Jacob Nighthorse. Meanwhile, Cady looks to Detective Fales for answers about her mother's death.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E04 - The Road to Hell
2.plot: A cattle heist sends the team on an urgent search for the missing livestock and driver as well as the thieves. Walt is concerned by Vic's fearful behavior when she receives a mysterious bouquet of flowers.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E05 - Party's Over
2.plot: When a teenage girl is found dead, Walt and the team investigate ties to the illegal sale of prescription drugs. Meanwhile Henry reconnects with an old flame and Cady returns home.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E06 - Tell It Slant
2.plot: Walt is tipped off to the murder of a supposed psychic by the Contrary Warrior, a Cheyenne who does the opposite of what people expect. While deciphering his backwards clues, Walt must also deal with a public debate against Branch.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E07 - Sound and Fury
2.plot: After Henry overhears a disgruntled husband try to order a hit on his wife, Walt and the team must use what little information they have to prevent her murder. Vic is wary when an ex-cop from Philly shows up in Durant.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E08 - The Great Spirit
2.plot: When a wild horse is found dragging a dead body, Walt discovers evidence of an illegal rodeo at a local farm. Detective Fales comes to town to talk to Henry.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E09 - Tuscan Red
2.plot: Following an explosion on the reservation and the discovery of a charred dead body, Walt is bombarded with public confrontation as the Cheyennes blame the blast on gas leaked from fracking by Newett Energy. Meanwhile, Branch reconnects with Cady and uncovers information that could help him in the election.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E10 - Election Day
2.plot: On election day, Walt and Branch aren't thinking about politics when Cady is badly injured by a hit-and-run driver. Vic and Ferg investigate, and Walt has a flashback to when Cady was a little girl.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E11 - Natural Order
2.plot: When a game warden is killed alongside an elk that was poached, Walt discovers a connection to a rare expensive supplement. Walt completes his sacrifice, and Branch closes in on the truth about Cady's accident.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E12 - A Good Death Is Hard to Find
2.plot: Longmire investigates after he receives a safe deposit box from a just-murdered inmate that contains a severed finger that is linked to both a new murder and a 20-year-old armed robbery. At the same time, Vic's paranoia peaks when she suspects she is being stalked, forcing her to confide in Walt.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E13 - Bad Medicine
2.plot: Walt and Branch team up when an apparent suicide is connected to Cady's accident. Meanwhile, Detective Fales returns with warrants, forcing Walt and Henry to face what happened in Denver.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E01 - The White Warrior
3.plot: Walt deals with the aftermath of Henry's arrest and Branch's shooting.The search for the shooter, however, is complicated by Branch's insistence that it was someone known to be already dead.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E02 - Of Children and Travelers
3.plot: An investigation into the murder of a Russian adoptee leads the team into a shady underworld. Henry faces trouble behind bars while Cady attempts to secure him competent legal representation.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E03 - Miss Cheyenne
3.plot: Walt splits his time working on a murder investigation and serving as a judge for a local pageant. Cady hopes an old friend can help with Henry's case.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E04 - In the Pines
3.plot: Walt and the team track missing teenage campers on a leadership trip in the wilderness. Branch continues his unauthorized search for his shooter.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E05 - Wanted Man
3.plot: Walt teams up with Lucian Connally to narrow the field of suspects in his wife's murder. Branch's behavior causes problems.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E06 - Reports of My Death
3.plot: A media frenzy erupts when a long-lost heir who went missing 30 years earlier is found dead. Henry makes a risky decision on his own.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E07 - Population 25
3.plot: Vic's vacation turns deadly after she and Sean are kidnapped following an accident. Walt is forced to make an unusual alliance to rescue the pair.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E08 - Harvest
3.plot: A life insurance policy complicates the investigation into a farmer's apparent murder. Branch and Cady check out a lead in Denver. Vic receives an ultimatum from Sean.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E09 - Counting Coup
3.plot: Walt is seriously concerned by Branch's behavior, but makes a key discovery in the David Ridges case. Henry faces a major setback in his trial. Vic makes an important decision about her future.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E10 - Ashes to Ashes
3.plot: Walt seeks closure in his wife's murder and Henry's case. Branch is suspended but continues to investigate Jacob Nighthorse.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E01 - Down by the River
4.plot: The team struggles with the fallout from Branch's confrontation with Barlow, and Walt's crusade to bring Nighthorse to justice spins out of control.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E02 - War Eagle
4.plot: Walt is forced to split his focus between new evidence in a personal case, and the murder of a caretaker at a former Japanese internment camp.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E03 - High Noon
4.plot: The investigation of Nighthorse heats up, but not in the way that Walt was hoping for. Cady makes a shocking discovery.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E04 - Four Arrows
4.plot: A body found in the luggage of a tour bus further complicates Walt's troubles with Nighthorse. Henry makes a bold move to help a mother and son.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E05 - Help Wanted
4.plot: When the husband of a former soldier is assaulted during an apparent robbery, Walt is drawn into an emotionally charged investigation.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E06 - The Calling Back
4.plot: A young Native American girl is raped on the reservation, which sparks new, volatile tensions between local oil rig workers and the Cheyenne people.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E07 - Highway Robbery
4.plot: A highway robbery sets off an investigation into a strange relationship, while Walt struggles to let go of the past.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E08 - Hector Lives
4.plot: When a former suspect in a rape case ends up dead in another county, Walt and Vic aren't convinced the death is an accident.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E09 - Shotgun
4.plot: Henry's attempt at justice backfires, resulting in new problems for him and a new investigation for Walt.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E10 - What Happens on the Rez...
4.plot: The line between justice and the law gets even blurrier for Henry and Walt as their hunt for a killer intensifies.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E01 - A Fog That Won't Lift
5.plot: A shaky Walt searches for Donna as he and Vic reconstruct what happened in the cabin. Mathias has a deal for Henry. Cady tells Walt about a job offer.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E02 - One Good Memory
5.plot: Henry renegotiates his deal with Mathias. Walt's search for Donna leads to too many suspects. A phone message sends Walt down an unexpected path.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E03 - Chrysalis
5.plot: Walt unravels the puzzling case of a girl and her missing father. Henry helps Cady find a place on the rez. Malachi and Jacob's alliance is weakening.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E04 - The Judas Wolf
5.plot: Walt and Vic investigate the bizarre kidnapping of a despised drug company CEO. Henry and Mathias deal with the ramifications of an overdose.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E05 - Pure Peckinpah
5.plot: Mathias must join forces with Walt after Henry discovers a drug dealer's body. Vic solves her housing problem. Malachi puts a bounty on Hector's head.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E06 - Objection
5.plot: Depositions for Walt's case go badly. Ferg loses confidence in himself. Henry and Vic help lead Walt toward the big boss at Manifest Destinations.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E07 - From This Day Forward
5.plot: When treasure hunters discover a body in a hollow tree, Walt finds a connection to an old case. Cady struggles to help a battered woman on the rez.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E08 - Stand Your Ground
5.plot: Walt looks deeper into the Irish mob. Henry finds the book he needs, while Cady gets legal advice. Malachi and Jacob lob accusations at each other.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E09 - Continual Soiree
5.plot: Walt's obsession with Jacob leads to more tension with Cady. Vic testifies against Gilbert. Walt's anger erupts at the Red Pony.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E10 - The Stuff Dreams Are Made Of
5.plot: Walt gets more bad news from the mayor. Vic does a strange favor. As Walt learns what's behind the lawsuit, Henry and Cady each face tribal rituals.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E01 - The Eagle and the Osprey
6.plot: A bank robbery ends in a shooting, giving Sawyer more leverage against Walt. When Henry goes missing, Cady tells Walt about a disturbing vision.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E02 - Fever
6.plot: While Henry recuperates, Walt investigates the murder of a man whose land is popular with treasure hunters.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E03 - Thank You, Victoria
6.plot: Chance Gilbert's plea appearance takes a dramatic turn that pulls Walt away from his own case and sets him and Vic on the path to a showdown.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E04 - A Thing I'll Never Understand
6.plot: An emotional Vic re-examines her life choices. Henry and Jacob join forces to pursue Malachi. Ferg helps Meg's mother avoid the tribal police.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E05 - Burned Up My Tears
6.plot: As the civil trial begins, things don't look good for Walt -- especially after a murder puts him and Vic under suspicion.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E06 - No Greater Character Endorsement
6.plot: The bizarre death of a drug dealer points to a violent new Hector. Cady tries to help a sick child whose parents don’t trust Western medicine.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E07 - Opiates and Antibiotics
6.plot: Walt wonders if a presumed-dead member of the Irish mob is alive. Mathias questions Cady about Catori. A mobile clinic raises Henry's suspicions.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E08 - Cowboy Bill
6.plot: While Ferg secretly works the Cowboy Bill case, Walt and Vic try to find Shane Muldoon. Cady's office is trashed.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E09 - Running Eagle Challenge
6.plot: Vic gets a surprise visit from her father. An FBI agent helps Walt pin down the mole working with Malachi. A tough race enables Vic to move forward.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E10 - Goodbye Is Always Implied
6.plot: Jacob's troubles escalate at the casino. Walt gets an unexpected visitor. An inevitable confrontation leads to changed lives.

meta.plot: A Wyoming sheriff rebuilds his life and career following the death of his wife. Based on the “Walt Longmire” series of mystery novels written by best-selling author Craig Johnson.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E01 - Might Need a Bigger Boat
1.plot: The NT is home to over 150,000 crocs and one man, Matt Wright, is on a quest to protect them all.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E02 - Life Insurance Ain't That Good, Baby
1.plot: A family fishing trip turns dangerous when the catch is bigger than expected; Matt reveals his unique bond with a wild crocodile; the boys are stalked during a risky night-time operation.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E03 - Sink or Swim
1.plot: Matt attempts to relocate a crocodile threatening human lives. An unexpected rookie joins the team causing frustration for Willow. An airboat mission is derailed by an emergency.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E04 - Don’t Hold Back
1.plot: Matt sets out to prove that perseverance pays off; the team races against the clock to catch an evasive croc; and a romantic fishing trip is ruined when Matt takes a dangerous detour.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E05 - Trouble in Paradise
1.plot: A sightseeing boat is stalked by an aggressive monster croc. An emergency phone call turns Matt's day upside down. Matt is tasked with apprehending an "uncatchable" crocodile.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E06 - Escape Artist
1.plot: The team chase a bait-robbing croc under the cover of darkness; a cunning escape artist forces Matt to pursue a new strategy; the boys launch a rescue mission to save a disoriented deadly predator.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E07 - Feeding Time
1.plot: The rookie Finn has his hands full at Matt's croc sanctuary. On the Tiwi Islands, a new build tests the team. A huge croc in a small waterhole sets nerves (and a boat) on edge.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E08 - Don’t Get Chewed
1.plot: With a flash flood predicted, Matt and Willow improvise a trap to tempt a hungry croc; Kaia and Banjo hone their foraging skills with a First Nations elder; Finn’s forgetfulness almost ends in disaster.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E09 - Wright or Wrong
1.plot: Kaia must deal with an unwanted visitor at home. A animal relocation tests Matt's skills for logistics and engineering. Banjo gets his first fishing rod. But will he catch a fish?

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E10 - The Reckoning

1.title: FR - Faking Hitler : L'arnaque du siècle - S01E06 - Episode 6

meta.plot: En 1978, le journaliste allemand Gerd Heidemann s'allie à Konrad Kujau un faussaire désargenté, pour écrire de faux journaux intimes d'Hitler. Retour sur un scandale.

1.title: FR - Diesel Brothers - S01E08 - Busting At The SEMA
1.plot: Last year the Dieselsellerz put their insane builds on the map when they debuted their legendary MegaRam at the SEMA trade show in Vegas. With less than two weeks to go, it’s all hands on deck to finish a 6-wheel drive F550 in time for the big show.

2.plot: Heavy D, Diesel Dave and the Dieselsellerz crew work to finish their epic monster mud truck for the giveaway, and The Muscle scrambles to find a buyer for the flashy Denali he bought without Heavy D's permission.

2.title: FR - Diesel Brothers - S02E07 - Epic Fail of the Year
2.plot: The Dieselsellerz pick up a vintage fire truck to transform into a tow truck that can carry everyone in the shop. And Heavy D is determined to finish the endless Fail of the Year UTV build.

2.plot: Heavy D decides to test the physics abilities of the shop and build a somersaulting truck to use for viral videos. And The Muscle takes over a flip from Heavy D and turns a Dodge Ram into a badass modern pop-up camper.

2.title: FR - Diesel Brothers - S02E09 - Flippin' Diesel
2.plot: The Diesel Brothers are up against the clock for their SEMA build: a replica Ford Bronco made from an F350 and an Excursion; Heavy D brings in physics help to make his dream of a somersaulting truck come true.

2.title: FR - Diesel Brothers - S02E10 - Good Bros and Goodbyes
2.plot: The Dieselsellerz SEMA build hits a snag, and the guys scramble to find a replacement. They decide to rebuild and give away their most iconic build: The Megaram.

meta.plot: Following the team at Dieselsellerz as they trick out trucks, work hard and play harder in the process. In the world of diesel vehicles, no one has more fun or builds bigger, badder trucks than Heavy D, Diesel Dave and their crew. Their mega builds and awesome truck giveaways are the stuff of diesel legend.

Le lendemain, elle prend contact en ligne avec plusieurs victimes directes ou collatérales et quand l’idée de créer une association de victimes prend forme, Christelle en devient la pierre angulaire. Mais elle vit dans le mensonge.

1.title: FR - Can I Tell You A Secret? - S01E02 - Part 2
1.plot: The women's voices are finally heard, and a suspect is called in for questioning — but with so little evidence, will he ever be brought to justice?

meta.plot: Trois femmes voient leurs vies bouleversées quand un harceleur infiltre leurs comptes sur les réseaux sociaux. Et elles ne représentent qu'une fraction de ses nombreuses victimes.

meta.plot: Onze participants se mettent dans la peau de fugitifs pendant 21 jours, durant lesquels ils vont devoir disparaître des écrans radars sur tout le territoire français. Une équipe d'experts sera à leur recherche. Pour les trois premiers binômes, le compte à rebours est lancé. Ils ont deux heures pour fuir avant que le commandant Caupenne et ses équipes d'experts se lancent à leur poursuite.

1.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S01E01 - Japanese Katana
1.plot: In this explosive new series, four bladesmiths will compete for $10,000 and the title of Forged in Fire champion. Across three grueling rounds, competitors design and forge deadly edged-weapons of war. Their work will be put to the test, and those that fail will be sent home. In the final round, the two remaining bladesmiths must forge one of the most iconic weapons from history; the Japanese Katana. Their swords will be pushed to the absolute limit…the final test will determine which is stronger; their Katanas or a speeding bullet?

1.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S01E02 - Chakram
1.plot: Four bladesmiths must forge a weapon using only reclaimed metal. With the clock winding down, two of the competitors are dramatically forced to improvise, and one almost doesn't make it through the round at all.

1.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S01E03 - Viking Battle Axe
1.plot: The bladesmiths must transform a steel "train spring" into a weapon of their choosing. Only two competitors will move on and are given just five days to forge a legendary Viking Battle Axe. After a barbaric round of testing from the judges, only one man will be left standing.

1.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S01E04 - Katar
1.plot: For this week's challenge the competitors create their signature blade by using the Hada technique--a traditional process that involves forging multiple layers of steel together. The pressure mounts as one of the smiths is pushed to his absolute breaking point.

1.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S01E05 - Crusader Sword
1.plot: The forge heats up as our four bladesmiths struggle create a special Japanese hardening technique on their signature blades. After a difficult first round of testing, the remaining two bladesmiths head home with just five days to forge the legendary Crusader Sword.

1.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S01E06 - The Elizabethan Rapier
1.plot: The forge heats up as the bladesmiths must use an age-old technique to create their signature weapons. But will their swords make the cut when the judges put them through a battery of tests? Two finalists head to their home forges to make one of history's most notorious weapons, the rapier, a sharply pointed sword that can kill with just one thrust.Source: History Channel

1.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S01E07 - The Roman Gladius
1.plot: A steel ball bearing ends up being transformed into a weapon. The finalists have to create a historically important blade called a Roman Gladius.

1.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S01E08 - The Moro Kris
1.plot: The bladesmiths must forge a signature weapon using everyday steel objects like ball bearings and shovels as their only source material. One contestant puts finishing his weapon before his own safety in a heated race to the finish. Only two competitors will move on and are given just five days to forge the mystical Moro Kris Sword--a distinctive blade that dates all the way back to 300 BC.

2.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S02E01 - The War Hammer
2.plot: Our bladesmiths must choose wisely as they are asked to dumpster dive for the right steel to be turned into a hardened blade of their choosing. Will these blades hold up after a tough round of testing? Only two will move on to forge a War Hammer. After five days at their home forges, the smiths return hammers in hand to pound their way to victory. But in the end only one will nail the competition and be crowned the Forged in Fire champion.

2.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S02E02 - Khopesh
2.plot: This week our bladesmiths are given a "twisted" challenge when they are asked to forge a weapon from cable steel. The competition slowly unravels as they handle this difficult steel. After two rounds only two are left to return home and forge an Egyptian Khopesh. Back at the forge their iconic weapons are put through their paces but only one can be crowned Forged In Fire champion.

2.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S02E03 - The Scottish Claymore
2.plot: Four blade smiths face one of the most grueling challenges in Forged in Fire history when the electricity and power tools are taken away from them and they must forge a blade with just fire and their bare hands. They'll have just five days to create the iconic Scottish Claymore, the legendary weapon of William Wallace.

2.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S02E04 - Spiked Shield
2.plot: Three is the magic number as our blade smiths are asked to forge three or more metals into a blade of their signature style. Despite pain and failure, two move on to the final round returning home to forge a legendary spiked shield. After a punishing round of testing only one emerges to be crowned the Forged in Fire Champion.

2.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S02E05 - Viking Sword
2.plot: Four bladesmiths salvage material from a car and forge a blade, and then have five days to create a Viking sword.

2.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S02E06 - Nepalese Kukri
2.plot: Four different types of metal are shaped into deadly weapons, and then bladesmiths forge a machete-like Nepalese kukri.

2.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S02E07 - The Shotel
2.plot: Four bladesmiths face the unpredictable challenge of taking high carbon steel and wrought iron and forging these two conflicting materials into a fully functional weapon. After a formidable round of testing, only two will move on to the final round where they'll have just five days to create one of the most beautifully designed blades in history, the Ethiopian Shotel. Will this uniquely shaped blade throw them a curveball or will one be able to hook themselves the title of Forged in Fire champion?

2.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S02E08 - The Cutlass
2.plot: The bladesmiths have to convert some failed blades from last season into fully-functional weapons.

2.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S02E09 - Khanda
2.plot: The bladesmiths need to create a weapon in their signature style from a large pile of mixed metal that is welded together.

2.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S02E10 - Tabar
2.plot: Four bladesmiths must take an ordinary garden lawnmower and using its metal to bend and shape to their will, create one of their signature blades. When the other contestants are mowed down in the competition, two will make it to the final round where they must create a Tabar, a deadly battle axe from Southern Asia. After a series of grueling tests, only one will survive the cut to be named the Forged in Fire champion.

3.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S03E01 - Champion Edition / Scottish Claymore
3.plot: Season 3 begins with the return of four champions who are charged with making a high-carbon-steel inlay. Then, two finalists are challenged to forge a Scottish Claymore, which has stumped previous contestants.

3.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S03E02 - Fan Favorites / Hook Sword
3.plot: Four former contestants, back in the Forge by popular demand, return for a second shot at victory and redemption in an all new challenge full of unexpected twists. Competition gets heated right away when they are forced to make their signature style blades with materials from a surprising source. After two rounds of grueling competition, only two smiths are left to take on the final challenge of recreating a weapon they've never seen before: The Hook Sword. This complex weapon gives both fan favorites a run for their money, but only one will hook the crown and take home $10,000.

3.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S03E03 - Butterfly Swords
3.plot: Four new contestants must choose wisely as they try to craft a blade of their signature style from a pile of tools, both old and new. Then the stakes are doubled when, for the first time ever, they must forge not one, but two swords in the final round. Crafting Chinese Butterfly Swords, our final two bladesmiths face twice the work, and twice the pressure, in their attempt to claim the title of Forged in Fire champion.

3.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S03E04 - The Falcata
3.plot: Four bladesmiths must create a blade out of high carbon steel while also forging the hammer they'll use to make it. After an extraordinary round of testing, only two move on to the final round where they'll have just five days to create a weapon known for its deadly prowess against armored soldiers--the Falcata. Will the blade's unique handle shape leave them open to a devastating blow, or will one smith be able to slice their way to the $10,000?

3.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S03E05 - Kora Sword
3.plot: Four new bladesmiths step up to the challenge of forging blades using pieces of steel harvested from some monstrous power tools. While some smiths excel under the pressure, others are pushed to the limits of exhaustion in the heat of the Forge. After a vigorous round of testing, the final two go toe-to-toe in creating a sacrificial sword from history which could reportedly cut a sheep in half with one swing. After a formidable battle in the finale, only one will earn the title Forged in Fire Champion and take home $10,000.

3.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S03E06 - Hunga Munga
3.plot: Four new bladesmiths have their creativity put to the test when they are tasked with making a serrated blade out of only the tools from the table in front of them. They must harvest enough steel to forge the blade, but without melting down a crucial tool they might need later. Then, the final two bladesmiths attempt to forge a Hunga Munga--a behemoth weapon where all four edges must maintain peak performance when put through the judges' gauntlet. Which bladesmith will prove worthy of a check for $10,000 and the title of Forged in Fire Champion?

3.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S03E07 - The Boar Spear
3.plot: Four bladesmiths must use the steel from a suit of armor to create a signature blade. After a tense round of testing, only two move on to the final round where they'll have just five days to create a weapon historically used for both combat and hunting--the boar spear.

3.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S03E08 - Xiphos Sword
3.plot: When a group of new bladesmiths enter the forge, they're met with a challenge they never saw coming. They must grab the steel they'll use to make their blades from an imposing piece of construction equipment. This isn't the kind of scrap metal they're used to harvesting and just pulling the right type of steel proves to be a bigger task than any of them anticipate. After an intense round of testing, two remaining smiths face off to recreate a classic Greek sword used in close quarters combat. With a $10,000 prize on the line, both smiths turn out impressive blades for a final round of testing, but the Gods will choose only one to be crowned Forged in Fire Champion.

3.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S03E09 - The Pandat
3.plot: Four blade smiths must salvage steel from a junkyard to create a signature blade using a hand-cranked coal forge.

3.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S03E10 - Zulu Iklwa
3.plot: Four new bladesmiths are put to the test when they must forge a bayonet blade and engineer it to attach to a rifle. After a round of grueling tests on their bayonets, the final two bladesmiths are sent home to spend five days forging the legendary African blade, the Zulu Iklwa. Will both bladesmiths fall, or will one stand a cut above to be crowned the Forged in Fire champion?

3.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S03E11 - Champions Edition / The Pata
3.plot: Over the course of three seasons, 26 bladesmiths have been crowned Forged in Fire champion. Tonight, prior winners return to prove who among them is the best of the best by forging a blade using canoe damascus. After two high octane rounds of competition, the two remaining champions will move to the final round where they must create a weapon known for its unique mechanics and deadly double-edged blade--the Pata. With $10,000 and their reputation on the line, which smith will survive the judges' brutal testing to once again be crowned Forged in Fire champion?

3.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S03E12 - The Zweihander
3.plot: Four competitors must forge weld blades for friction folders from tiny cubes of steel. After hammering through the testing, two smiths will return home where they will forge a German Zweihander. Due to its long length and use on the battlefield, they take their Zweihanders outside the forge to be tested, where only one will be crowned Forged in Fire Champion.

3.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S03E13 - Cavalry Saber
3.plot: Four new bladesmiths face the unprecedented challenge of forging the barrel of a gun into a lethal knife. After a round of brutal testing, the final two bladesmiths return home where they have five days to forge one of the most legendary blades in combat history, the Cavalry Saber.

3.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S03E14 - The Naginata
3.plot: Four blade smiths must create a signature blade using a randomly chosen mystery technique. After a brutal round of testing, only two will return to their home forges where they will reproduce a Japanese Naginata. Famous for its long length and use in martial arts, the smiths take their Naginatas outside the forge to be tested. Only one will survive and be crowned Forged in Fire Champion.

3.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S03E15 - The Haladie
3.plot: For the first time ever, four bladesmiths must use high carbon steel to forge a hatchet. After an intense round of testing, only two can chop their way to the final round where they'll have just five days to create an ancient Indian weapon used to both stab and slice. Will the double-edged Haladie wound both of the finalists, or can one be singled out and crowned Forged in Fire champion?

3.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S03E16 - Redemption / Viking Sword
3.plot: Four previously eliminated bladesmiths return to the forge for a shot at redemption, but they face a challenge that will make their climb to the top more difficult than they imagined. After two rounds of competition with shocking eliminations, the two remaining smiths face off to recreate a sword known for its devastating strength--the Viking sword. With $10,000 on the line, which smith will survive a grueling round of testing and finally be crowned Forged in Fire champion?

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E01 - Judges Pick
4.plot: The judges pick past bladesmiths to represent them; first, the smiths must use steel from N.Y.C. streets to forge signature blades. In the final round, the competitors have five days to forge a sword that originated in West Africa, the Ida.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E02 - Deer Horn Knives
4.plot: Four bladesmiths tee up for a never-before seen challenge, harvesting steel from a vintage golf club to forge signature blades. In the final round, the remaining smiths must forge a pair of iconic double bladed weapons with two times the edge.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E03 - The Katzbalger
4.plot: For the first time ever, the competitors are challenged with creating not one, but two blades in the first round. After a grueling second round, the two remaining smiths have just five days to create an iconic 15th century combat sword–the Katzbalger.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E04 - Makraka
4.plot: Four bladesmiths face a new twist in the first round when they learn they can’t forge any blade in their own style, they must forge a karambit, a curved knife that resembles a claw. The final two competitors have five days to forge one of the deadliest weapons in African history–the Makraka.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E05 - Fans' Choice
4.plot: Chosen by fans, four bladesmiths return for a second shot at victory. The smiths must use their best forging techniques to make a signature blade using barbed wire; the final two smiths craft a historical Filipino weapon of war, the Panabas.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E06 - Akrafena
4.plot: Bladesmiths are tasked with forging a Kukri, the signature blade of master smith and judge, Jason Knight. After two rounds of mishaps and mischief, two smiths forge ahead in the final challenge to reproduce a distinctive African sword, the Akrafena.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E07 - Talwar
4.plot: A new group of competitors face the unknown when they are tasked with using odd shapes of mystery steel to forge a blade in their signature style. All four smiths fight to the finish amidst painful injuries and setbacks, but only two make it through to the final round. With just five days to recreate the sacred but lethal Talwar sword, which smith will defy all odds to claim the title of Forged In Fire Champion and $10,000 prize?

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E08 - The Cinquedea
4.plot: Four bladesmiths are welcomed to the forge with a curveball–they must utilize questionable steel from mining tools to forge a blade in their signature style. Ultimately, two smiths survive to forge an intricately designed and deadly Italian sword–the Cinquedea.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E09 - The Charay
4.plot: The competitors must demonstrate edged-weapon mastery when they are tasked with turning salvaged junkyard steel into a weapon. Two forge ahead to the final round to recreate the legendary Charay sword.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E10 - Sword Breaker Redemption
4.plot: Four competitors return to the forge for a second chance; they must forge their signature blades using recycled steel from a jackhammer. Then, the finalists must recreate a distinctive 16th-century blade called the Sword Breaker.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E11 - Master & Apprentice
4.plot: Masters compete alongside their apprentices as they take turns on the forge floor, fusing their skills to forge a cleaver using the arduous jellyroll technique; in the final round, the smiths must forge a deadly Congolese chopper, the Nzappa Zap.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E12 - Ngombe Ngulu
4.plot: Four bladesmiths must forge blades from a giant elevator cable; two finalists return home to recreate the African Ngombe Ngulu, known as the executioner's sword.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E13 - The Shamshir
4.plot: Four competing bladesmiths are tasked with forging a bowie knife that will require a d-guard in the second round; only two manage to make it through to the final round where they must recreate a deadly saber called the Shamshir.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E14 - The Kachin Dao
4.plot: Smiths must use steel from old nautical equipment to forge-weld their signature blades, while being forced to do it using a metal inlay technique; then, the two finalists have just five days to forge the Kachin Dao, a deadly headhunting sword.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E15 - The Gladiators' Scissor
4.plot: With a variety of steels to choose from, the smiths are forced to create a canister Damascus billet from which they must forge a dagger; only two enter the final round where they must recreate an ancient Roman weapon known as the Scissor.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E16 - The Kampilan
4.plot: Four bladesmiths head to a scrap yard to create their signature blades using harvested metal and a coal forge; in the final round, the smiths must re-create a fearsome battle weapon known as the kampilan.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E17 - The Kpinga
4.plot: The smiths are forced to layer a complex Damascus pattern into their signature-style blades; broken blades fall throughout two challenges and an unforgiving round; finalists must recreate a three-bladed African throwing knife called the Kpinga.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E18 - The Yatagan
4.plot: The competition shifts into high gear when the smiths are tasked with turning the rusted steel from a 1971 Mercury Cougar into their signature blades in just three hours; the finalists must create an elite military weapon known as the Yatagan.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E19 - International Championship / The Spadroon
4.plot: Four of the top smiths from around the world compete in an international championship; two smiths return home empty handed, while two go on to recreate the Spadroon, a weapon that transcends borders, in their efforts to bring home the title.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E20 - Tabar-Shishpar
4.plot: Smiths are asked to forge blades from pipe wrenches; two competitors advance to the final round during which they must recreate a rare axe-mace hybrid known as the Tabar-Shishpar.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E21 - Ultimate Champions Edition
4.plot: Five returning champions must earn a spot at one of the four anvils; the four remaining smiths are given cubes to forge blades in the infamous canister Damascus challenge; then, the finalists return to their home forges to recreate the Tai Chi sword.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E22 - Knights Templar
4.plot: Four brave smiths are thrown for a loop when they must forge together rusty chain mail and high quality steel to produce Knights Templar Crusader Daggers in Round 1.

4.title: FR - Forged in Fire - S04E23 - Viking Edition
4.plot: Four brave competitors march into a dry moat where they must resurrect old swords and forge them into a Viking Seax, using the time-tested coal forge. With hammers in full swing and multiple obstacles in their path, the smiths exhaust every ounce of their strength to produce weapons fit to withstand any test imaginable. In the final challenge, the remaining two smiths voyage home to recreate a pair of deadly Viking War Axes in their final fight for the coveted title of Forged In Fire champion.

meta.plot: Competitors re-create weapons from historical periods ranging from Japanese katanas to medieval broadswords to ancient throwing blades. Each entry is judged on its artistry as well as its functionality and accuracy.

1.title: FR - Hyperdrive - S01E01 - Qualifier 1: Ready to Launch
1.plot: The amped-up drivers get their first experience on the course, but not everyone has what it takes to dominate behind the wheel.

1.title: FR - Hyperdrive - S01E02 - Qualifier 2: Roll the Dice
1.plot: A millionaire with a Lamborghini, a truck driver in a stock Mustang and a slew of other racers in tricked-out rides push each other to new extremes

1.title: FR - Hyperdrive - S01E03 - Qualifier 3: Enter the Assassin
1.plot: The qualifying rounds continue with the craziest obstacle yet and six new racers. The standout is a 21-year-old nicknamed the Baby-Faced Assassin.

1.title: FR - Hyperdrive - S01E04 - Qualifier 4: Go Hard or Go Home
1.plot: The qualifying rounds continue with the craziest obstacle yet and six new racers. The standout is a 21-year-old nicknamed the Baby-Faced Assassin.

1.title: FR - Hyperdrive - S01E05 - Knockout 1: Head to Head
1.plot: As the knockout round begins, the drivers must prove themselves on a newly redesigned course. But not everyone's car survives the chaos.

1.title: FR - Hyperdrive - S01E06 - Knockout 2: Checkers or Wreckers
1.plot: A new obstacle humbles the racers -- even one indomitable driver. Another contestant's overconfidence proves costly on the track.

1.title: FR - Hyperdrive - S01E07 - Knockout 3: Track Is Hot
1.plot: With the competition down to eight drivers, the track designers crank up the difficulty with a new obstacle that turns out to be alarmingly dangerous.

1.title: FR - Hyperdrive - S01E08 - Wild Card: A Chance at Redemption
1.plot: A few old favorites return to the course for a series of head-to-head battles. The prize: a second chance at glory.

1.title: FR - Hyperdrive - S01E09 - Semifinal: Last Chance
1.plot: The course is downright diabolical. The margin for error is thinner than ever. The finale is nearly here. Go, drivers, go!

1.title: FR - Hyperdrive - S01E10 - Finale: The Monster
1.plot: It all comes down to this. The top six drivers race through nine obstacles to determine the ultimate champion on four wheels.

meta.plot: Elite street racers from around the world test their limits in supercharged custom cars on the biggest, baddest automotive obstacle course ever built.

1.title: FR - Killer Ratings - S01E01 - The Accusation
1.plot: Brazilian journalist and politician Wallace Souza is beloved by Manaus's gang-weary citizens until a criminal's arrest leads to a shocking allegation.

1.title: FR - Killer Ratings - S01E02 - The Investigation
FR - Killer Ratings - S01E03 - Conspiracy
FR - Killer Ratings - S01E04 - The Son
FR - Killer Ratings - S01E05 - In God's Hands
FR - Killer Ratings - S01E06 - Judgement
FR - Killer Ratings - S01E07 - The Terror

meta.plot: Brazilian TV personality and politician Wallace Souza faces accusations of masterminding the violent crimes he reported on and rallied against.

1.title: FR - Captains - S01E01 - The Chosen Few
1.plot: Qualification for the FIFA World Cup brings pressure to some of the biggest names in football. Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang prepares Gabon to take on Mo Salah's Egypt in a crucial match.

1.title: FR - Captains - S01E02 - A Leader and not a Follower
1.plot: We meet Thiago Silva and discover his history wearing the national shirt. A shock defeat for Jamaica in Panama means Andre Blake must unify the squad.

1.title: FR - Captains - S01E03 - Homecoming
1.plot: Luka Modric returns to the Croatia squad after injury, while the Lebanon team prepares for a rare home fixture.

1.title: FR - Captains - S01E04 - Tell the Man to put on his Shirt
1.plot: Vanuatu travel to Qatar for an Oceania qualification event postponed due to Covid-19. Aubameyang must help a team-mate with a crisis of confidence.

1.title: FR - Captains - S01E05 - Everyone wants me to be a Superhero
1.plot: Must win games for Brazil, Croatia and Lebanon as the pressure to get to the FIFA World Cup ramps up. Modric mentors the new crop of internationals coming through the squad.

1.title: FR - Captains - S01E06 - What if we don’t Qualify?
1.plot: Crunch time for Croatia. Papa Aubameyang steps up and a new coach tries to revitalise the Jamaica side.

meta.plot: Six captains from six different confederations attempt to qualify for the 2022 World Cup in Qatar.

1.title: FR - Blood Sisters - S01E01 - It's a Bloody Affair
1.plot: During their lavish engagement party, Sarah and Kola's relationship hangs in a balance. Later, Sarah and Kemi get caught in a precarious situation.

1.title: FR - Blood Sisters - S01E02 - Run Sisters Run
1.plot: With Kola missing, his family clashes over how to move forward. Meanwhile, Sarah and Kemi desperately search for a solution to their growing problem.

1.title: FR - Blood Sisters - S01E03 - The Hunt
1.plot: As Kola’s family mourns, Sarah and Kemi go into hiding until trouble finds them. With new evidence in tow, detective Joe chases a lead of his own.

1.title: FR - Blood Sisters - S01E04 - The Catch
1.plot: Personal agendas and painful truths come to light when Sarah and Kemi fight through another deadly situation and land in the crosshairs of a family feud.

meta.plot: Connected by a dangerous secret, best friends Sarah and Kemi are forced to flee after a wealthy groom disappears at his own engagement party.

1.title: FR - Bienvenue sur Terre - S01E01 - The Silent Roar
1.plot: On a remote island in the Pacific, Will Smith descends into the heart of an active volcano to investigate sounds beyond human hearing. Will discovers that everything on our planet creates its own unique sound—even if we can’t always hear it.

1.title: FR - Bienvenue sur Terre - S01E02 - Descent into Darkness
1.plot: In a deep-water submersible, Will Smith descends 3,300 feet to the bottom of the ocean, where even fewer people have gone than outer space. Along the way down, Will and explorer Diva Amon investigate how color is used in the natural world.

1.title: FR - Bienvenue sur Terre - S01E03 - Mind of the Swarm
1.plot: Thirty years ago, Will Smith was mesmerized by a photo of the incredible wildebeest migration across the Serengeti in a National Geographic magazine. Now he visits those same wildebeests and discovers an amazing survival strategy.

1.title: FR - Bienvenue sur Terre - S01E04 - Power of Scent
1.plot: On the trail of tiger sharks in the Pacific, Will explores the power of smell. For humans, the sense of smell triggers deep memories and emotions, but it has an even more vital function in the animal world.

1.title: FR - Bienvenue sur Terre - S01E05 - Speed of Life
1.plot: Will explores the Namibia Desert, where both the landscape and time seem to have stood still for over 50 million years. 1.title: FR - Les Pyjamasques - S01E47 - Catboy and the Lunar Dome
1.plot: At day, Connor is trying a new dance move called The Tornado except he messed up and ended up being laughed by the kids. Then, while Connor, Amaya, and Greg are walking back to their school, one of Luna Girl's moths gave the kids an invitation to her party, but they soon become suspicious of her plan and the trio transforms later at night. Luna Girl appears with the speakers and streamers for the party. She states that the PJ masks aren't really guests, but they are victims of her Lunar Dome, and traps them. Luckily, the dome doesn't cover the whole HQ since it's only in a half circle so the PJ masks suggest that digging underground is the only way out. Unfortunately, an embarrassed Catboy thinks of other ideas despite Owlette and Gekko telling him that the Super Tornado is the only key to escaping the dome. When Greg, Connor and Amaya were in the library reading books, Greg found a book about the strongest athletes in the world that won many medals and trophies.

1.title: FR - Les Pyjamasques - S01E48 - Gekko and the Rock of All Power
1.plot: Greg wondered if he could win at least one medal to declare him being strong. By the time they went out of the library, they saw lamposts being bent. By night, they saw Night Ninja chasing a rock called the Rock of All Power. Amaya heard about the rock in her Kung Fu book that whoever breaks the rock will be awarded with a medal. Gekko was so tempted to break the rock to get the medal since he has the power of strength instead of protecting his friends and their HQ. But while he tries to stop the rock, he breaks it, not meaning to. He says that he felt stronger than ever, and that true strength comes from caring for your friends. That is the best strength.

He proposes a race between himself and Catboy, with Luna Girl as the referee. What she really wants is the trophy for herself. Catboy keeps messing up because he kept going to fast in each competition. Owlette and Gekko try to convince him to take his time, as slow and steady wins the race. Finally, he comes up with a plan and offers one last race with the two villains. This time he slows down and wins the race, with the other two competetants losing. The PJ Masks return the trophy to where it belonged.

1.title: FR - Les Pyjamasques - S01E52 - Gekko's Special Rock

By night, they find that Luna Girl stole the rocks for her Luna magnet to pick up bigger things, like vehicles. She uses them to try and destroy things, including the PJ Masks. But instead of trying to get the mission done, Gekko tries to go after his rock, and that causes the heroes to struggle to get the mission to a success. His friends tell him that's it's not important like the mission is, and he sacrifices his rock to stop Luna Girl.

meta.plot: A six ans, Sacha, Amaya et Greg vont à l’école comme tous les enfants. Mais ça, c’est seulement la journée… Car la nuit, nos petits justiciers pas vraiment comme les autres enfilent des pyjamas magiques, et au lieu d’aller se coucher se transforment en super-héros pour régler les tracas. Faites place à Yoyo, rapide comme l’éclair et bondissant comme un chat ; Bibou à la vue perçante, qui vole comme un oiseau ; et Gluglu aux méga muscles, capable de se suspendre au plafond comme un gecko ! Ensemble, ils forment un formidable trio prêt à accomplir toutes les missions. Les Pyjamasques ont un nouveau défi. Les soucis, ils les règlent la nuit !

2.plot: The day of Jay and Ryan's fight sees everyone taking on new roles: Nate cornering Jay, Alicia and Ava hosting the afterparty, and Alvey taking a step back. But before any of that can happen, Ryan still has to be convinced that he's ready to fight.

2.title: FR - Kingdom - S02E14 - Do Not Disturb
2.plot: Alicia receives an offer that Alvey believes looks more promising than it is. Jay and Ava celebrate his lightweight championship, retreating into each other. Alvey must make amends for a past accident.

2.title: FR - Kingdom - S02E15 - Take Pills
2.plot: Jay and Ava's plans are completely upended when an unexpected visitor comes looking for Christina. Ryan breaks up Alicia's living situation while questions about why he lost his championship fight swirl.

2.title: FR - Kingdom - S02E16 - Halos
2.plot: Nate returns to the cage looking for an end to his losing streak and to prove to Alvey and everyone else that he's still a viable fighter. Mac brings something into Navy St. that threatens the gym's operations.

2.title: FR - Kingdom - S02E17 - Help Wanted
2.plot: Lisa returns to Los Angeles, but she's unsure of what life is waiting for her there. Ryan demonstrates his dominance of the gym while Nate attempts to drag Jay away from his new life with Ava.

2.title: FR - Kingdom - S02E18 - Cut Man
2.plot: Alicia faces the biggest challenge of her career in a fight that promises to vault her to new heights if she can secure the victory. Alvey must contend with how Lisa's return impacts his relationship with Roxanne.

2.title: FR - Kingdom - S02E19 - Late to Leave
2.plot: Alicia makes a career defining decision that will alter her relationships with everyone in the gym. Keith presents a challenge to Ryan, reminding him just how unstable his roommate can be.

2.title: FR - Kingdom - S02E20 - No Sharp Objects
2.plot: The rematch between Jay and Ryan for Jay's lightweight title belt could not come at a worse time for a reeling Jay. Alvey rescues an old friend from a bad spot.

3.title: FR - Kingdom - S03E01 - Wolf Tickets
3.plot: Nate looks to prove himself in the cage, and Ryan defends his title. Jay seeks balance in his new life. With plans to take King Beast to the next level, Garo presents Alvey with a lucrative offer.

3.title: FR - Kingdom - S03E02 - Ritual
3.plot: Lisa hires help at Navy St. so Alvey can focus on training. Jay struggles to adjust to working life, while Garo tries to woo Ryan back to King Beast. Christina makes the best of a new situation, and Alvey forges a deeper bond with Nate.

3.title: FR - Kingdom - S03E03 - Thank You, Boys
3.plot: While Alvey deals with a health scare, Lisa proves her worth as a manager. A gift from Ryan presents complications for Jay and Amy, and Jay takes Ryan on a real estate tour. Lisa goes on a date.

3.title: FR - Kingdom - S03E04 - Headhunter
3.plot: Dom's relationship with Ryan creates problems with Alvey and Lisa. Nate tries to make peace when Jay causes tension at home. Alvey gets a surprise from his past.

3.title: FR - Kingdom - S03E05 - Please Give
3.plot: Dom pushes boundaries at the gym, while Christina takes charge of Kayla and the girls. Jay continues to struggle with Amy and work. Lisa gets Nate a fight on short notice, and Ryan takes a break from training.

3.title: FR - Kingdom - S03E06 - All Talk
3.plot: Ryan deals with the consequences of his actions while Nate helps Alvey with press for his fight. Dom gets closer to Ryan, and Jay and Mac look for a party. Nate takes on a tough opponent.

3.title: FR - Kingdom - S03E07 - Platinum Level
3.plot: Ryan checks in with Keith while Alvey looks for a distraction from his pain. A new boss moves in with Christina. Jay gets back in the gym, and Lisa considers a tempting offer.

3.title: FR - Kingdom - S03E08 - Old Pueblo
3.plot: An unexpected trip makes Alvey reassess his relationship with his sons. Cody puts Christina in a tough position with Kayla. Ryan questions Lisa's judgment about Dom, and Lisa makes a decision.

3.title: FR - Kingdom - S03E09 - Cactus
3.plot: Dom dishes on Navy St. and forces Lisa to make an unexpected move. Alvey tries to connect with his mother while bonding with Nate and Jay in the desert.

3.plot: Alvey's comeback fight couldn't come at a worse time as Navy St. comes to grips with tragedy. Roles are reversed when Ryan coaches Alvey, and Lisa begins a new chapter.

1.title: FR - Prison School - S01E05 - The School’s Number One Most Treacherous Man

1.title: FR - Prison School - S01E08 - The Diary of Andre

1.title: FR - Prison School - S01E10 - It’s a Bum-derful Life
1.plot: The boys are resigned to their upcoming expulsions, and spirits are low, until Gakuto, suffering a bout of temporary insanity, devises one last strategy to get them out of their predicament, if they can just buy enough time to pull it off.

1.title: FR - Prison School - S01E11 - Eryngii Brockovich

meta.plot: Au milieu d'un paysage infranchissable au pied des Alpes, un jeune groupe de grands délinquants suit un programme éducatif expérientiel destiné à les réhabiliter. Tout à coup, un membre du programme meurt de mort violente. Personne ne sait exactement ce qui s'est passé et les jeunes font face à une décision difficile. Devraient-ils attendre que les autorités récupèrent le corps et enquêtent sur le crime ? Ou s'échapper et prendre leur destin en main ? Le groupe n'a pas grand-chose en commun les uns avec les autres, bien qu'une chose les unit; Tous ont eu de très mauvaises expériences avec les autorités et ne s'attendent pas à être traités équitablement. Comme ils ne savent pas qui est l'agresseur, ils n'ont qu'une seule option : fuir. En haut des montagnes, en haut des plus hauts sommets des Alpes. Cela semble sans espoir jusqu'à ce qu'ils tombent sur un système de grottes complexe où ils peuvent trouver un abri contre le vent, les intempéries et leurs poursuivants.
