1.plot: Raphaëlle and Astrid take an interest in a former resident of the mysterious house, a woman who murdered her entire family there 24 years ago.

1.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S01E03 - Missing Link
1.plot: A Natural History Museum employee is found dead at the foot of a dinosaur skeleton. Not a drop of water on the horizon and yet, the victim drowned.

1.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S01E04 - Locked Room
1.plot: When a famous writer is found dead, the duo starts an investigation on the trail of a tragic fire that could be the source of a Machiavellian revenge.

1.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S01E05 - Fulcanelli
1.plot: Astrid and Raphaëlle find out that the dead body discovered after the collapse of an underground gallery is that of an 80 year-old alchemist.

1.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S01E06 - The Man Who Never Was
1.plot: When a man collapses on a bus, possibly killed by an extremely contagious disease, the duo ends up confronting the leader of an eco-terrorist group.

1.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S01E07 - Dead and Company
1.plot: After the president of an autistic association dies mysteriously, a new corpse is found. Though officially deceased days earlier, he is a suspect.

1.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S01E08 - Invisible
1.plot: A woman is murdered, but the main suspect was in prison at the time of the events. The duo quickly realizes that it is the work of a serial killer.

2.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S02E01 - Starling
2.plot: A famous lawyer is shot dead in front of twelve witnesses who have seen nothing, heard nothing: are they accomplices to the murder or victims of an incredible mystification... Through a neurologist with mentalist talents, Astrid and Raphaëlle will direct their investigation to a magician, former television star. By digging into the victim's past, they will eventually understand that magic was the starting point of his success but also of a terrible personal drama.

2.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S02E02 - Irezumi
2.plot: The Japanese owner of an art gallery is found dead in a spa. Killed with a sword, he would have cut off his little finger as a sign of penance before dying as a yakuza would. Astrid and Raphaëlle go in search of a killer with a huge tattoo on his back. They will gradually realize that a family story is the key to murder.

2.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S02E03 - The Fermi Paradox
2.plot: A man is killed in an ultra-secure factory from which the main suspect inexplicably managed to escape. Astrid and Raphaëlle are about to leave the crime scene, when it appears before their eyes, in a flash. Could she have been the victim of an alien abduction as suggested by the first elements of the investigation or is another much more tangible reality behind this crime?

2.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S02E04 - High Point
2.plot: A trainee is found dead in the huge organ of the Maison de la Radio. Astrid and Raphaëlle investigate the very heart of the instrument and meet an organist prodigy and her cantankerous old teacher. Things get tough when a second lifeless body is found near the organ. The modus operandi is the same... A track is beginning to emerge: what if it was the music that kills?

2.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S02E05 - Circe
2.plot: A young woman is found dead in a forest. Her body is partially burned and it seems that strange rituals were performed at the crime scene. Disturbing detail: she gave birth just hours before her death and the baby's whereabouts are unknown. Astrid and Raphaëlle find themselves on the trail of a feminist association: Circé. Was this young woman killed because of her commitment? Is the murder related to an obscure practice of witchcraft or to the baby she was carrying?

2.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S02E06 - Golem
2.plot: One of the associates of a high-tech company is murdered. The crime scene suggests that this Orthodox Jew may have been a victim of the Golem, a mythical clay creature obeying the orders of its creator. This directs the investigation towards an artificial intelligence project with disturbing realism. While their first suspect sinks into madness, Astrid and Raphaëlle will discover that taking oneself for God is never without consequences.

2.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S02E07 - The Book
2.plot: At an auction, the auctioneer presents a precious ancient manuscript, the Corpus Hermeticum, before having a fit of delirium and then collapsing, dead. Apparently, he was poisoned, and in panic, the priceless book was replaced by a fake. Astrid and Raphaëlle will be interested in this object that would contain absolute knowledge and that arouses the wildest desires.

2.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S02E08 - In Custody
2.plot: An armed woman enters the criminal documentation and takes everyone hostage. Accused of killing her godfather to Alcoholics Anonymous, she absolutely wants to prove her innocence. She is desperate, alone against all... Astrid and Raphaëlle, will play the clock and try to piece together the puzzle of this story to restore the truth.

3.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S03E01 - Overall Plan
3.plot: A renowned astrophysicist is found struck down even though no storm had occurred at the time of his death. Social networks take over the case and cry conspiracy when we learn that the victim was about to divulge a state secret.

3.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S03E02 - Memento Mori
3.plot: Father Louis Desforges is found stabbed to death in a monastery. Astrid and Raphaëlle discover that the man, who lived under a false identity, bore stigmata.

3.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S03E03 - Natifs
3.plot: A young woman under the influence of a powerful drug is found unconscious, with a weapon with her that was used to commit a crime twenty years earlier in a small Native American community from Canada. Who is this young woman and how did the weapon end up in her hands?

3.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S03E04 - The Open Room
3.plot: A murderer interned in a psychiatric hospital is found dead in his room. The first clues seem to rule out the theory of an accident. Astrid and Raphaëlle embark on a difficult investigation. They are still unaware that this murder is the work of an organized gang operating from inside the hospital.

3.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S03E05 - Témoin
3.plot: Consultant criminalist, Astrid Nielsen, who is also autistic, helps Commander Raphaëlle Coste solve criminal investigations. With conspiracy theory followers or a Native American community, in places as varied as a monastery or a psychiatric hospital, the two women combine their talents to solve these cases. Furthermore, Astrid could well lift the veil on an already old mystery, which her father had already tried to elucidate, but without success. The series, a real audience success in France, is also broadcast in around twenty countries, in Europe, Latin America, the United States and even Japan.

3.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S03E07 - The Flowers of Evil
3.plot: A biologist passionate about research into plant intelligence is found lifeless in a tropical greenhouse. His death immediately gave rise to the most fanciful speculations. Could the tragedy be connected to the research laboratory from which the victim had resigned abruptly a few years earlier? Astrid and Raphaëlle both lead the investigation...

3.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S03E08 - A basement
3.plot: Two police officers discover a homeless man dead, beaten, in the abandoned building where he lived. Astrid and Raphaëlle immediately go there. At the crime scene, Astrid notes an intriguing detail: the victim is wearing a very clean suit, without any trace of blood. This enigma is quickly resolved: another homeless man, who shared the same squat, is arrested. He admits to having put the costume on him to attract the attention of the police. According to him, three other homeless people were killed in the same way without the police launching an investigation. Astrid, like Raphaëlle, is determined to stop the killer, but she does not know how much this investigation will weigh on her emotional stability...

4.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S04E01 - The Eye of the Dragon
4.plot: A diamond of exceptional quality must be exhibited in Paris. But on the day it opened to the public, the head of security was found dead, his skull horribly shattered. The magnificent gem has also mysteriously disappeared. Astrid and Raphaëlle are put on the investigation...

4.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S04E02 - 1001 Nights
4.plot: The body of a man of Iranian origin is found charred in his home. Spontaneous combustion or diabolical crime? Astrid and Raphaëlle quickly discover that he was living under a false identity….

4.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S04E03 - 10,000 meters
4.plot: A serial killer repatriated by plane under Raphaëlle's supervision dies during the flight, the victim of a mysterious decompression accident. Helped by Astrid on the phone, Raphaëlle finds proof that it is an assassination and that the culprit is among the passengers...

4.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S04E05 - The Fool's Sacrifice
4.plot: During a prestigious chess tournament, one of the favorite players collapses in the middle of a match, struck down by poison! Astrid and Raphaëlle then realize that they are at the heart of a bloody, life-size game of chess...

4.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S04E06 - The Passenger of Time
4.plot: A famous environmental activist is murdered in public by a young woman, who is immediately arrested. Things get tougher for our heroines when the criminal claims to come from the future...

4.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S04E07 - Back Again
4.plot: The heir of a rich Breton family is found dead in a bar. Problem: he already died two years ago! Raphaëlle and Astrid travel to Brittany to uncover the darkest secrets of this illustrious family...

4.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S04E08 - Guilty
4.plot: Raphaëlle is found, with amnesia, at the wheel of an accident car, the body of a man shot to death beside her. Guilty or innocent? It will take all the talent of Astrid and Nicolas to help him untangle the tortuous thread of events...

5.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S05E01 - We only die once
5.plot: A woman without stories is found dead on a bench in a park, victim of a sting poisoned by the venom of an exotic snake. Astrid and Raphaëlle embark on the case and soon find themselves on the trail of a dangerous mafia hitman who had not been talked about for years. Why did he come out of the shadows again? Did this woman die by accident or was she involved in illegal activities? The two investigators have a hard time to get the truth out in the open. As always, Astrid's extraordinary sagacity is of great help to Raphaëlle...

5.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S05E02 - But it's for so long
5.plot: Astrid and Raphaëlle will have to walk on eggs when they find themselves in spite of themselves involved in a very sensitive diplomatic affair. The two investigators will deal with the French and American secret services...

5.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S05E03 - Mandala
5.plot: Maxime Rivière, a friend of Commissioner Bachert, is the victim of a recurring nightmare concerning the murder of the Tibetan monk. Astrid makes the connection with the unsolved murder of the llama Tulku Lingpa, on May 20, 1996, in a monastery in Île-de-France. On their way there, the commissioner, who turns out to be a Buddhist, Raphaëlle, Astrid and Nicolas discover disturbing elements that question the guilt of the perpetrator of the murder, a drug addict who was prowling in the nearby forest. According to Raphaëlle, the crime was committed inside the monastery.

5.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S05E04 - The last of the Aztecs
5.plot: Philippe Desmond, 65, is found dead at home, victim of an Aztec ritual sacrifice. The heart of this former archaeologist turned treasure hunter was extracted from his rib cage and then placed in a sacred urn.  Raphaëlle and Astrid then go in search of the victim's adopted son, Necalli Cantu, a young Mexican living hidden in a forest. Questioned, the latter reveals to Raphaëlle that his father had found the Eldorado, the mythical land of South America supposed to be full of gold. According to him, he was killed because of his discovery ...

5.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S05E05 - The baptism of the dead
5.plot: A man belonging to the Mormon community is found murdered in a temple. Astrid and Raphaëlle soon discover that the murder strangely resembles that of Joseph Smith, founding father and prophet of the community...

5.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S05E06 - Wolf are you there?
5.plot: A new victim of the formidable serial killer "the Werewolf" is found under a Parisian bridge on a full moon night. Our two heroines quickly orient their investigation on the trail of an enigmatic voodoo ritual...

5.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S05E07 - We finish the jockeys well
5.plot: A racehorse belonging to a prestigious stable is found stabbed dead. The case gets tougher for the two investigators when another crime is suddenly perpetrated...

5.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S05E08 - A wedding and four funerals
5.plot: On a film set, a famous actor is accidentally killed by a blank bullet. Astrid and Raphaëlle soon discover that it is indeed a murder and that it could only be orchestrated by a real crime expert ...

6.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S06E01 - Raphaëlle's Death
6.plot: Raphaëlle finds herself in the emergency room, between life and death, while a famous ghost-hunting YouTuber is found dead at home, crushed by a mysterious force.  Between paranormal experiences and high-end scams, the investigation gradually leads to the trail of a mysterious medium nicknamed Odin. How is he connected to this sinister affair? And above all, how will Raphaëlle get out of it?

6.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S06E02 - The Boarding School
6.plot: Raphaëlle has emerged from her coma, but her legs remain paralyzed.  The investigation into Odin leads Astrid and Nicolas Perran to investigate a strange boarding school, Overlook College. While investigating within its walls, the investigators soon discover that the suspicious death of a student at the school is curiously linked to that of their first victim. He may not have succumbed to meningitis, but may have been poisoned...

6.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S06E03 - The Cursed Boli
6.plot: A bloody African statuette is found near the lifeless body of Adrien Dorval, a 65-year-old retired engineer who had opened a pottery workshop. The medical examiner notes that the victim's torso was slashed post-mortem.  Strangely enough, the statuette is not the murder weapon. Adrien Dorval was actually killed with a clay roller found in a trash can near the crime scene.  The investigation gradually puts Astrid and Raphaëlle on the trail of a Machiavellian revenge. The police officer and the librarian are in for a surprise.  Raphaëlle also fears being shelved.

6.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S06E04 - The Theory of Everything
6.plot: The body of a prominent mathematics professor is found in the trunk of a car.  Our two heroines gradually focus their research on a revolutionary mathematical theory that arouses everyone's desire.

6.title: FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S06E05 - Episode 5
FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S06E06 - Episode 6
FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S06E07 - Episode 7
FR - Astrid et Raphaëlle - S06E08 - Episode 8

meta.plot: Lorsque le commandant Raphaëlle Coste s'adresse au service des archives judiciaires de la police pour une de ses enquêtes, elle ne se doute pas qu'elle va rencontrer une jeune femme aussi brillante que déroutante, mémoire vivante des enquêtes criminelles, Astrid, 30 ans, signe particulier : autiste Asperger.

1.title: FR - Into the Fire : La fille perdue - S01E01 - Part 1
1.plot: Cathy learns of the disappearance of her birth daughter, Aundria, in 2010. A search for answers leads to a shocking suspect.

1.title: FR - Into the Fire : La fille perdue - S01E02 - Part 2
1.plot: In the wake of a surprise arrest in another long-standing cold case, Cathy inches closer to uncovering her daughter's fate.

meta.plot: Dans ce documentaire en deux parties, une mère met tout en œuvre pour élucider le mystère qui entoure la disparition de la fille qu'elle avait confiée à l'adoption en 1989.

1.title: FR - Undone - S01E01 - The Crash
1.plot: After a fight with her sister Becca, Alma gets in a car accident and sees something mysterious.

1.title: FR - Undone - S01E02 - The Hospital
1.plot: While recovering in the hospital from her car accident, Alma talks with her dead father, who has a confusing and compelling request.

1.title: FR - Undone - S01E03 - Handheld Blackjack
1.plot: Alma begins her training with her dad, and tries to get a grip on her new reality.

1.title: FR - Undone - S01E04 - Moving the Keys
1.plot: Alma progresses through training with her dad, and continues to uncover information about his death.

1.title: FR - Undone - S01E05 - Alone in This (You Have Me)
1.plot: Alma realizes Sam has been lying to her and they get into a fight.

1.title: FR - Undone - S01E06 - Prayers and Visions
1.plot: Camila helps out at the church, and accompanies Becca on a food tasting with Reed’s family.

1.title: FR - Undone - S01E07 - The Wedding
1.plot: Alma attends Becca and Reed’s wedding while continuing to investigate her father's murder.

1.title: FR - Undone - S01E08 - That Halloween Night
1.plot: Alma goes back to the Halloween night Jacob died and tries to change the past.

2.title: FR - Undone - S02E01 - The Cave
2.plot: Alma questions her identity.

2.title: FR - Undone - S02E02 - The Painting
2.plot: Alma pushes her family to look at themeselves.

2.title: FR - Undone - S02E03 - Mexico
2.plot: Alma and Becca go to Mexico!

2.title: FR - Undone - S02E04 - Reflections
2.plot: Alma and Becca discover something about the past.

2.title: FR - Undone - S02E05 - Lungs
2.plot: Alma and Becca meet a stranger.

2.title: FR - Undone - S02E06 - Help Me
2.plot: Alma calls for help.

2.title: FR - Undone - S02E07 - Rectify
2.plot: Where are we?! What's happening?!

2.title: FR - Undone - S02E08 - We All Love Each Other
2.plot: All is well, or is it?

meta.plot: Après un accident de la route qui a failli lui coûter la vie, Alma se découvre un nouveau rapport au temps et se sert de cette nouvelle capacité pour découvrir la vérité sur la mort de son père.

1.title: FR - The Pentaverate - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Canadian reporter Ken Scarborough seeks out a hard-hitting story to save his job. Meanwhile, a new face is asked to join a centuries-old secret society.

1.title: FR - The Pentaverate - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: As the Meadows draws near, professor Clark attempts a scientific breakthrough, a guest investigates Jason's death, and Ken endures a painful test.

1.title: FR - The Pentaverate - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: At Pentaverate headquarters, a billionaire high roller arrives amid news of another death. Ken embeds with the guards and is sent on a risky mission.

1.title: FR - The Pentaverate - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: To retrieve the Parce Clavem, Ken heads to Dubrovnik, where a tricky challenge awaits. Later, a mysterious man and a helicopter ride upend Ken’s plans.

1.title: FR - The Pentaverate - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: After Patty's smarts prove invaluable, the Pentaverate races to the Meadows to stop a diabolical plan, while Ken and Reilly are taken hostage on a jet.

1.title: FR - The Pentaverate - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: At the Meadows, Ken strips down before rallying the guards into action. Can he stop the Pentaverate from falling into nefarious hands?

meta.plot: Une société secrète qui influe sur l'histoire depuis des siècles doit affronter une grave menace venue de l'intérieur. Le salut viendra-t-il d'un journaliste canadien ?

1.title: FR - La Bonne Terre - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: In Brussels, first-generation Moroccan immigrant and funerary business owner Omar retires, leaving his right-hand daughter and rebellious son in charge.

1.title: FR - La Bonne Terre - S01E02 - Barking Dogs
1.plot: Convinced that his idea is the future of the business, Ismael sets out to do some marketing with JB. Meanwhile, Omar keeps a big secret from his family.

1.title: FR - La Bonne Terre - S01E03 - Death of a Promise
1.plot: Ismael's one-off burial suddenly becomes the firm's specialty, so along with Nadia they prepare for the next one — a challenging, high-profile service.

1.title: FR - La Bonne Terre - S01E04 - He Who Digs a Well
1.plot: To buy Vanessa's silence and save the project, Ismael and JB get crafty and think out of the box. A miserable Rachid faces criticism from the community.

1.title: FR - La Bonne Terre - S01E05 - Palace Street
1.plot: Business booms and the firm gets nominated for an award, so Ismael sets out to secure funds for an expansion amid clashes with Rachid over customers.

1.title: FR - La Bonne Terre - S01E06 - Concession F24
1.plot: A tragic event ends Omar's trip and his return sets off a series of revelations and clashes complicating Ismael's situation. Brahim's truth gets out.

1.title: FR - La Bonne Terre - S01E07 - Diwan Awards
1.plot: Ahead of the Diwan Awards, Nadia scrambles to save the business and seeks Ismael's help. The arrival of an unannounced guest stirs up some family drama.

1.title: FR - La Bonne Terre - S01E08 - Nejma
1.plot: A furious Ismael heads out on a risky mission to Tangiers, his Moroccan hometown, putting family ties and the business at stake.

meta.plot: Pour relancer l'entreprise familiale, un jeune entrepreneur élabore un plan osé et risqué visant à importer de la terre du Maroc pour inhumer les morts de sa communauté.

1.title: FR - Les Monstres de Cracovie - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: After attracting the interest of a mysterious professor as the result of her first exam, Alex receives an invitation to join a unique group of students.

1.title: FR - Les Monstres de Cracovie - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Alex initially wants nothing to do with Professor Zawadzki's group but reconsiders when a horrifying demon begins following her.

1.title: FR - Les Monstres de Cracovie - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: When members of the group realize Alex is the demon's target, they take turns keeping watch over her. But they forget she's not the only one in danger.

1.title: FR - Les Monstres de Cracovie - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: As the giant Winter Spas roams around Cracow and leaves frozen bodies in his wake, Alex visits her grandmother in hopes of learning more about her past.

1.title: FR - Les Monstres de Cracovie - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Following Hvor's orders, Winter Spas spreads madness, disease and death throughout the streets of Cracow, creating chaos at the university's hospital.

1.title: FR - Les Monstres de Cracovie - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: To reconnect with her mother, Alex tries to induce a lucid dream. But she soon learns that the answers she seeks aren't in her fantasy.

1.title: FR - Les Monstres de Cracovie - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Alex returns from the underworld, bringing a protective deity with her. Hvor uses the professor's sick son to turn him against the group.

1.title: FR - Les Monstres de Cracovie - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: After the tragic events at the Barbican, Alex and the members of the group resolve to perform an old Slavic ritual to stop Hvor once and for all.

meta.plot: Une jeune femme hantée par son passé rejoint un mystérieux professeur et son groupe d'étudiants surdoués pour analyser des phénomènes paranormaux et combattre des démons.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E01 - It’s Summertime
1.plot: Renowned Mexican wakeboarder Steffi arrives at a remote Argentine resort to compete in a revived competition... and she's looking to uncover a secret.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E02 - Memories of Sky Vibes
1.plot: A pair of famous twins arrive at Cielo Grande. Steffi finds old photos that raise new questions. Luz and her friends sing while restoring Sky Vibes.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E03 - Friend Zone
1.plot: The twins' manager threatens to leave as the staff worries about Cielo's future. Julian discusses his crush on Luz, who has eyes for someone else.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E04 - New Competition
1.plot: Juan attempts to win Steffi over, with Ian's help. The Cielo Grande crew makes final preparations for Sky Vibes. A new competitor joins the ranks.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E05 - Who’s That Girl?
1.plot: Julian attempts to calm Steffi's nerves after the arrival of her rival Natasha rattles her. Luz launches Sky Vibes, but opening night hits a snag.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E06 - Date Night
1.plot: The identity of the girl in the photograph that Steffi found is revealed. Nati confesses she has a crush on someone. Luz and Tony go on a date.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E07 - Unexpected Trouble
1.plot: When one of the wakeboarders is injured during training, Luz makes a startling discovery. Steffi speaks to her father about his past.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E08 - Bird Leaves the Nest
1.plot: Luz and Steffi join forces to try to solve the mystery surrounding their past. Back at the resort, the crew practices a new "friend zone" song.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E09 - Truth or Dare?
1.plot: Steffi and Luz peel back multiple layers of deception when they confront Ron and Cynthia. Julian leads a meditation the night before the competition.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E10 - Summer Crush!
1.plot: It's finally the day of the Summer Crush competition, and Natasha and Steffi face off for the trophy as their friends and family watch.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E11 - Save Cielo
1.plot: The friends sing and perform in the "Save Cielo" fundraiser to help the resort pay its bills. Steffi has a heartfelt conversation with her father.

meta.plot: En relançant sa compétition de wakeboard, un hôtel reculé d'Argentine éveille l'intérêt de Steffi, une athlète mexicaine bien décidée à percer un secret de famille.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: The bucolic tranquility of Greylock, New Hampshire, is upended when a massive vein of an incredibly valuable mineral is discovered under the town.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E02 - Power
1.plot: Sarah is faced with her first major challenge as a leader when Greylock's power is shut off. Bella pushes boundaries with her dad when it comes to spending time with Tyler and Sarah.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E03 - The Lines Between Us
1.plot: When the governor of New Hampshire closes Greylock's borders, Sarah calls on Bella, Tyler and Maya to help her solve the problem. Corinne pushes Danny to reveal a secret that he's been keeping from everyone.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E04 - In Us We Trust
1.plot: When Sarah discovers that everyone in Greylock is being charged foreign transaction fees, she enlists her friends to help her create own currency. Grover shares with Danny what really happened to Corinne after he left.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E05 - The Criminals it Deserves
1.plot: With Lydon's workers causing problems, Sarah drafts an executive order to help protect Greylock's residents. Grover introduces Danny to a new friend, but they have more in common than Danny realizes. Maya feels abandoned.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E06 - A Show of Hands
1.plot: After a damaging magazine article is written about Sarah, she realizes that it's time for Greylock to create a more representative government. With an election open to anyone, Danny, Maya, AJ, and Corinne take a shot at the four available seats.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E07 - Sanctuary
1.plot: Greylock's fledgling congress must decide their immigration policy now that new people want to immigrate. Sarah and Danny face someone from their past and have different reactions to the visitor.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E08 - The Perfect Conditions for Disaster
1.plot: After an unexpected snowstorm leaves Greylock stranded with no plows, Sarah and the town come up with a creative plan to clear the roads. During the storm, Sarah gets two unexpected guests and tries to figure out how to navigate both circumstances.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E09 - Sons and Daughters
1.plot: When Corrine confides in Sarah about what happened with Danny, Corinne also admits that she needs Sarah's help with something she has always questioned. Sarah confronts Danny about what happened, leaving Danny to make a decision about his future.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E10 - From Simple Sources
1.plot: Greylock is threatened with a massive flood as unseasonably warm weather melts the snow from the recent blizzard. Knowing Greylock will be underwater in hours, Sarah must ask for help from the last person she wants to rely on—Paul.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E11 - Pledge Allegiance
1.plot: Sarah and Paul start to make headway in their relationship. Ellen surprises everyone by coming home earlier than expected. Danny accidentally makes things harder for Corinne, leaving her with a tough choice about some of the people in her life.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E12 - Two Imposters
1.plot: When Danny shares good news about Greylock's finances, Sarah winds up in a debate that traps her between her two closest friends. Corinne is trying to right her wrongs, but she can't catch a break, especially after Sarah drops a major bombshell. Meanwhile, Bella and Tyler get creative with each of their school projects, which helps Sarah and Grover in ways they didn't realize they needed.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E13 - The Last Rabbit
1.plot: Sarah is offered a chance for international recognition of Greylock but the price may be too high. Danny offers to help Corinne with her legal woes but she asks him for something unexpected.

meta.plot: Confrontée à la destruction de sa ville par une société minière cupide, l'enseignante rebelle du secondaire Sarah Cooper utilise une obscure faille cartographique pour déclarer son indépendance. Maintenant, Sarah doit diriger un jeune groupe d'inadaptés alors qu'ils tentent de créer leur propre pays à partir de zéro.

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E01 - LUX
1.plot: Esther cannot reach her husband after a great loss. She decides to look for him. Evi is assigned a murder case, which is linked to the suspected human trafficking couple Sylvia and Ingmar. Sylvia is offered a deal to testify against Ingmar, but declines. In the evening she receives one of her regular customers: Eric. Due to a misunderstanding, things get out of hand and Eric flees.

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E02 - Maman
1.plot: Esther reports Eric's missing. She finds out that Eric is cheating on her from photos of him and a woman with a specific tattoo, which she finds on her father's computer. Evi gets drunk at her twins' party and this leads to a big confrontation with Gust. Ingmar brings Imana to Amsterdam, where he has a fight with his rival Elarbi. Sylvia finds out that she is pregnant.

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E03 - "E"
1.plot: Sylvia lies that she had an abortion. She is confronted by the police with a photo of Ingmar, Petra and their child. Imana is brought back mutilated by Elarbi and wants to escape. Ingmar plots revenge on Elarbi. Evi goes to stay with Sam because Gust has kicked her out of the house. Esther finds out that the family business is almost bankrupt and Veronqiue is not the woman with the tattoo from Eric's photos. Everything becomes too much for her during a performance.

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E04 - Kashmir
1.plot: The body in the Scheldt turns out to be Eric's. Esther turns out not to be pregnant and is told not to use Eric's seed now that he is dead. Veronique confesses that she saw Eric at Tropicana and Evi and Sam are going to investigate further. They inform Esther about his visit to the club. Sylvia makes an appointment with the police. Esther decides to go to Tropicana herself. She finds herself in a dire situation and when she runs off, she recognizes Sylvia by her tattoo.

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E05 - Tropicana
1.plot: Esther is questioned by Evi and Sam about Eric's death. Esther insists she has nothing to do with it. Then she contacts Sylvia, who does not want to hear about it. Sylvia has enough on her mind betraying Ingmar. Together with the police, she makes a plan how they can catch Ingmar in the act. Evi and Gust seem to get closer to each other and for a moment they seem like a real family again, but Evi can't handle it anyway.

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E06 - Dearest Mother
1.plot: Esther tries in vain to contact Sylvia again and gives her a business card. Evi and Sam question Sylvia again. Sylvia complains about Esther harassing her. Evi follows Veronique, they arrive at Eric's funeral. Sam finds out that Veronique has an alibi. The police action is ready to begin when Sylvia warns Ingmar at the last minute and flees. Esther is shocked by an unexpected visit.

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E07 - Peacock Eye
1.plot: Esther does not know what to do with Sylvia and gives her money for a hotel. Esther becomes intimate with Jeroen when she confides in him. Evi is honest with Gust that she doesn't want to be a mother, which Gust doesn't understand at all. The research now focuses on Ingmar and Sylvia and Evi works together with Anna and Kamiel. Ingmar finds out about Sylvia's whereabouts and flees back to Esther. Sylvia makes Esther a very strange proposal ...

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E08 - Our House
1.plot: Evi and Sam help the human trafficking department with a large-scale raid on the bungalow park of Ingmar. Evi concludes that Sylvia is now the main suspect in Eric's case. Evi informs Esther and Esther confronts Sylvia. Sylvia does not understand and tells Esther what she thinks happened on that night. She tries to convince Esther to buy the baby. Evi suspects that Sylvia is with Esther and decides to observe them. Ingmar has apparently also received this information.

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E10 - Awake
1.plot: A confrontation ensues between Ingmar and the women. It finally becomes clear who is responsible for Eric's death. Esther and Sylvia struggle to flee, while Evi goes after Ingmar and his henchmen. Esther and Sylvia go to Spain, where Eric is said to have a house where Sylvia is safe. Meanwhile, Evi is faced with betrayal from someone close to her.

meta.plot: Trois femmes se retrouvent empêtrées dans le monde de la traite des êtres humains et de la prostitution lorsque le mari d'Esther disparaît soudainement. Venant d'univers complètement différents, les vies de ces femmes s'entremêlent. Elles découvrent qu'elles ont besoin les unes des autres pour échapper aux situations difficiles dans lesquelles elles se trouvent.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E01 - Imaginary Friends
1.plot: Young Dylan arrives at his relatives' home needing a place to live, but his streetwise swagger upends the conservative Wilson household.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E02 - Street Smart
1.plot: Yasmine’s celebrity client DJ Khaled visits, presenting Dylan with a golden opportunity to prove his rap credentials and score a record deal.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E03 - Chasing That Dream
1.plot: Dylan has trouble adjusting to the Wilson family’s rules, leading to confrontation with his uncle that makes him feel unwanted.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E04 - Plain Faces
1.plot: Dylan doesn’t want to attend school, and does whatever it takes to avoid going, including convincing little Charlie not to go, either.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E05 - The Enforcer
1.plot: On his first day at school, Dylan starts a classroom protest over having to wear uniforms.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E06 - Speechless
1.plot: The kids help Myles plan Yasmine’s big dinner at the house for her boss. While Myles struggles to write a speech in honor of his wife, the kids throw out the catered food and plan their own menu.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E07 - Flowers
1.plot: After failing to get approval to go to the school dance, Rebecca tells her date that she can’t go because her grandmother has died, a lie that leads to a series of misunderstandings within the family.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E08 - In Too Deep
1.plot: As Myles and Yasmine sort out the truth behind a lie that spun out control, Dylan helps them plan payback on Rebecca before she gets home.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E09 - Mother May I
1.plot: Dylan writes a serious rap about his mom, prompting Martin to read his diary to find out if he’s doing ok. Dylan catches him in the act, triggering an escalating run of each family member invading the others’ privacy.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E10 - Teachable Moments
1.plot: Rebecca is being bullied online, prompting Dylan to encourage Martin to respond to some of the posts. His posts are not anonymous, however, and the family must deal with the fallout.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E11 - Natural Beauty
1.plot: Dylan tries to help Charlie with his homework, but his unconventional style of doing his homework comes to a head with Dylan gets into a rap battle with their teacher.

1.title: FR - Plan cœur - S01E04 - The Love Plan
1.plot: Elsa navigates a dizzying swirl of emotions after her night with Jules. Matthieu makes a confession. Antoine springs a surprise on Milou.

1.title: FR - Plan cœur - S01E06 - The Lame Plan

2.title: FR - Plan cœur - S02E03 - The Backup Plan
2.plot: When Elsa's lies come back to bite her, she vows to tell her friends the truth. But a surprise bachelor party upends everyone's day.

2.title: FR - Plan cœur - S02E04 - The Pick-Up Plan

1.title: FR - Björnstad - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: On a mission to rejuvenate the struggling community's ice hockey program, recently retired pro player Peter Andersson relocates his family to Beartown for a fresh start. But when the elite squad he was promised proves to be anything but, Peter switches his focus to the junior team, aggravating local tensions and reigniting his troubled past with star player Kevin Erdahl's father, Mats.

1.title: FR - Björnstad - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: With the finals rapidly approaching, Peter pushes his team and coaching staff to their limits. Meanwhile, as Maya attempts to work through the assault, Kevin does everything he can to forget. Later, Peter must choose between his family and the big game.

1.title: FR - Björnstad - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: While Maya and Kevin provide their statements to the police, the junior team is forced to take on the final without their coach and star player. Meanwhile, news of the allegation threatens to tear Beartown apart, and later, Amat grapples with a loaded offer.

1.title: FR - Björnstad - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: The entire hockey community gathers for an emergency meeting to decide Peter's future with the program. Facing increased hostility from the town and harassment at school, Maya reaches her breaking point. Later, after the police close their investigation, Maya and Kevin square off in a chilling confrontation. Season Finale.

meta.plot: Le hockey est la dernière lueur d’espoir pour la ville de Beartown de regagner une certaine dynamique. Une lourde responsabilité pour Peter, le nouvel entraîneur de l'équipe junior, et Kevin, l'étoile montante. Au milieu de cette effervescence, un acte violent sème le trouble au sein de la communauté...

1.title: FR - Nos années miraculeuses - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Summer 1948: The D-Mark is introduced, delighting sisters Ulla, Gundel and Margot. A new phase of post-war life begins for the three sisters.

1.title: FR - Nos années miraculeuses - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Ulla is accepted to medical school in Tubingen. Gundel’s father refuses to let her run the family company and Gundel seeks revenge on Ulla.

1.title: FR - Nos années miraculeuses - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Eduard Wolf is on trial for war crimes. Ulla wants to prove his innocence. Until further notice, Gundel will run the family business.

1.title: FR - Nos années miraculeuses - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: The old feelings between Ulla and Tommy flare up again in East Berlin. But there is too much division between them.

1.title: FR - Nos années miraculeuses - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Margot marries Bocker. As the new managing director of United Metal Works, he wants to have ammunition manufactured.

1.title: FR - Nos années miraculeuses - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: After almost a week in which no one has heard from Bocker, he suddenly appears again. He makes accusations that Margot betrayed him.

meta.plot: L'histoire de la famille Wolf dans l'Allemagne des années 40 et 50. Alors qu'Eduard Wolf est jugé pour crimes de guerre, Ulla tente de prouver son innocence. Pendant ce temps, Gundel reprend la gestion de l'entreprise familiale.

1.title: FR - Anne Boleyn - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: The queen consort is pregnant and convinced she will bear Henry VIII a male heir, with their first-born Elizabeth being overlooked for the throne, but the king has his eye on Jane Seymour, one of Anne's ladies-in-waiting.

1.title: FR - Anne Boleyn - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Anne Boleyn's position at court is in serious jeopardy and her new mission is to secure her daughter's right to the throne. However, Cromwell has other ideas.

1.title: FR - Anne Boleyn - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Anne Boleyn is accused of treason and adultery and stands trial. However, she is prejudged as Cromwell bribes and blackmails her ladies into testifying against Anne.

meta.plot: Biopic qui retrace les derniers mois d'Anne Boleyn, la seconde épouse du roi Henri VIII, en réimaginant sa lutte avec la société patriarcale de l'Angleterre des Tudor, son désir d'assurer un avenir à sa fille, Elizabeth, et la réalité brutale de son échec à fournir à son mari un héritier mâle.

Tout bascule quand devant les caméras, Fodé Thiam, la star du Racing, assène un violent coup de tête à son entraineur et le traite de « sale toubab ».« Toubab », cela signifie « blanc » en Wolof. 1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Nothing is going well in Joseph's life. His marriage to Marie is running out of steam: it is obvious that he is no longer attracted to his wife who is in despair. At work, it's not better. Oppressed by a tyrannical boss, Joseph spends his days in front of his computer, alone and jaded, selling labels. The only person who seems to want to bond with him is Jacques, the company computer scientist, a clumsy nerd who is harassed by his colleagues. But one evening, after having received a couple of friends at their home, Joseph suddenly had a severe stomach ache.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Joseph goes to a gold buyer who estimates his turd at ... 30,000 euros.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: While shopping, Joseph bumps into his upset friend Sylvie. She suspects her husband Stéphane is having an affair.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Joseph is now sure that his wife is cheating on him with Stéphane but prefers to feign ignorance. The gold buyer turns out to be a thug and begins to take a closer interest in Joseph, who has decided to hide his gold turds rather than sell them to him.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Gilles, Joseph's father, tells him that he used to lay gold in the past too! Joseph immediately understands that his mother was cheating on his father who never suspected anything. Marie begins to suspect Joseph to know about her affair with Stéphane.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Nothing goes for Joseph: he realizes that one of his productions is missing of its hiding place and then suspects Marie.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Between Joseph and Marie, the atmosphere is more relaxed since the truth is known. As everything seems to be going better, his marriage comes back to life and he is ready to buy his company, Joseph is kidnapped by Gino, driven by a spirit of revenge after the death of his father, the gold buyer.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Gino still threatens Joseph to get his turds back, while Marie breaks up with Stéphane.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Joseph and Marie find themselves prisoners in Gino's cellar, who intends to sleep with Marie so that Joseph can lay eggs.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: At the head of his new company, Joseph tries to find a solution to reimburse the tax authorities. To help, Jacques invests his mother's inheritance. Gino then offers to help ...

meta.plot: Un VRP d’une petite PME de banlieue dont la morne vie se résume à : métro-boulot et mariage raté, découvre un jour un stupéfiant pouvoir : il pond de l’or.

1.title: FR - Diggstown - S01E01 - Willy MacIsaac

Pam hits Colleen's bureaucratic red tape when she volunteers to represent a disinherited friend. Marcie struggles to overcome her anger at the pastor who she believes helped drive her aunt to suicide.

1.title: FR - Diggstown - S01E02 - Renee Joy
1.plot: An activist lawyer jeopardizes the future of Marcie's musically gifted teen client in the name of “the greater good.” Doug's defence of a lawyer accused of defrauding his community of millions dredges up his past at the Eskasoni reserve. Marcie and Carson struggle to keep their jobs from coming between them.

1.title: FR - Diggstown - S01E03 - Taisir Ahmed
1.plot: Marcie races to find her client after he's snatched off the street by law enforcement. Pam scrambles to track down a new home for her pregnant client after her arguments against an eviction leads to the building being condemned. Marcie's work-place dating advice to Leah falls on deaf ears.

1.title: FR - Diggstown - S01E04 - Delroy Nelson

2.plot: Marcie's patience is tested when an Indigenous girl accused of murder refuses a deal that will afford her a more lenient sentence. Iris butts heads with Reggie when he fails to notice a client being blatantly racist, and Pam has an unexpected scare.

2.title: FR - Diggstown - S02E03 - Willy MacIsaac Redux
2.plot: Marcie's previous client Willie MacIsaac resurfaces, this time charged with the murder of his ex-wife, Gloria; Doug fights for a nurse accused of stealing from his elderly patient who has fallen into a coma.

2.title: FR - Diggstown - S02E04 - Tanya Ianova
2.plot: Marcie defends trans woman, Tanya Ianova, when she is charged in a seafood stealing scheme masterminded by her boss, but the efforts to clear Tanya's name may lead to her deportation.

2.title: FR - Diggstown - S02E05 - Vi Bayley
2.plot: Marcie defends a hair salon owner who is charged in connection with the assault of a gang member; Doug's relationship with a former client place him and Pam in the crosshairs of a misconduct complain

Tara et Pascal, deux trentenaires allumés et un brin perfectionnistes sont les parents de 10 enfants. Chaque épisode offre un regard intime et drôle sur la vie d'un foyer où le quotidien n'est jamais banal.

1.title: FR - High School Girls : La série - S01E01 - New Year, New Plans
1.plot: Julia, her new roomie Jason and their friends prepare to submit their school project ideas. But the new, test-obsessed headmaster Agnes has other plans.

1.title: FR - High School Girls : La série - S01E02 - Lacisum
1.plot: The Misfits get sneakily creative under the watchful eye of Agnes as they recruit other squads for their musical and try to find a place to practice.

1.title: FR - High School Girls : La série - S01E04 - Hard to Get
1.plot: After someone working with Agnes sabotages the rehearsal by destroying props and changing the script, Julia and the others start to suspect each other.

1.title: FR - High School Girls : La série - S01E05 - BFF
1.plot: Julia is tempted by dreams of fame while Nick struggles to be honest. Meanwhile, the musical takes another hit, and the girls confront their suspect.

1.title: FR - High School Girls : La série - S01E06 - Tomorrow, Everything Will Be Different
1.plot: The Misfits come together to solve the mystery of the saboteur while Julia and Magenta make the choice between their dreams and their friends.

1.title: FR - High School Girls : La série - S01E07 - The Show Must Go On
1.plot: The Misfits' excitement for the musical is dampened by betrayal and hurt feelings. In an additional setback, 10 students are forced to leave campus.

1.plot: It's showtime! With everyone separated, the quiz show begins with Agnes on top. But the Misfits don't intend to back down.

meta.plot: L'année de folie de la bande commence mal : la nouvelle proviseure décide d'annuler la comédie musicale qu'ils préparaient. Julia doit sauver la situation.

1.title: FR - Hierro - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Candela, an unconventional judge with character, is sent to the remotest possible posting, El Hierro, an island that is full of peculiar characteristics, where she doesn’t quite fit in. As soon as she arrives, she must face a murder case. The victim is Fran, a young man who was going to get married on that very day. Everything seems to suggest the culprit is Díaz, Fran’s boss and father of the bride, a shady local businessman who had served sentence for murder as a young man.

1.title: FR - Hierro - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Candela must decide if Díaz is kept in pretrial custody. Against the criterium of her team, and of the whole island, he is released on bail, although he won’t be allowed to leave the island and he will be closely monitored. In any case, it’s an extremely unpopular decision, compounded by Díaz’s determination to find the real culprit by himself. Candela, at odds with her own team, needs someone by her side to rely on, someone who also knows the ropes of the island. She takes a new controversial decision – she includes Reyes, a local police officer, in the investigation team.

1.title: FR - Hierro - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The investigation brings to light the dark side of Fran’s life: he had established contact with some mysterious person in Holland, and he had an affair with an unknown lover. Did Fran die because he was involved in some shady business? Or was it a crime of passion? Both Candela and Díaz make progress in their respective investigations, carried out independently. Díaz believes Fran used his contacts from the milieu of a dangerous drug smuggler. And Candela makes an uncomfortable discovery – Fran’s mysterious lover is someone very close to her.

1.title: FR - Hierro - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: During a clandestine trip out of the island, Díaz discovers that Fran, just before he died, was trying to sell some valuable merchandise. He doesn’t know what kind of merchandise. And above all, he doesn’t know who was the partner from El Hierro who cooperated with him in the operation. This mysterious partner could be the murderer, because he is trying to get something from Fran’s environment (he broke into his and his mother’s houses…) Meanwhile, Candela feels the police investigation is progressing too slowly. The only person she trusts is Reyes. And in fact, the local police officer does discover (and us with her) who the murderer is. But she won’t live to tell the tale.

1.title: FR - Hierro - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: The murderer, upon being found out, kills Reyes. From that moment on, he faces the difficulty of getting rid of the body in an island like El Hierro, where it is difficult to vanish without trace. Especially after the disappearance of the local police officer gives rise to a public outcry. There is a reaction in the island. Police forces, civil defense services and volunteers start a desperate search. The most likely scenario is that the murderer Reyes was investigating is back in action. Candela is devastated; she feels guilty because she is the one who enlisted Reyes for an investigation that strictly speaking was not part of her work duties.

1.title: FR - Hierro - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Reyes hasn’t been found, but the search operation leads to tracing down a sunk boat which will provide new clues. The boat was used for smuggling African diamonds, and was found by Fran in a diving excursion. Diamonds are the shady business he was involved in. Candela cannot accept defeat in the search for Reyes, or the slowing down in the speed of the investigation as a result of the Descent, a religious festivity that paralyzes the island every four years. Desperate, she tries to get Díaz’s cooperation, who is also vent on finding the real culprit. The murderer feels the investigation is closing down on him. He considers fleeing, but he hasn’t found the diamonds hidden by Fran yet. And he diverts attention to everyone’s ideal false culprit – Díaz.

1.title: FR - Hierro - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Díaz avoids being arrested by desperately fleeing. But leaving the island without being found out is impossible, especially with a police operation that shut up firmly the few available exit routes from the island. Finally, Díaz gets caught. And the island sighs, relieved – they will be able to celebrate their Descent in peace. Only three people in the island seem anxious: Díaz himself, who knows that someone has planted false evidence to frame him; Candela, who has a hunch there must be something wrong; and the murderer, who got the police off his back, but who continues looking for the diamonds that are at the root of his whole adventure. In the middle of the Descent festivities, the murderer discovers the location of the diamonds.

1.title: FR - Hierro - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: The murderer, taking advantage of the chaotic situation during the Descent, manages to get hold of the diamonds. But now he must face a new obstacle – the drug smuggler whose help Fran had enlisted has been following him, and he wants to take the diamonds himself. Meanwhile, Candela and Díaz go over their investigations together, and find the key to identify the murderer. They trace him down when he is on his way out of the island. They have caught him. But he is not prepared to surrender.

meta.plot: Mutée à El Hierro, l’île la plus éloignée de l’archipel des Canaries, la juge Candela se retrouve confrontée au meurtre d’un jeune local, assassiné la veille de son mariage avec la fille de Diaz, un riche entrepreneur à la réputation sulfureuse. Ce dernier devient rapidement le principal suspect du crime. Bien que mus par des intérêts diamétralement opposés, Candela et Diaz ont un objectif commun : découvrir le véritable assassin.

meta.plot:
Alexandra Ehle est médecin légiste à l'IML de Bordeaux. Brillante, fantasque et libre, elle évolue dans cet univers avec une aisance déconcertante. Elle s'est donné une mission : rendre aux morts leur intégrité physique, mais aussi  "humaine", leur rendre justice. Alors, elle mène ses propres enquêtes, en dépit des recommandations de son équipe et des mises en garde d'Antoine Doisneau, commandant de la PJ, qu elle prend un malin plaisir à devancer...

Alex est assistée par le jeune Théo Durrel, fraîchement débarqué à l’IML. Pas insensible à son charme, il fait tout pour la satisfaire, mais il n’est pas franchement à l’aise dans cet univers. Alex et Théo vont former un duo aussi improbable qu’efficace, et tant pis s’ils doivent faire fi des règles de droit élémentaires…

1.title: FR - L'Imposture - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: The undercover operation gains momentum as prime suspect Colin Stagg starts to fall for covert officer 'Lizzie James'. But when the honeytrap is compromised, Detective Inspector Pedder must act fast.

1.title: FR - L'Imposture - S01E03 - Episode 3

1.title: FR - L'Imposture - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: While Colin Stagg is on remand in prison, another horrific murder occurs with some clear similarities. Is Stagg in fact an entirely innocent man?

meta.plot: Afin de résoudre le meurtre de Rachel Nickell poignardée puis violée en 1992, une femme officier mène une enquête sous couverture afin de confondre le tueur présumé. Sous le nom de "Lizzie James", elle va devenir l’appât sexuel de celui qui va lui faire vivre l’expérience la plus dangereuse de sa carrière.

1.title: FR - Goliath - S01E01 - Of Mice and Men

1.title: FR - Goliath - S01E02 - Pride and Prejudice
1.plot: Billy scrambles to get his wrongful death lawsuit into court by any means necessary.

1.title: FR - Goliath - S01E03 - Game On
1.plot: The judge gives Billy only a day to make a compelling offer of proof before he dismisses the lawsuit.

1.title: FR - Goliath - S01E04 - It's Donald

1.plot: As both sides begin their depositions, more secrets start to come to the surface, threatening to destroy everyone involved.

1.title: FR - Goliath - S01E06 - Line of Fire
1.plot: Billy has to go to great lengths to secure his physical evidence's safety and preserve his witnesses' credibility.

1.title: FR - Goliath - S01E07 - Beauty and the Beast
1.plot: With danger mounting around every corner, Billy has to decide whether to head directly to trial or take his chances with a continuance.

1.title: FR - Goliath - S01E08 - Citizens United
1.plot: The trial concludes as former partners and old friends have their final showdown in court.

2.title: FR - Goliath - S02E01 - La Mano

2.title: FR - Goliath - S02E06 - Two Cinderellas
2.plot: Believing his client will soon be a free man, Billy joins Marisol for a romantic weekend in Mexico, only for his case to fall apart at home.

2.title: FR - Goliath - S02E07 - Diablo Verde
2.plot: Held hostage by strangers and with no memory of how he got there, Billy has to make a harrowing escape from Mexico.

2.title: FR - Goliath - S02E08 - Tongue Tied
2.plot: On the night of the mayoral election, Billy and his team race to take down the people responsible before they become an unstoppable Goliath.

3.plot: The unexpected death of an old friend takes Billy McBride to California’s Central Valley, where a record drought has made water more valuable than human life.

3.title: FR - Goliath - S03E02 - Happiness from the Ground Up

3.title: FR - Goliath - S03E03 - Good Morning, Central Valley
3.plot: As Billy and Patty begin a class action lawsuit against the corporate farmers, the Blackwoods start dealing with everyone who gets in their way, including Billy.

3.plot: As Billy and Patty make their first appearance in court, their class action is threatened when they walk into traps set for them by the Blackwoods.

3.title: FR - Goliath - S03E06 - Fer-De-Lance
3.plot: Billy and Patty grill the Blackwoods in their depositions, shining a light on their complicated relationship and how they obtained ownership of the county’s water supply.

3.title: FR - Goliath - S03E07 - Conscious Uncoupling
3.plot: Billy puts Wade Blackwood on the stand and under oath, forcing him to admit every detail of his scheme to steal the state’s water.

3.title: FR - Goliath - S03E08 - Joy Division
3.plot: As Billy and Patty close in on the Blackwoods, Wade tries to cover up their crimes while Diana makes one final, desperate play, regardless who gets in her way.

4.title: FR - Goliath - S04E01 - Hadleyville
4.plot: Billy returns to his Big Law roots after Patty takes a job at a prestigious white-shoe law firm in San Francisco. Together, they try to take down one of America’s most insidious Goliaths: the opioid industry.

4.title: FR - Goliath - S04E02 - The Pain Killer
4.plot: Patty finds herself on the hook for Billy’s behavior as he digs deeper into the case.

4.title: FR - Goliath - S04E03 - Signed, William Hamilton McBride
4.plot: As Billy and Sam grow closer, he discovers that the opioid industry is keeping bigger secrets than he ever imagined.

4.title: FR - Goliath - S04E04 - Forcibly Removed
4.plot: Billy goes to extremes to keep the case alive, and Sam questions whether bringing him on board was a good idea after all.

4.title: FR - Goliath - S04E05 - Spilt Milk
4.plot: As Billy faces repercussions from his conduct, he is forced into a truce with an old adversary.

4.title: FR - Goliath - S04E06 - Rundleworks
4.plot: Billy and Patty take measures to protect a witness, while the partners at Margolis & True scramble to strengthen their case.

4.title: FR - Goliath - S04E07 - Lawyer Trickery Bullshit
4.plot: When Patty calls a surprise witness to the stand, the defense does everything they can to undermine the witness’s credibility.

4.title: FR - Goliath - S04E08 - It's Time
4.plot: In a final showdown with George Zax, Billy and Patty seek justice for the victims of the opioid epidemic, no holds barred.

meta.plot: Autrefois puissant avocat, Billy McBride est maintenant épuisé et désenchanté, passant plus de temps dans les bars que dans les salles d'audience. Quand il accepte à contrecœur de reprendre un procès sur une mort suspecte contre le plus grand cabinet d'avocat " Cooperman & McBride",  qu'il a aidé à créer, Billy et son semblant d'équipe découvrent une vaste conspiration mortelle, les opposant tous dans un procès de vie ou de mort contre le Goliath ultime.

1.title: FR - Chabracadabra - S01E01 - The Amulet

She soon learns 2 bad witches, Wilma and Wanda are after her locket so they can have ultimate power, and she alongside her best friends Scout and Lily turn into cats to escape.

1.title: FR - Chabracadabra - S01E02 - If the Hat Fits...

1.plot: Determined to make more of her potion, Willa enrolls in science club — for better or worse. Elsewhere, Willa’s dad faces off with Wilma and Wanda.

1.plot: As a “witch-buster” teams up with a “witch-storian,” Wilma and Wanda recruit new, nosey help, and Willa, Scout and Lucy meet an enchanting mentor.

1.title: FR - Chabracadabra - S01E08 - The Legend of the Witches of Winding Way

meta.plot: Pour ses 12 ans, Willa Ward reçoit un cadeau miaou-gnifique qui lui ouvre les portes d'un univers de sorcellerie et d'animaux bavards, à explorer avec ses amies !

1.title: FR - Bless This Mess - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Newlyweds Rio and Mike drop everything (including their jobs and overbearing mother-in-law) to make the move from big city New York to rural Nebraska in search of a simpler life. They soon realize that becoming farmers isn’t as easy as they planned as they are faced with unexpected challenges.

1.title: FR - Bless This Mess - S01E02 - The Chicken and the Goat
1.plot: After weeks of researching soil revitalization and coming up with a wonderful plan to make their farm successful, Rio and Mike are forced to find a new strategy when the weather forecast is not in their favor. As Mike tries to focus on addressing the dead soil, Rio attempts to connect with new neighbors at the Bowman's potluck but ends up spicing up her romantic relationship with Mike instead.

1.title: FR - Bless This Mess - S01E03 - The Return of Short Shorts
1.plot: Mike attempts to fit in with the Coffee Boys in order to get rid of his old nickname, “Short Shorts,” by trying to prove to them that he’s a “true farmer.” Meanwhile, Rio finally gets Constance to open up to her, and she discovers that Constance has a liking for Rudy.

1.title: FR - Bless This Mess - S01E04 - Predators
1.plot: Rio is having trouble adjusting to social and cultural differences between New York and Nebraska, resulting in a few awkward encounters. Through their wild chase to catch an unwanted predator that is after their chickens, Mike and Rio soon convince Rudy and Beau to step out of their comfort zones by getting them to express their feelings.

1.title: FR - Bless This Mess - S01E05 - In Hot Water
1.plot: In order to afford a new water heater, Rio and Mike must come up with ways to make money since Mike refuses to let Rio's mom, Donna, pay for it. Mike decides to sell their chickens' eggs at the local farmers market; and Rio tries to find new clients for therapy, but the town doesn't seem to want their business.

1.title: FR - Bless This Mess - S01E06 - The Estonian Method
1.plot: Mike and Rio enter the "best hen" competition at the county fair with their prized chicken Priyanka in order to prove themselves to the community. Meanwhile, romantic sparks fly between Rudy and Constance, only to be halted by a run-in with someone from Rudy's past; and Kay and Beau struggle with some marital issues.

2.title: FR - Bless This Mess - S02E01 - 459
2.plot: Mike and Rio host the big event of college football season: the town’s Huskers kickoff party. But no one in Bucksnort believes they can pull it off. They might be right when Rio loses Portia, the pig that’s been selected for the lucky pig race. Beau and Kay frantically try to hide the fact that they’ve split up, with mixed results.

2.title: FR - Bless This Mess - S02E02 - Phase Two
2.plot: Mike and Rio attempt to reignite their love life, after getting pressure about it from Beau; Constance and Rudy grapple with how to unveil their relationship to Constance's son.

2.title: FR - Bless This Mess - S02E03 - Omaha
2.plot: The ladies head to Omaha for their annual exams, but the trip quickly goes off the rails; Kay is jealous of Beau's new dating profile; Mike, Rudy and Beau bond when an accident leaves them stranded in a tree.

2.title: FR - Bless This Mess - S02E04 - Bang For Your Buck
2.plot: Mike decides to get back into journalism by reinvigorating the town newspaper.

2.title: FR - Bless This Mess - S02E05 - Scare Night
2.plot: Mike and Rio first met on Halloween years ago, so now Mike loves to commemorate the holiday by scaring the wits out of Rio all night. Unbeknownst to Mike, Rio actually hates the scares but is afraid to tell Mike. When Rio turns the tables on Mike and tries to scare him into ending Scare Night, Mike gets bitten by a bat and the night escalates from there.

2.title: FR - Bless This Mess - S02E06 - The Visit
2.plot: Donna springs a last-minute trip to Nebraska on Mike and Rio, which she claims is to relax, but Mike and Rio soon find out she has other plans in mind when she steps into competitive mode to get them to participate in the harvest. Meanwhile, Constance's son Brandon is driving her crazy working at the store, so she pawns him off on Rudy.

2.title: FR - Bless This Mess - S02E07 - Six Out of Six
2.plot: Mike and Rio are at odds with each other when they consider having a kid of their own; and they soon get a taste of the parenting life when they are forced to take care of Portia’s six piglets. Meanwhile, Kay and Beau may have found common ground during the annual Euchre tournament party

2.title: FR - Bless This Mess - S02E08 - The Grisham Gals
2.plot: Rio tries to help Kay get over her jealousy of her sister Stacey who is in town visiting, but soon finds herself jealous of Kay's near-perfect sister when she learns that Mike and Stacey used to date. Meanwhile, Rudy and Constance want to take their releationship to the next Level.

2.title: FR - Bless This Mess - S02E09 - Goose Glazing Time
2.plot: Mike and Rio are thrilled about having their first Christmas alone as a married couple, but a wrench is thrown into their romanticized holiday plans as they are interrupted by crisis after crisis; Kay invites Beau home for Christmas.

2.title: FR - Bless This Mess - S02E10 - Bad Seed
2.plot: Mike and Rio must decide what seed to start growing on their farm; Rio tries to get Beau and Kay's relationship to set sail; Jacob shadows Constance for a school project, making Rudy a nervous wreck while they discuss catching criminals.

meta.plot: Le projet d'un couple de jeunes mariés de quitter la grande ville pour une vie plus calme dans le Nebraska ne se déroule pas comme prévu.

1.title: FR - Cross - S01E01 - Hero Complex
1.plot: Washington, D.C. Detective Alex Cross is called to solve the case when a Black Lives Matter activist is killed in cold blood.

1.title: FR - Cross - S01E02 - Ride the White Horsey
1.plot: Emir Goodspeed's murder spreads like wildfire through D.C., catching others in its burn, while D.C.-powerbroker Ed Ramsey seduces his next victim: an art aficionado named Shannon Witmer.

1.title: FR - Cross - S01E03 - The Good Book
1.plot: Cross raids a home connected to Emir's murder. The suspect escapes, but leaves behind a piece of evidence so unique, it limits the list of suspects to an elite D.C. few.

1.title: FR - Cross - S01E04 - Masks
1.plot: With Cross hot on his heels, Ed Ramsey sets up a new locale to perform his kills, as the Cross family continues to be tormented by a mysterious someone connected to Deirdre Nolan.

1.title: FR - Cross - S01E05 - What Happens at Ramsey's
1.plot: Cross and Elle dine at Ed Ramsey's house for his annual birthday soiree. But the night's twists take a dark turn, when Cross realizes that Ramsey's next victim is in the house.

1.title: FR - Cross - S01E06 - A Bang, Not a Whimper
1.plot: A fresh lead sends Cross to Philly with his son Damon. Along the way, father and son reconnect through the shared grief over Maria's death.

1.title: FR - Cross - S01E07 - Happy Birthday
1.plot: Cross closes in on Ed Ramsey as the clock desperately ticks down to the moment when Shannon Witmer is set to die. Will Cross make it in time?

1.title: FR - Cross - S01E08 - You Had Me at Motherfucker
1.plot: Cross realizes that his attempt to protect his family has put them in more danger. He races against time to rescue the people he loves.

2.title: FR - Cross - S02E01 - Harrow
2.plot: When billionaire Lance Durand's life is threatened, Alex Cross is called into action. But to find the killer, Cross must discover why someone would want to murder the man that feeds America.

2.title: FR - Cross - S02E02 - Scatter
2.plot: A break in the investigation brings the team to Chicago, following the man with the haunting grin from surveillance footage. Meanwhile, Kayla's personal mission encounters a tragedy.

2.title: FR - Cross - S02E03 - Feed
2.plot: After finding clues in the subway, Cross' team tracks the suspect to Texas where they must work with Homeland Security to uncover another criminal enterprise.

2.title: FR - Cross - S02E04 - Harden
2.plot: Two vigilantes meet in a Florida hotel room, and plans are hatched to exact justice. But when their connection endangers both their lives, an impossible decision is made: only one can live.

2.title: FR - Cross - S02E05 - Climb
2.plot: A breakthrough brings Cross and Kayla to the remaining vigilante. She'll turn herself in, if Cross meets her at a specific place. But Kayla warns it may be a trap.

2.title: FR - Cross - S02E06 - Gather
2.plot: Cross decodes the evidence to learn the vigilante is killing people in a specific order. He rushes to save the next person on the list, before it's too late.

2.title: FR - Cross - S02E07 - Winnow
2.plot: Those on the kill list are rushed to a military base. There, the tightly-packed billionaires turn on each other. Then one reveals a secret that could turn this case on it's head.

meta.plot: Alex Cross, inspecteur de la criminelle de Washington, est confronté à un tueur en série sadique. Lui et son partenaire, John Sampson, traquent ce tueur et une menace issue du passé de Cross apparaît avec de mauvaises intentions.

1.title: FR - The Pembrokeshire Murders - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Detective Superintendent Steve Wilkins reinvestigates one of Pembrokeshire's most notorious unsolved crimes, known locally as the Coastal Path Murders.

1.title: FR - The Pembrokeshire Murders - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: A long-awaited forensic breakthrough gives Detective Steve Wilkins and his team the ammunition they need to finally arrest and prosecute John Cooper.

meta.plot: Detective superintendent reopens two unsolved murder cases from the 1980s. Forensic methods link the crimes to a string of burglaries. Steve's team has to find more evidence before the perpetrator is released from prison.

1.plot: Marianne is pregnant with Axel's child and travels back to Norway to say goodbye to her dying father. Leonard is in love from afar.

1.title: FR - À Marianne de Leonard - S01E07 - Chelsea Hotel
1.plot: Leonard goes to New York and experiences a fateful meeting at the Chelsea Hotel. Marianne feels abandoned at Hydra and seeks solace elsewhere.

1.title: FR - À Marianne de Leonard - S01E08 - So Long, Leonard
1.plot: Leonard secures a record deal, but the substance abuse continues. Marianne goes to New York to help him.

meta.plot: À MARIANNE DE LEONARD raconte l’histoire d’amour légendaire du chanteur et poète canadien Leonard Cohen et d'une femme norvégienne extraordinaire, Marianne Ihlen. C’est l’histoire intime de deux personnes solitaires qui tombent amoureuses l’une de l’autre dans une période de leur vie où elles tentent de comprendre qui elles sont et quelle est leur place dans le monde.

1.title: FR - Secrets de famille - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: When recently-widowed Vivien announces her love for a new man, Mark, it throws her family of adult children into chaos.

1.title: FR - Secrets de famille - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Vivien shocks her children by announcing she plans to sell their childhood home and go travelling with Mark. Each of the three siblings also has personal problems of their own to contend with - Helen's actions at work are beginning to have an impact on her marriage, Jake is shocked to discover that Leila might be moving on, and Natalie's affair starts to threaten her physical safety

1.title: FR - Secrets de famille - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The children's ongoing distrust starts to put a strain on Vivien and Mark's relationship. Meanwhile, Natalie struggles deal with her situation with Tony, and Jake turns to Stella for advice. Later, Jake unearths a darkly disturbing secret about Mark's past.

meta.plot: Chair et sang est l'histoire moderne de trois frères et sœurs adultes - Helen, Jake et Natalie - qui sont jetés dans le désarroi lorsque leur mère Vivien, récemment veuve, déclare qu'elle est amoureuse d'un nouvel homme.

1.title: FR - Histoire de Lisey - S01E01 - Bool Hunt
1.plot: Lisey Landon begins to face repressed realities about her late husband, novelist Scott Landon, two years after his death.

1.title: FR - Histoire de Lisey - S01E02 - Blood Bool
1.plot: Lisey calls Professor Dashmiel to warn him about Jim Dooley, who is already close at hand.

1.title: FR - Histoire de Lisey - S01E03 - Under the Yum-Yum Tree
1.plot: The bool hunt leads Lisey to a moment from her past, when Scott shared a confession about his family and traumatic childhood.

1.title: FR - Histoire de Lisey - S01E04 - Jim Dandy
1.plot: After a terrifying experience, Lisey opens up the gates of her memory to find answers in Scott’s world of Boo’ya Moon.

1.title: FR - Histoire de Lisey - S01E05 - The Good Brother

Alors qu’elles rêvent de conquérir le monde, elles font face à des hauts et des bas dans leur carrière, font de nouvelles rencontres et connaissent des peines de coeur qui vont les amener à se poser des questions sur leur vie : qui sont-elles et où vont-elles ?

meta.plot: Lorsque le fils de Jodie Walsh, âgé de 4 ans, disparait lors d’un pique-nique au bord du lac, il est présumé noyé. Son corps n’a jamais été retrouvé. Pourtant 9 ans plus tard, lorsque Jodie aperçoit un adolescent sur le chemin de l’école, elle en est convaincue, c’est lui ! La vie qu’elle a minutieusement reconstruite pendant tant d’années est ébranlée mais elle est prête à tout pour prouver qu’elle a raison. Va-t-elle convaincre la police et sa propre famille que l’homme qui s’occupe actuellement du garçon n’est pas son père mais son ravisseur ?

meta.plot: Une troupe de scouts débarque à Warnaffe pour leur grand camp d'été. Parmi eux, le dernier venu de la patrouille des Coyotes, Kevin, un garçon rebelle et solitaire. Dès le premier soir, il part pour trouver de quoi fumer dans le village voisin. Il y rencontre Marie qui est la recherche de Toni, son ex, dont elle n'est plus amoureuse et dont elle n'a plus de nouvelles. C'est le coup de foudre entre elle et Kevin. Marie lui donne un acide et ils passent la nuit au bord d'un lac dans une carrière. Le lendemain, toujours sous l'effet de la drogue, Kevin plonge dans le lac, découvre une grotte, une sirène et des diamants. Ce qu'il ne sait pas c'est que ces diamants ont été volés à Moyersoen, un douanier véreux. Kevin confie sa trouvaille à Furet, son meilleur pote dans la troupe, qui insiste pour qu'ils retournent voir qui était cette sirène. Après avoir caché les diamants, ils retournent dans la grotte et découvrent le cadavre d'un jeune homme.

meta.plot: Layne Reed, une jeune fille de 12 ans à la vie très organisée résidant dans la ville fictive de Cedarville, découvre, aux côtés de sa voisine Zora, l'existence d'une voiture ultra-sophistiquée dotée d'une intelligence artificielle et douée de parole dénommée V. I. N. (acronyme de Vehicle Integrated Nanotech), cachée dans un hangar sous-terrain secret situé sous une cabane abandonnée adjacente à sa maison. Elle finira par se rendre compte qu'elle est liée au véhicule et qu'elle semble donc être par conséquent la seule à pouvoir l'activer et le contrôler mais également que d'autres personnes cherchent à s'en emparer par tous les moyens et qu'elle devra tout faire pour empêcher cela.
